jobs.title: Southern California Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**National Forest Foundation (NFF)** is pleased to offer an exempt, full\-time, 2\-Year term position that will support the Southern California Ignition Reduction Program (SCIRP), a public\-private partnership of governmental agencies and their partners working together to reduce human\-caused ignitions, primarily along roadsides.

**About the NFF:** As the official national partner to the US Forest Service (USFS), the National Forest Foundation was chartered by Congress in 1990\. Today, the NFF advances forest resiliency, healthy watersheds and wildlife habitat, and recreation for all by working with communities and organizations across the country. The Foundation has grown significantly in the last few years in programmatic impact, revenue and support, and organizational capacity. NFF leads with impact, deploying roughly 90% of its expenses towards projects and programs across the country’s 193\-million\-acre National Forest System. NFF is forward\-thinking and innovative, with ambitious strategies and goals to advance and prepare forests for a new economy.

**Position Function:** The Southern California Project Coordinator reports to the Southern California Program Director and will work closely with key members of SCIRP, including the USDA Forest Service, California Department of Conservation, California Department of Transportation, and California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection.


The Project Coordinator will support project development and implementation of roadside ignition projects; coordinate with federal, state, and private partners; and support fundraising efforts for projects. This position will work with their supervisor and key members of SCIRP to support project solicitation, project prioritization, and development of the 10\-Year Project Portfolio and Master Plan.


**Position Duties and Responsibilities:** The Southern California Project Coordinator will:

* Work closely with the key SCIRP members and teams to develop project pipeline tools that will support project prioritization, planning, and implementation.
* Support development of the 10\-Year Project Portfolio and Master Plan.
* Develop relationships and facilitate communication between SCIRP partners and project leads.
* Develop agendas, facilitate, and document takeaways for meetings among SCIRP partners and project leads.
* Coordinate with agency partners to complete environmental review, including coordinating associated activities and processes as needed.
* Coordinate and oversee site visits with SCIRP partners and project leads.
* Provide regular updates to the SCIRP Executive Committee and Core Team.
* Work with NFF staff and SCIRP members to secure funds from government sources, foundations, corporations, and individuals to support projects.
* Support preparation of progress and funding reports for federal, state, and local government funding sources as well as for philanthropic support from corporations, foundations, and individuals.
* Oversee the advertisement, negotiation, and award of contracts for services related to SCIRP projects.
* Maintain a breadth of knowledge about current trends, emerging issues, policy interventions, and innovations related to wildfire risk reduction and relevant land management policy and regulations.

**Education and Qualifications:** NFF expects the Southern California Project Coordinator to possess the following educational and experiential qualifications:

* Minimum of an undergraduate degree in natural resource management, biological sciences, environmental policy, or another related field (or equivalent experience).
* Minimum of three (3\) years’ experience in project management, government agency relations, or natural resource management.
* Familiarity with the US Forest Service, California Department of Conservation, California Department of Transportation, and California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection.
* Knowledge of Southern California and Central Coast natural resource management and policy principles, practices, and concepts sufficient to perform the full range of activities connected with planning and coordinating natural resources projects.
* Knowledge of and experience in U.S. Forest Service and/or State of California land management policies, procedures, and regulations.
* Experience working effectively in collaborative efforts with individuals or groups that have a multitude of views.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.

**Abilities and Skills:** NFF expects the Southern California Project Coordinator to possess the following proven abilities and skills:

* Ability to work collaboratively to manage projects with multiple partners, including advanced communication skills and coordination and facilitation skills.
* Ability to represent the NFF in a clear and professional manner through excellent written and oral communication skills and excellent interpersonal skills.
* Ability to effectively set priorities, manage timelines, and create workflows, while managing a variety of projects and tasks to successful completion.
* Ability to utilize a variety of document and data management platforms.
* Ability to work well and be flexible in a team\-oriented environment.
* Self\-driven and motivated to stay focused and productive in a fully remote work environment
* Must have valid U.S. driver’s license and clean driving record.
* Ability and willingness to travel when required to project sites in Southern California and Central Coast, as needed.
* Excellent analytical skills with a strong attention to detail.

**Location:** The location for this position is Southern California in a community near the Los Padres, Angeles, San Bernardino, or Cleveland National Forests. Applicants must be able to travel regularly throughout the Central Coast and Southern California. This position is a remote/work\-from\-home position and requires reliable internet access and a dedicated workspace.

jobs.title: Salesforce Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

  

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high\-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

  

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

  

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real\-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end\-to\-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.  

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day\-to\-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
* Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery
* Lead team and client meetings, ensuring timely follow\-up and holding project team members accountable
* Provide daily task coordination, action tracking and project evaluation
* Leverage data to measure and monitor progress against commitments and provide transparency to project team
* Coach clients on Agile practices and champion the right Agile frameworks based on the type of work
* Use effective decision making to control risk and minimize uncertainty while being proactive through strategic thinking to strive to find new and innovative ways to deliver successful results
* Implement streamlined, effective processes through change management
* Mentor and train entry level team members; play a key role in the interviewing and onboarding process for new Project Managers
* Operate as an innovative thought leader; contribute significantly to the overall growth and quality of the department through knowledge sharing and coaching on current best practices and market trends

 **Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in technology\-focused project management
* Minimum of 1\-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
* Experience managing and forecasting budgets
* Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience creating and maintaining a project plan from inception through completion
* Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end\-to\-end
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C\-Level management
* Excellent organizational, multi\-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
* Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem\-solving skills as required
* We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
* Bachelor’s degree

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in Agile, Project Management, or Business Process Management, highly preferred (or willingness to achieve identified certification within first 12 months of employment)
* Experience working with Salesforce, highly preferred

  

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.


In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.


The wage range

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Join Rimkus and unlock your potential with endless opportunities for growth, learning, and making a difference!


Rimkus (www.rimkus.com) is a worldwide leader in Engineering and Technical Consulting. Rimkus experts specialize in building envelope, engineering, forensic consulting, dispute resolution, construction management services, and solutions built for the environment.


NOW IS THE TIME to join this growing and stable company! We offer our full\-time employees a competitive salary, bonus opportunities and a full benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life, disability, employer\-matching 401(k), and opportunities for advancement!


We are currently seeking Project Coordinator that will assist designated Project Managers with day\-to\-day project and coordinating functions. The primary job duties consist of providing a high level of support to our clients in support of the professional’s forensic engineering work. This is an in\-office position where the individual is expected to be onsite during business hours.

 **Requirements** **Essential Job Functions**

* Provides project support and coordination work.
* Manages email and calendar.
* Assists with scheduling of meetings, conference calls, inspections, and deposition or trial testimony.
* Assists with logging time and expenses.
* Tracks project milestones and deliverables to ensure timely completion.
* Organizes and manages electronic project records.
* Coordinates electronic file sharing of project data.
* Coordinates shipping of technical equipment between district offices and Project Managers.
* Coordinates technical equipment needs and team resources.
* Other miscellaneous duties as assigned.

**Required Education and Certifications**

* An associate’s or bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university is preferred.

**Required Skills and Abilities**

* Excellent oral and written communication skills are required.
* Outstanding computer skills are expected, including the ability to effectively use and assist others with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook). Experience with shared Outlook Calendar as a scheduling tool is a plus.
* Experience in a project support or coordination role in the engineering, legal, or insurance fields a plus.
* Must have strong interpersonal skills and demonstrated poise, tact, and diplomacy.
* Must be able to handle sensitive and confidential information.
* Must have good organizational skills as well as analytical and interpretive skills.
* Should have the ability to manage multiple projects and set priorities.
* Must have the ability to work independently or in a team environment.
* Must have dependable transportation and have a valid Driver’s license.

**Physical Demands, Overtime, and Travel Requirements**


Work is performed primarily in an office setting. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, bend, crouch, hear, and talk (must be able to speak and communicate clearly with employees). Employee may lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Clear vision and depth perception are also necessary.


There will be periods where overtime will be required to meet the company’s business needs.

*Rimkus is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and will make all employment\-related decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.*

 **Benefits**  

* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision)
* Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D)
* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays)
* Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
* Short Term \& Long Term Disability
* Training \& Development
* Work From Home

jobs.description:
**Autism Program Specialist II (BCBA 12 month Contract)**
=========================================================

Job Category: Clinical
Department: Behavioral Health
Location:
Los Angeles, CA, US, 90017


Position Type: Full Time
Requisition ID: 13327
**Salary Range:** **$77,265\.00** **(Min.) \-** **$100,445\.00** **(Mid.) \-** **$123,625\.00** **(Max.)**

  

Established in 1997, L.A. Care Health Plan is an independent public agency created by the state of California to provide health coverage to low\-income Los Angeles County residents. We are the nation’s largest publicly operated health plan. Serving more than 2 million members, we make sure our members get the right care at the right place at the right time.
  

  

Mission: L.A. Care’s mission is to provide access to quality health care for Los Angeles County's vulnerable and low\-income communities and residents and to support the safety net required to achieve that purpose.  

  



**Job Summary**
---------------


The Behavioral Health Treatment Program Specialist II is responsible for conducting clinical reviews of comprehensive diagnostic evaluations, Behavioral Health Treatment (BHT) plans, and related medical records. The Clinical reviewer determines medical necessity, evaluates requested service intensity against clinical severity and documented progress, and ensures appropriate documentation. The reviewer will confirm compliance with the established clinical policy and state/federal regulatory standards governing Medi\-Cal Behavioral Health Treatment (BHT) services. These services apply to individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) and related conditions where individuals require Applied Behavioral Analysis (ABA) or other related BHT services. Behavioral Health Treatment Program Specialist applies clinical benchmarks and medical necessity criteria consistently and conduct peer\-to\-peer clinical discussions with providers as needed to coordinate care.


**Duties**
----------


Conduct clinical review of comprehensive diagnostic evaluations and BHT treatment plans to determine medical necessity, clinical appropriateness, and accuracy of documentation.

  

Review and approve BHT/ABA treatment plans, ensuring requested services are clinically justified, properly documented, and consistent with diagnostic findings and treatment goals.

  

Apply BCBA\-level clinical judgment to evaluate ABA service requests, treatment hours, goals, and progress notes for medical necessity and clinical soundness.

  

Ensure clinical determinations comply with applicable state and federal regulatory standards governing BHT/ABA referral, authorization, and documentation requirements.

  

Identify documentation gaps or clinical concerns in submitted records and communicate findings to providers and internal UM/claims staff.

  

Perform other duties as assigned.


**Duties Continued**
--------------------


**Education Required**
----------------------


Master's Degree in Psychology or Applied Behavior Analysis or Related Field
**Education Preferred**
-----------------------


Bachelor's Degree
**Experience**
--------------


**Required:**


At least 2 years of experience as a BCBA with ABA services, assessments, treatment, programing, and familiarity with regulations.

  

Experience in face\-to\-face ABA case management in the field.


**Skills**
----------


**Required:**


Understand the Early Periodic Screening Detection \& Treatment (EPSDT) process and the eligibility criteria.

  

Proficient in reviewing progress reports and assessing appropriateness of clinical treatment and recommendations.

  

Excellent verbal, written communication and presentation skills.

  

Proficient in Microsoft Office and computer skills


**Licenses/Certifications Required**
------------------------------------


Board Certified Behavioral Analyst \- Active, current and unrestricted California license.
**Licenses/Certifications Preferred**
-------------------------------------


And/Or any of the following Licenses/ Certifications:
Licensed Pharmacy Doctorate/Psychology Doctorate \- Active, current and unrestricted California
Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) \- Active, current and unrestricted California License
Licensed Marriage and Family Therapy (LMFT) \- Active, current and unrestricted California License
**Required Training**
---------------------


**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------


Light
**Additional Information**
--------------------------


**Salary Range Disclaimer:** The expected pay range is based on many factors such as geography, experience, education, and the market. The range is subject to change.

  

This position is a limited duration position. The term of this position is a minimum one year and maximum of two years from the start date unless terminated earlier by either party. Limited duration positions are full\-time positions and are eligible to receive full benefits.

  

  

**L.A. Care offers a wide range of benefits including**


* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Retirement Plans
* Medical, Dental and Vision
* Wellness Program
* Volunteer Time Off (VTO)
  
  

**Nearest Major Market:** Los Angeles
  

**Job Segment:** Social Worker, Behavioral Health, Pharmacy, Claims, Service, Healthcare, Insurance

jobs.title: Program Operations Coordinator 1
jobs.description:
**SPECIAL SERVICE FOR GROUPS, INC.**
Job Description  

 Title: Program Operations Coordinator 1 Division: HOPICS  

 FLSA: Non\-Exempt, Full\-time Supervisor: Business Operations Manager  

 Pay Scale: $25\.00\-30\.00  

  

**Summary**  

Under the supervision of the Business Operations Manager, the Program Operations Coordinator I is primarily responsible for supporting the agency's Accounts Payable function by reviewing, verifying, processing, and maintaining financial transactions in compliance with agency policies, funding requirements, and internal controls. The position also provides administrative and operational support to the Business Operations Department as assigned. The Program Operations Coordinator I supports the day\-to\-day functions of the Accounts Payable department by maintaining financial records, monitoring invoice processing, communicating with vendors and internal staff, researching payment discrepancies, and assisting with month\-end and fiscal year\-end activities. In addition to Accounts Payable responsibilities, the position provides operational support for administrative processes, financial record keeping, and other Business Operations functions as assigned. The role  

requires strong attention to detail, sound organizational skills, discretion when handling confidential financial information, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.  

  

**Essential Functions**  

Accounts Payable Operations  

 Prepare and maintain accurate financial logs, reconciliation reports, receipts, and supporting documentation.  

 Prepare invoices and supporting documentation for payment processing in accordance with agency policies and procedures.  

 Verify invoice accuracy, coding, approvals, and supporting documentation prior to submission for payment processing.  

 Maintain organized filing systems for operational, financial, and administrative records.  

 Ensure compliance with agency policies, audit standards, and financial procedures.  

 Receive, review, and process vendor invoices.  

 Process Request for Check (RFC) packets.  

 Enter invoices into QuickBooks.  

 Reconcile vendor statements and research discrepancies.  

 Respond to vendor payment inquiries.  

 Maintain AP records and documentation.  

 Track invoice aging and payment deadlines.  

 Assist with month\-end and fiscal year\-end AP activities.  

 Maintain confidentiality of financial records.  

 Scan, index, and electronically file Accounts Payable documentation in accordance with agency record retention requirements.  

 Maintain vendor records and assist with vendor onboarding and documentation as assigned.  

  

Business Operations Support  

 Assist with day\-to\-day administrative and operational activities across assigned HOPICS locations.  

 Maintain and monitor petty cash funds, travel advances, and company\-issued gift cards in accordance with agency financial policies and internal controls.  

 Track distribution, usage, reconciliation, and documentation of cash funds and gift cards.  

 Prepare spreadsheets, reports, tracking logs, and operational summaries as requested.  

 Respond to operational and administrative inquiries in a professional and timely manner.  

 Monitor operational expenditures and assist with tracking department spending and budget\-related documentation.  

 Coordinate ordering, tracking, and receipt of office, operational, and facility\-related supplies.  

Compliance \& Record keeping  

 Maintain confidentiality of financial, employee, participant, and operational information.  

 Support compliance with agency operational procedures and internal controls.  

 Maintain accurate records related to reservations, purchases, inventory, reconciliations, and operational activities.  

 Assist with audit preparation and documentation requests as needed.  

  

Communication \& Collaboration  

 Establish and maintain professional working relationships with staff, vendors, and community partners.  

 Communicate effectively regarding operational schedules, reservations, purchasing, and administrative processes.  

 Attend required meetings, training, and agency events.  

 Perform additional duties as assigned.  

  

**Secondary Functions**  

 Overtime, evening, or weekend work may occasionally be required based on operational or event needs.  

 Travel between HOPICS locations may be required.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications \- Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required**  

 High School Diploma or GED required; Associate degree preferred.  

 Minimum one (1\) year of experience in Accounts Payable, financial administrative support, accounting support, or  

bookkeeping, preferred.  

 Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate financial and operational records.  

 Ability to organize tasks, prioritize workload, and manage multiple assignments.  

 Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.  

 Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, and database systems.  

 Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment.  

 Valid California driver’s license, proof of insurance, and reliable transportation may be required.  

 Successful completion of background screening and verification of employment eligibility required.  

  

**Non\-Essential Qualifications \- Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**  

 Experience working in nonprofit, social services, or multi\-site operational environments.  

 Experience with financial tracking systems, reservation systems, or accounts payable processes.  

 Bilingual skills preferred.  

  

**Supervisory Responsibilities**  

This position does not have direct supervisory responsibilities.  

  

**Environmental Conditions (Working Conditions)**  

The Program Operations Coordinator I works primarily in office and program site environments with frequent interaction with staff, vendors

jobs.title: Program Coordinator -11-205 - SC/ Zahn
jobs.description:
Mission Statement



The Salvation Army, an international movement, is an evangelical part of the universal Christian church. Its message is based on the Bible. Its ministry is motivated by the love of God. Its mission is to preach the gospel of Jesus Christ and to meet human needs in His name without discrimination.



Position Summary



The Emergency Housing Manager is responsible for all operational aspects of The Salvation Army Zahn Emergency Shelter including management and regulatory compliance. Functional responsibilities include personnel selection and development, continuous quality improvement, fiscal management and community relations with Homeless agencies providers. (S)He represents The Salvation Army, through Zahn, to community\-based organizations, state agencies, health care organizations and private individuals involved in the homeless service provision.



Essential Functions


* Ensure that residents receive the care and supervision outlined in the resident’s Individual Care Plan/Individualized Housing Stability Plan.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
* Maintain positive communication and relationship with Department of Mental Health (DMH), Los Angeles Homeless Authority (LAHSA), Department of Social Service (DPSS), Family Solution Center (FSC) and other Homeless agencies.
* HMIS/Clarity Data.
* Promote the availability of the facility to agencies and organizations.
* Monitor and implement the applicable policies of Zahn Shelter.
* Complete and submit monthly DPSS report.
* Submit monthly and weekly Statistics.
* Submit annually evaluations of supervise staff.
* Ensure Zahn is up to code with the Health Department and Fire Department.
* Audit residential files periodically for quality assurance.
* Monitor staffs’ timesheets.
* Supervise and coordinate ongoing training for all staff at Zahn Emergency Shelter.
* Enforce resident and staff conduct, building and safety codes.
* Complete periodic reports as required by The Salvation Army, LAHSA and HMIS/Clarity.
* Attend weekly or monthly leadership meeting.
* Supervise all staff (desk clerks, cooks and maintenance) and appropriate outside agencies.
* Attend outside partnership agency meetings/network.
* Responsible for placing Shelter Partnership order and assuring clients have access to donations.
* Facilitate and lead the annually Cluster meeting regarding Zahn Emergency Shelter.


Working Conditions



Ability to walk, stand, bend, squat, climb, kneel and twist on an intermittent or sometimes continuous basis. Ability to grasp, push, pull objects. Ability to lift up to 30 lbs.



Minimum Qualifications


* A. degree or equivalent experience.
* Must be able to speak, read and write English; bilingual (English/Spanish) is a plus.
* Must pass criminal background check.
* Knowledge of basic hotel\-type operations, housing regulations and Cal/OSHA requirements for safe housing environment.
* Red Cross First Aid and CPR certification.

jobs.description:
Student Support Services
  
  

Full\-Time \| Non\-Exempt \| Benefited \| Onsite \| Hourly Rate $30\.00
  
  

About CSUDH Toro Auxiliary Partners
  
The California State University, Dominguez Hills (CSUDH) Toro Auxiliary Partners was established in 1968 to serve as a strategic partner of the university. The Auxiliary provides essential services, supports innovative programs, and enhances initiatives that are integral to the university’s educational mission.
  
  

About CSU Dominguez Hills
  
Founded in 1960, CSU Dominguez Hills is one of 23 campuses in the California State University system. The university is recognized for its rich diversity and serves as a vital educational hub for the South Bay region of Los Angeles County. Its mission is to foster academic excellence and community engagement in a dynamic, metropolitan environment.
  
  

Position Summary
  
  

The Program Coordinator plays a central role in the day\-to\-day operation of the TRIO SSS program, with primary responsibility for planning, coordinating, and facilitating the workshops, events, and programmatic activities that support participant success. The Coordinator designs and delivers workshops on topics such as academic skill\-building, financial literacy, career and graduate school exploration, and personal development; organizes cultural and campus enrichment events; and coordinates program\-wide activities such as orientation, recognition ceremonies, and off\-campus trips. The Coordinator is also responsible for collecting, entering, and maintaining participant data and outcome assessments to support grant compliance and program evaluation, and serves as a primary point of contact for participants, providing responsive, high\-quality customer service. This position works under the general direction of the Director and collaborates closely with SSS advisors, tutors, and campus partners.
  
  

This is a full\-time, benefited, onsite position with an hourly rate of $30\.00\.
  
  

Position Benefits
  
Toro Auxiliary Partners offers comprehensive benefits, including employer\-sponsored health, dental, vision, life insurance, retirement plans, and paid sick/vacation leave.
  
  

Duties and Responsibilities
  
  

Workshop, Event, and Program Coordination
  
  

* Plan, develop, and facilitate workshops and skill\-building sessions for participants covering topics such as study skills, time management, financial literacy, financial aid and scholarship processes, career exploration, graduate school preparation, and college readiness and enrollment.
* Design and coordinate program events and activities, including orientation, recognition and graduation ceremonies, cultural enrichment trips, campus activities, and social/community\-building events, from concept through execution.
* Manage event logistics including scheduling, facility and room reservations, catering, transportation arrangements, invitations, RSVPs, and on\-site setup and staffing.
* Develop and maintain an annual workshop and events calendar aligned with grant objectives and participant needs, adjusting programming based on participation trends and feedback.
* Recruit, train, and coordinate peer mentors, guest speakers, presenters, and campus/community partners to support workshops and events.
* Promote workshops and events through email, social media, flyers, the program website/learning management system, and direct outreach to maximize participant engagement.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of workshops and events through participant feedback and outcome data, and use findings to improve future programming.


Data Collection, Assessment, and Reporting
  
  

* Collect, enter, and maintain accurate participant data in program databases (e.g., Blumen, TRIO software, or institutional systems), including attendance, workshop participation, academic progress, and service contacts.
* Administer and track participant needs assessments, satisfaction surveys, and outcome assessments to measure progress toward grant objectives (retention, good academic standing, persistence, and graduation/transfer rates).
* Maintain up\-to\-date, compliant participant files and documentation in accordance with federal TRIO grant requirements and institutional record\-keeping policies, including FERPA.
* Prepare regular reports summarizing workshop attendance, event participation, and program outcomes for the Director and for the U.S. Department of Education Annual Performance Report (APR).
* Assist with program evaluation activities and continuous improvement efforts based on assessment data.


Participant and Customer Service
  
  

* Serve as a welcoming, responsive first point of contact for prospective and current participants, faculty, and staff, in person, by phone, and by email.
* Provide accurate information about program services, eligibility, workshops, and events, and resolve participant questions or concerns promptly and professionally.
* Support participant recruitment and intake, including verifying eligibility documentation and processing applications.
* Build positive, trust\-based relationships with participants to encourage sustained engagement with program services.
* Model and promote a professional, inclusive, and supportive program environment for a first\-generation, low\-income, and/or disability\-served student population.


Administrative and Program Support
  
  

* Provide general administrative support to the Director and SSS staff, including correspondence, meeting scheduling, and maintenance of meeting minutes.
* Assist with monitoring and tracking budget expenditures related to workshops, events, and program activities.
* Maintain and regularly update the program website, Canvas shell, and social media channels with current, accurate content to keep participants and campus partners informed.
* Support the hiring, onboarding, and training of student workers, peer mentors, or tutors as assigned.
* Represent Educational Partnerships at campus event

5–7 years in operations, business operations, or production administration at an agency, production company, or fast\-moving small business, with real ownership of systems.

You think in systems, not tasks. You see the pattern behind a one\-off problem and fix the pattern.


You're proactive, not reactive. You see what needs to happen next and you do it without being told.


You communicate clearly and follow through relentlessly, including when you need to flag something to someone senior to you.

#### **Bonus if you also bring**

Agency or production company background.


Tech\-savvy — you pick up new software quickly and you don't wait for someone to hold your hand through it. We use a mix of tools and you won't always get a tutorial.


A genuine interest in figuring out what should be systematized or automated as a company scales, rather than just running the process as it exists today.

#### **Why Race Service?**


We are an Automotive Culture Hub and Creative Agency. Our mission: reshape automotive culture. We work at the intersection of content, strategy, experiential, and design for some of the most iconic brands in the world.


But what makes us different isn't the clients. It's our people.

If that sounds like your kind of life, hit apply.

**About OpenArt**

OpenArt is an AI storytelling and visual creation platform used by millions of creators worldwide. We're building the next generation of creative tools powered by cutting\-edge AI—enabling anyone to create videos, visuals, characters, and stories with unprecedented speed and imagination.


Our enterprise platform helps marketing, creative, and studio teams at leading brands, agencies, and entertainment companies accelerate image and video production.

* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-moving, ambiguous startup environment.
* Genuine interest in AI, creative technology, and the future of content production.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in or serving the **entertainment, media, advertising, or creative industries**.

jobs.description:
**Job Description – Speakman Strategic Account Manager – Industrial Safety – Western Territory** *For more than 150 years, Speakman has been a trusted manufacturer of innovative plumbing fixtures and hospitality solutions, recognized for exceptional performance, quality, and reliability. As part of Everflow, Speakman continues to build on that legacy through continued investment in our products, people, and customer partnerships.* *Our culture is built around collaboration, accountability, and growth. We move with purpose, think like owners, and believe every team member plays an important role in driving success. As we continue to grow, we're looking for motivated people who want to make an impact and help shape the future of the Speakman brand.* **Position Summary**  

As the **Strategic Account Manager, Industrial Safety** for Speakman, you will lead and manage complex customers within a specific Industrial Safety Channel Focus (that cross over multiple District’s on the West Coast). Your primary responsibilities will include formulating and executing strategies, overseeing financial metrics, and enhancing customer relationships. You will collaborate with regional and divisional offices and work closely with field sales teams to implement initiatives and drive business growth.  

  

The ideal candidate is someone who has a strong knowledge of and experience in the Industrial Safety Channel, with sales routes to market, as well as specific experience in the building and construction industry, particularly with large national accounts.  



  

This position is remote based with preference that the individual live near a major airport in the West Region. LAX, PHX, SAN, SFO, PDX, SEA or DEN.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop and implement sales plans, encompassing market analysis, account opportunities, short and long\-term goals, strategic initiatives, and measurable outcomes including individual account plans, specification and upgrade recommendations, and sales strategies for Speakman Safety products.
* Build and nurture relationships with key decision\-makers and stakeholders across the business to retain existing business, secure national specifications, and improve margins.
* Gain a deep understanding of each strategic account's business and its critical performance metrics, collaborating with the customer to acquire essential information and assess opportunities.
* Analyze data and trends to develop insights that enhance customer retention, drive incremental revenue, and create a competitive advantage.
* Ensure timely and effective responses to customer needs by mobilizing the organization, facilitating cross\-functional involvement, and including relevant departments to benefit the customer.
* Monitor and maintain consistent communication with relevant parties.
* Coordinate the allocation of organizational resources to maximize sales opportunities.
**Required*** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience, MBA preferred
* Minimum of 7 years of proven sales or relevant experience.
* Implicit understanding of focus channel sales route to market.
* Proficient in MS Office Suites.
* Ability to travel 75% or 3 weeks out of the month.
 **Preferred**  

Large national account and sales experience in manufacturing and building products. **Target Compensation Range:** The posted pay range of **$130,000\-$150,000** represents the anticipated hiring range for this position. Individual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, qualifications, education, certifications, geographic location, market conditions, internal compensation practices, and other job\-related business considerations, consistent with applicable law.

 **Why Speakman,** ***an Everflow Company***

*At Speakman, we believe great companies are built by great people. We are committed to creating a culture where employees feel supported, empowered, and connected to the work they do every day.*

*We value people who think like owners, move with urgency, work collaboratively, and follow through on their commitments. As a growing organization, we offer opportunities to learn, contribute, and grow your career alongside a team that is passionate about serving customers and building long\-term success together.*

***Benefits****: Our offerings include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, company\-sponsored retirement plans, and additional programs designed to support our employees and their families. Most importantly, we strive to create a workplace where people feel valued, supported, and empowered to succeed.*

*Everflow is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*

jobs.title: Community Manager
Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
iHeartMedia Markets  



Current employees and contingent workers click here **to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.**

  



The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it! iHeartMedia, **the number one audio company in America**, reaches 90% of Americans every month \- a monthly audience that’s **twice the size of any other audio company** – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad\-supported music streaming service. In fact, we have:

* **More \#1 rated markets** than the next two largest radio companies combined;
* **We’re the largest podcast publisher**, with more monthly downloads than the second\- and third\-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest\-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;
* iHeart is **the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on\-air personalities and podcast influencers**, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;
* We create and produce some of **the most popular and well\-known branded live music events** in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;
* iHeartRadio is the **\#1 streaming radio digital service** in America;
* Our **social media footprint** is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and
* We have **the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio**, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale. As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option.


Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity. Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the \#1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

  



**What We Need:**


We’re seeking a Social Media Manager to work in the iHeartRadio Los Angeles group of stations. In this role, you’ll be focused on increasing digital listening, follower engagement, brand recognition, brand affinity, and ultimately drive overall growth. The ideal candidate will understand the responsibility that comes with leading social media for multiple major brands.
  

  

This position requires openness to a flexible schedule as there may be work needed on occasional nights and weekends.  



**What You'll Do:**

  

* Manage and maintain regular posting schedule of content and editorial pieces on Los Angeles stations with a heavy focus on the Alternative Rock genre.
* Coordinate with various departments and help guide on\-air personalities to maximize listening opportunities through their personal and station social channels.
* Respond to music and pop culture events and use those opportunities to introduce new fans to the iHeartRadio ecosystem.
* Track social media analytics to use to judge prior campaigns and future strategies.
* Work closely with the Digital Program Director on developing and carrying out the plan for each station to increase digital listening, social engagement and other KPIs in line with iHeartRadio’s overall strategy.
* Be responsible for all social media touchpoints for the music fandoms, including new releases, social first campaigns and any other interaction to boost fan and community engagement.
* Work with on\-air talent to find ways to localize/personalize content, making it more relevant and engaging on station social platforms.
* Covering both local LA\-station events and national iHeartRadio tentpole events to capture content and posting real\-time event coverage.
* Writing and editing compelling social media copy with the purpose of engaging our fans, while leading community engagement.

  



**What You'll Need:**

* Minimum of 2\+ years of experience working in social media or digital marketing, entertainment or music industries preferred.
* The position requires urgency, curiosity, creativity, the ability to collaborate with a team and consistently meet deadlines.
* The role requires a person with excellent communication and strong organizational skills.
* Always on your phone, with a healthy appetite for Alternative music, pop culture and entertainment.
* In\-depth knowledge of the latest best practices, tools, and trends on social media platforms (Facebook, Facebook Live, Instagram, Instagram Stories, IGTV, Instagram Live, X, YouTube, TikTok, Twitch etc.), as well as sponsored/partner content protocols.
* Strong writing, proof\-reading, and copyediting skills.
* You know how to capture and create on the fly content when covering events IRL and virtually.
* Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite and/or Canva.

  



**What You'll Bring:**

* Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
* Accountability for own work and desire to provide guidance to new team members
* Ability to contribute to several projects at the same time under a moderate level of direction
* Application of objective judgement, technical skills and prior experience to solve business problems
* Strong written and verba

jobs.title: CHINESE COMMUNITY MARKETING SPECIALIST
jobs.description:
**CHIMCKING USA** 

**Job Title:** Chinese Community Marketing Specialist \& Franchise Relations Liaison

**Work Location:** 2100 E VALENCIA BLVD SUITE B, FULLERTON CA 92831 (Plus local fieldwork \& occasional domestic travel)

**Pay \& Compensation:** $71,000 \- $75,000 a year (Negotiable, depending on experience)  
**Supplemental Pay:** Generous 5% Commission on the Franchise Fee (Earned only on franchise contracts secured through the employee's direct sales and outreach efforts within the Chinese community) / Performance\-based Bonus

**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Travel Requirement:** Approximately 20% (Local fieldwork \& domestic business trips)

**\[About CHIMCKING HQ \& Leadership]**

CHIMCKING is a leading global K\-Food and culture brand, pioneering the premium Korean Fried Chicken \& Beer market with its unique interior concepts and superior signature sauces. Starting in South Korea, CHIMCKING has rapidly expanded across the Asian and global markets, currently operating approximately 30 stores across South Korea, Japan, Vietnam, Mongolia, and the United States. With upcoming flagship expansions planned for Thailand, Indonesia, and across the US, CHIMCKING is dynamically growing into a premier global franchise powerhouse.

CHIMCKING USA is proudly led by our US CEO, HONG TAE KIM, an esteemed pioneer in the global franchise business in Korea. Under his visionary leadership and proven track record of international success, CHIMCKING USA is embarking on an aggressive expansion phase, offering an unparalleled environment for professionals looking to grow alongside an industry leader.

**\[Job Overview]**

CHIMCKING USA is aggressively expanding into the Los Angeles market! As our corporate executives and legal representatives do not speak Chinese, we are seeking a highly professional, proactive, and bilingual Chinese Community Marketing Specialist \& Franchise Relations Liaison to serve as the vital bridge between our executive team and the Chinese\-American business community.

This position is based out of our Fullerton, CA office. This is an active, dynamic role where fieldwork and business travel account for about 20% of the total workload. You will lead our brand promotion via Chinese social media channels, attend local community events, conduct on\-site market research, and serve as the primary point of contact for prospective franchise investors.

**\[Key Responsibilities]**

· **Franchise Consulting \& Lead Generation:** Serve as the proactive first point of contact for prospective franchise investors from the Chinese community; present CHIMCKING’s business model, unique value propositions, and financial systems.

· **Active Community Engagement:** Build and maintain an active network within the local Chinese\-American business community through continuous outreach, online forums, and corporate discovery events to organically source warm leads.

· **Executive Interpretation \& Translation:** Provide precise, professional interpretation (Mandarin \<\-\> English) during corporate meetings and contract negotiations between prospective franchisees and our executive team.

· **Advanced Content Creation \& SNS Management:** Design, produce, and manage high\-impact text and short\-form video content tailored to the Chinese\-American demographic to maximize brand exposure and franchise inquiries.

· **Fieldwork \& Travel (20%):** Conduct local marketing outreach, attend Chinese business association events, film on\-site promotional content at restaurant locations, and occasionally travel out\-of\-state to support franchise expansions and operational audits.

**\[Qualifications]**

· **Language Capabilities:** Native or near\-native fluency in Mandarin is strictly required. For this specific position, Mandarin proficiency is our top hiring priority and carries greater weight than English proficiency. Professional working proficiency in English is required for internal corporate reporting. Proficiency or conversational ability in Korean is highly desirable / preferred (to facilitate smooth communication with corporate executives and partners).

· **Franchise Insight:** Strong comprehension of franchise business operations and investor mentalities (Prior experience in franchise growth or commercial B2B sales is highly preferred).

· **Communication Powerhouse:** Natural networker with an outgoing personality, skilled at cold/warm outreach and building trust with diverse business owners.

· **SNS \& Media Proficiency:** Highly skilled in managing business accounts on WeChat, Xiaohongshu (RED), and Douyin/TikTok, with proven capability in short\-form video editing (e.g., CapCut).

· **Experience:** 2\+ years of experience in Franchise Relations, B2B Sales, Social Media Marketing, or Commercial Liaison roles. (Candidates with proven experience in these similar roles will receive preferred consideration).

· **Travel \& Mobility:** Valid Driver’s License and a reliable vehicle for local fieldwork; flexibility to travel for business up to 20% of the time.

· **Work Authorization:** Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

**\[Benefits \& Perks]**

· **Performance\-Driven Incentive Structure:** 5% Commission on the Franchise Fee for contracts closed via direct sales and sourcing efforts

· **Health Benefits:** Health, Dental, and Vision insurance options (Available after 3 months of introductory period)

· **Meals:** Lunch Provided

· **Paid Sick Days:** 6 Paid Sick Days per year

· **Holidays:** Paid Federal Holidays (Day Off)

· **Reimbursement:** Travel \& Mileage Reimbursement for business\-related travel and fieldwork

· **Time Off:** Paid Time Off (PTO)

· **Career Path:** Clear path to career and executive growth as our corporate footprint expands nationwide

**\[How to Apply \& Selection Process]**

Please submit your resume (and a portfolio of content creation or marketing campaigns if available) through Indeed, or apply directly by contacting us at the information b

jobs.company: Campus Billiards - Craft Beer & Sports Bar
jobs.title: Server / Social Media Specialist / Live Streamer
jobs.description:
Campus Billiards \& Sports Bar. is hiring a Server / Social Media Specialist for weekends. This is one cohesive role with two major responsibilities: serving the room and owning our social media presence.

You will be on the floor serving, selling shots, and taking care of guests on busy Friday and Saturday nights. You are also the person fully in charge of all Campus social content—filming, appearing on camera, talking about sports, acting or modeling for TikToks, live\-streaming, editing, and posting during every single shift.

This is not a position where you just take a few phone videos if you happen to find the time. You are the content person for our nightlife footprint. If you only want to serve, please do not apply. If you only want to film behind the scenes and never want to be featured on camera yourself, this is not the role for which you should apply.

What You Will Do

Serving \& Floor Support

* Serve shots, beer, cocktails, and food.
* Help drive shot sales and specialty drink promotions when the room is packed.
* Learn our craft beer selection and operate the POS system efficiently.
* Work collaboratively as an active part of the floor team.

Social Media \& Live Streaming

* Film and post content talking about the sports games and match\-ups of the day.
* Appear as the main on\-camera talent—talking, acting, and modeling for TikTok and Instagram Reels.
* Go live on social platforms during peak hours to showcase the room, crowd, and energy.
* Film the crowd, the screens, the drinks, and the overall vibe of the bar.
* Edit and finalize clips using CapCut and Canva before the end of your shift.
* Help grow our digital following to bring more foot traffic through the door.

Required Skills \& On\-Camera Comfort

You must already be highly proficient and comfortable with:

* TikTok and Instagram (creating, editing, and publishing Reels/videos).
* CapCut and Canva.
* Being the center of attention on camera (talking\-head videos, skits, and promotional modeling).

*Note: Content creation is a core part of your mandatory shift duties, not extra work to do after you clock out.*

Required Schedule (No Exceptions)

You must be able to work both of the following shifts every single week:

* Friday: 9:00 PM – 2:00 AM
* Saturday: 9:00 PM – 2:00 AM

Because we operate with a small, tightly knit crew, we are unable to accommodate time\-off requests for upcoming concerts, weddings, parties, or trips. Please do not apply if you have existing schedule conflicts on these nights. Total reliability and dependability are strict conditions of employment.

Requirements

* Must be 21 years of age or older.
* Outgoing, reliable, and comfortable navigating a high\-volume sports bar floor.
* Extremely comfortable speaking, acting, and modeling on camera.
* Proven ability to create, edit, and finish digital content efficiently during a fast\-paced shift.
* Reliable transportation and a strict commitment to arriving on time.
* Physical ability to walk, stand, and move quickly for the entire duration of the shift.
* Must pass a pre\-employment drug screen.
* Willingness to learn our craft beer menu.
* *Prior bar or restaurant experience is a plus, but dynamic on\-camera personality and the ability to consistently deliver completed content matter most.*

Pay \& Perks

* $17\.00/hour plus a shared tip pool.
* Growth Opportunities: This is an excellent job for someone currently studying social media marketing who wants hands\-on industry experience. For the right dependable worker, we offer opportunities over time to cross\-train behind the bar and learn the trade of bartending.

How to Apply

Apply directly on Indeed and include links to your public Instagram and TikTok profiles. We review social media portfolios first to evaluate on\-camera comfort and editing style.

Pay: From $17\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Employee discount

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sales Operations and Regulatory Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
We are a pet food company seeking an organized, detail\-oriented coordinator to manage customer orders, freight, shipping documentation, invoicing, and state product registrations. This role works with production partners, carriers, customers, and regulatory agencies to keep orders and shipments moving accurately and on schedule.

**Responsibilities**

* Enter dry, canned, and raw food orders; create sales orders and purchase orders; update production worksheets and sales records; and send order confirmations.
* Compile monthly production orders and supporting purchase orders.
* Request and review freight quotes, coordinate pickups, prepare bills of lading and pallet tags, and track freight charges.
* Prepare and check commercial invoices, packing slips, certificates of origin, lot code and best\-by information, and other documents for international shipments.
* Coordinate documentation for shipments involving Canada, South Korea, and Japan, including applicable USFWS and APHIS processes.
* Maintain state licenses and product registrations, track renewal requirements, and submit tonnage reports where required.
* Post purchase orders and sales orders, process invoices, and coordinate credits for damages or shipping errors.
* Document pallet temperatures and loading details for applicable shipments.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in sales operations, order processing, logistics, regulatory administration, or a related role.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when checking shipping documents and meeting filing deadlines.
* Proficiency with Excel and the ability to work across multiple recordkeeping

Pay: $22\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 32\.0 – 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Door-to-Door Sales Representative 10-99
jobs.description:
Door\-to\-Door Sales Representative

Overview

seeking motivated, self\-driven individuals to join our growing sales organization. This is a 1099 independent contractor opportunity offering unlimited earning potential, flexible scheduling, and a clear path to leadership.

As a Door\-to\-Door Sales Representative, you will connect with homeowners in assigned neighborhoods, educate customers on fiber internet services, and help families find solutions that fit their needs. Whether you’re experienced in sales or looking to build a career, Northstar Fiber provides training, mentorship, and opportunities for advancement.

Top performers can earn leadership positions, build their own teams, participate in recruiting, run sales blitzes, and generate additional income through team overrides and referral bonuses.

Responsibilities

* Prospect residential neighborhoods through door\-to\-door sales
* Build rapport with homeowners and identify customer needs
* Present fiber internet solutions professionally and confidently
* Generate and follow up on leads
* Maintain accurate customer and sales records
* Attend team meetings, trainings, and development sessions
* Work independently while contributing to team goals
* Represent Northstar Fiber with professionalism and integrity

What We Offer

* 1099 Independent Contractor position
* Unlimited commission potential
* Flexible schedule — work your own hours
* Weekly pay
* Comprehensive sales training
* Leadership and management advancement opportunities
* Ability to build and lead your own sales team
* Team override compensation opportunities
* Referral bonus program
* Opportunities to participate in and lead sales blitzes in multiple markets
* Ongoing coaching and mentorship

Qualifications

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Self\-motivated and goal\-oriented
* Ability to work independently
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn
* Sales experience is a plus but not required
* Must be at least 18 years old

Growth Opportunity

At Northstar Fiber, we don’t just hire sales representatives—we develop leaders. Individuals who demonstrate strong performance and leadership abilities may have the opportunity to recruit, train, and manage their own sales teams while earning additional compensation through team production.

If you’re looking for a flexible opportunity with uncapped income and a path to leadership, apply today.

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Relocation assistance

Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for **making a difference for small business** in your community? Are you looking for a career with **unlimited income potential**? Is **company culture** important to you? Or maybe you have been thinking about switching career paths and moving into sales?

**NFIB was chosen as a Glassdoor Top 50 Best Places to Work.** Whether you have some sales experience or are new to sales, NFIB will set you up for success with best\-in\-class training. **A career with NFIB provides a flexible work/life balance while still maintaining full\-time effort in the field.**  

Think of this as an in\-field work environment where you're not tied to an office location. Instead, your office is the work area you serve. Approximately 95% of your time will be spent in the field within your local market, meeting face\-to\-face with small business owners and growing NFIB membership.


***What’s in it for you:**** **W\-2 with full benefits** (medical, dental, vision, matching 401k, and more) \- **eligible after 30 days**
* **Up to 13 weeks** (1,000/wk) **performance\-based training pay** (or commission, whichever is greater)
* **Production\-based weekly commissions, monthly \& quarterly bonuses**
* **Yearly average compensation: $80,000 \- $200,000**
* **40%** of our sales force **earns 6\-figures** with the **top 10%** earning **over 200k**
* **UNCAPPED earning potential** (Straight Commission)
* **Monthly Mileage reimbursement**

***Who we are*****:**

**NFIB is the most trusted advocate for free enterprise**, promoting and protecting the rights of any individual to own, operate, and grow their business. **NFIB's advocacy has a profound impact on shaping public policies** by influencing


decision\-makers, raising awareness, and mobilizing public support. NFIB membership is the mechanism for small business owners to actively contribute to the development of policies that align with their values and concerns. **NFIB has been fighting for independent business owners** for over 80 years. We are the **Voice of Small Business** in Washington, D.C., and in all 50 state capitals. **NFIB is a nonprofit, nonpartisan, and member driven** organization.

  

We educate small business owners through in\-person prospecting (no appointment setting) using NFIB's success\-proven verbatim sales presentation. This is a hunter/closer sales position using an assumptive one\-call close with no account management after the sale. ***What you will be responsible for:**** Meeting small business owners through in\-person prospecting (no appointment setting)
* Memorizing and utilizing NFIB’s proven 5\-minute verbatim sales presentation
* Building quick rapport and delivering an engaging presentation
* Overcoming objections and closing the sale

Processing payment on the spot  
* 

  

***Requirements to win in this role:**** Strong work ethic
* Grit and relentless perseverance
* Self\-starter and ability to stick with a structured, proven sales model
* Desire for ongoing learning
* Quick\-witted, adaptable, and strategic
* Passion for the success of small business
* Sales experience **AND/OR** transferable skills
* Intermediate technical skills


A career with NFIB means being part of a team of truly extraordinary people working to promote and protect small business. You will be impacting your community while taking advantage of our competitive compensation, ongoing training, incentives, and generous benefits package. **Learn more about the NFIB’s culture here:** www.nfib.com/careers


Equal Opportunity Employer

As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.
  
  

Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.
  
  

We boldly go.
  
  

**Where is the work:**  

Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.
  
  

**What's in it for you:**  

The Client Service Representative delivers exceptional service and support to our customers within a specific group of assigned Account Managers. This role is important to meeting the financial and business goals for the Region’s service business. This role sits on the sales team and partners closely with operations. Responsible for scope expansion, improving customer satisfaction and ensuring contractual obligations are being met. Identifies opportunities for growth and sales in assigned customer portfolio and partners with the sales team as required. Works with account team(s) to develop innovative solutions that provide a profitable, measurable, and repeatable value. This position includes customer support and sales activities at client’s facilities as needed. Duties include making sales or obtaining order or contracts for services.
  
  

**What you will do:**  

* Responsible for customer satisfaction, retention, and growth for assigned portfolio mostly consisting of small service agreement customers and accounts.

* Driving new mechanical service agreements and service agreement renewals.

Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. jobs.description:

They meet with potential and existing customers to present sales proposals and inform them of product benefits and features. The Territory Sales Representative will play a key role in increasing distribution and display activity by managing and negotiating with clients, research sales competition, qualifying prospects and managing sales of products and services.

Sales**Job Description Summary:**

This position is designed as a sales development role and will rotate through a number of different territories. The primary responsibility for this position will be to fill in open territories as needed in order to maximize the sales of supplier brands to the trade. This position may be asked to assist the Merchandising Department during particularly heavy merchandising periods.**Job Description:**

**Job Responsibilities:**


Calls on accounts and covers daily routes by creating an established and efficient routing pattern.

* Prepares and delivers professional sales presentations to customers by balancing the company’s priorities and customer’s needs to include selling display ideas, new products, cold box, shelf, back bar placements and resets, drink and wine lists, and promotions.
* Maintains product levels in accounts by taking inventory and restocking shelves (where legal).
* Ensures maximum brand visibility within accounts by using effective and current point of sale materials when appropriate.
* Obtains payments for company by collecting and delivering checks or other remittance from accounts where legally permissible.
* Educates account staff by conducting educational staff training seminars on brands.
* Services accounts by delivering products to customers in extenuating circumstances, handling customer issues and complaints and referring these issues as appropriate to management.


Strategizes/preplans on how best to achieve sales and merchandising objectives by understanding company pricing and product programming information on a monthly basis and maintaining accurate historical account purchase information.

* Ensures national account compliance where applicable by accurately completing all necessary surveys.
* Understands the account’s buying patterns by reviewing the company pricing and product programming information on a monthly basis and maintains accurate historical account purchase information.
* Attains standards of performance goals by achieving the distribution, volume and activity goals of supplier brands as set by management.
* Manages customer account receivables by timely processing of credits and returns and communicating with accounts on aged receivables.
* Remains informed of company/supplier activities and updates by attending and actively participating in weekly sales meetings.


Other duties, as assigned by the jobholder’s supervisor, may also be required.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related field and/or equivalent training and work experience
* Minimum of 2 years’ experience in sales
* Basic PC skills using MS Office and other various computer programs including presentation software
* Must be a results\-oriented professional with verbal/written communication skills using diplomacy and discretion as well as customer service skills
* Ability to multi\-task, work independently and/or within a team, pay attention to detail and meet deadlines
* Analytic and Reporting skills
* Utilize sound judgement and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to work in fast\-paced, high\-volume, team environment
* Have a valid driver’s license

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Ability to hold a Solicitor’s Permit
* Understanding of wine and spirits

**Physical Requirements:**

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to, stand, sit; talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer and telephone
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to reach overhead, squat and bend
* Carrying and lifting 45\-65 pounds

**Competencies:**

* Accountable for results which impact the department.
* Selects best option from a set of defined procedures/ solutions using common sense and experience of similar situations.

*This job description is only a summary of the typical functions of this position, not an exhaustive or comprehensive list of all possible job responsibilities, tasks and duties. Responsibilities, tasks, and duties of individual jobholders may vary from the above description.*

***Salary and Benefit Statement:***


Any offered salary is determined based on internal equity, internal salary ranges, market data/ranges, applicant's skills, and prior relevant experience.

**Compensation**

* $45k \- $55k Salary
* Mileage Reimbursement at 70 cents per Business Miles driven

**Benefits**

* Medical (HMO \& PPO), Dental, Vision (PPO)401(k) matching.
* Annual PTO Accrual and holidays
* Rollover Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)
* Free Life and AD\&D Insurance Employee Assistance Program

2901 Daimler Street, Santa Ana, CA

Full\-Time

**FLSA Classification:**

Non\-Exempt (Hourly)

$25\.00 – $27\.00 per hour

**Position Summary**

The Project Coordinator – Regulatory supports Eterna Management, LLC in planning, tracking, and executing projects within a highly regulated manufacturing and third\-party logistics (3PL) environment. This role coordinates timelines, documentation, and cross\-functional communication to ensure projects are completed accurately, on schedule, and in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter who takes initiative without constant direction, is exceptionally detail\-oriented, and understands that in a regulatory environment, accuracy and documentation are non\-negotiable.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and track regulatory, quality, and operational projects from initiation through completion, including timelines, milestones, deliverables, and action items.
* Maintain organized, audit\-ready project files, logs, and records in accordance with company document control and record\-retention requirements.
* Assist with the preparation, review, and submission of regulatory documentation, registrations, renewals, certificates, and compliance reports.
* Track regulatory deadlines, license and permit renewals, and required filings; proactively notify stakeholders of upcoming due dates.
* Support internal audits, customer audits, and regulatory inspections by gathering documentation, preparing binders, and tracking corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) to closure.
* Coordinate cross\-functionally with Quality Control, Production, Lab, Warehouse, Safety, and Management to gather information and keep projects moving.
* Schedule and facilitate project meetings; prepare agendas, record meeting notes, and distribute and follow up on action items.
* Review documents, labels, specifications, and records for accuracy, completeness, and consistency, and escalate discrepancies promptly.
* Assist in drafting, updating, and routing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and forms for review and approval.
* Prepare status reports, trackers, and summaries for leadership on project progress, risks, and open items.
* Monitor changes in applicable regulations and industry guidance as directed and communicate relevant updates to the team.
* Maintain confidentiality of proprietary, customer, and regulatory information.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

**Education and Experience:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business, Science, Regulatory Affairs, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of two (2\) years of project coordination, administrative, compliance, or quality support experience.
* Experience in a regulated industry (e.g., dietary supplements, food, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, hemp/CBD, or medical devices) strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with cGMP, document control, audit processes, or CAPA systems preferred.

**Skills and Abilities:**

* **Self\-Starter:** Works independently, takes ownership of assignments, and identifies next steps without waiting for direction.
* **Detail\-Oriented:** Exceptional accuracy and thoroughness; catches errors and inconsistencies before they become compliance issues.
* **Organized:** Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines at once.
* **Communicator:** Clear, professional written and verbal communication with employees at all levels.
* **Technical:** Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint); experience with project\-tracking tools is a plus.
* **Integrity:** Exercises sound judgment, handles confidential information with discretion, and escalates concerns appropriately.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) a plus.

**Physical Requirements and Work Environment**

This position is primarily performed in an office setting, with regular visits to production, laboratory, and warehouse areas. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for extended periods, use a computer and keyboard, and communicate in person and by phone. The employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, and lift up to 25 pounds. When in production or warehouse areas, the employee must follow all Cal/OSHA safety requirements, company safety policies, and personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and may be exposed to moderate noise levels. This is a non\-exempt position eligible for overtime in accordance with California law. Employees accrue paid sick leave in accordance with California law, including SB 616, and are eligible for company benefits in accordance with applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.
