Employment with Eterna Management, LLC is at\-will, meaning that either the employee or the company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice. Nothing in this job description creates a contract of employment. This job description is not intended to be an all\-inclusive list of duties, and the company reserves the right to modify duties and responsibilities at any time.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
**Join our team as a Digital Marketing Manager at Quorum Hospitality!**



Are you a results\-driven marketer who thrives on performance and strategy? As the **Digital Marketing Manager**, you'll be responsible for the digital presence and performance of our multi\-brand hotel portfolio, including brand.com and property websites, search engine optimization (SEO), and paid media across search, display, and social channels. You'll partner closely with our Director of Marketing, property General Managers and sales teams, brand digital marketing programs, and outside agencies to drive direct bookings, lower cost of guest acquisition, and strengthen brand and property visibility across the portfolio.

  


**Salary:** $105,000 \- $115,000 / year.

  


**Location**: This position supports a flexible **hybrid** work model, with on\-site requirements based on the employee's location relative to our Newport Beach office.



* **Orange County residents:** Two days per week in the office.
* **Los Angeles, San Diego, and other surrounding areas:** Two in\-office days per month.
  





**Your Role:**



As our Corporate Marketing Manager, you'll own digital performance across our hotel portfolio, from websites to paid media to organic search. Some of your responsibilities will include:


* Manage the day\-to\-day content accuracy, updates, and performance of property, corporate, and independent/restaurant websites, including hosting, design updates, and content refreshes.
* Coordinate with brand digital teams and vendors on brand.com and OTA content, imagery, and merchandising for each property.
* Monitor site analytics and report on traffic, conversion rate, and direct booking metrics.
* Develop and execute SEO strategy across all properties, including keyword research, on\-page optimization, and local SEO, and track rankings and organic visibility by market and property.
* Manage Google Business Profiles at the property level, including listings accuracy, photos, posts, and review response.
* Manage planning, execution, and optimization of paid media campaigns across paid search, metasearch, paid social, and OTAs, including brand\-specific programs and budgets (Hilton Advance, Beacon, Amplify/Elevate, Marriott PLUS).
* Own budget pacing, bid strategy, audience targeting, creative testing, and monthly performance reporting across all paid channels.
* Oversee organic social content calendars and community management across property and restaurant group accounts.
* Partner with Revenue Management to align digital marketing spend and messaging with rate strategy and demand calendars, and maintain a monthly digital marketing dashboard for ownership and property leadership.
* Manage relationships and contracts with external SEO, web, and paid media agencies as needed.
* Other duties as assigned.

  


**What We're Looking For:**


* 3–5\+ years of digital marketing experience, ideally within hospitality, multi\-unit retail/restaurant, or multi\-location services businesses.
* Hands\-on experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics 4, Google Business Profile, and a major CMS (WordPress or brand\-proprietary platforms).
* Familiarity with hotel brand digital ecosystems is a strong plus (e.g., Hilton Advance/Amplify/Beacon, Marriott PLUS/Marriott Digital Services/Koddi).
* A high school diploma or equivalent is required; a bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field is a plus.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate performance data into clear recommendations for non\-marketing stakeholders.
* Excellent project management skills; comfortable managing multiple properties, brands, and vendors simultaneously.

  


**What We'll Do For You:**


* **Health Benefits –** Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance available starting the first of the month after just 30 days. *(Full\-time team members)*
* **Holidays \& Paid Time Off –** Take time to relax and recharge. *(For eligible team members)*
* **401(k) Retirement Plan –** Secure your future with our generous company match.
* **Education Program –** Further your career with our tuition reimbursement program.
* **Hotel Travel Discounts –** Explore the world with special rates.
* **Daily Pay –** Access your earnings when you need them.

  


**Why Join Quorum Hospitality?**



Quorum Hospitality, ranked among the nation's leading hotel management companies, has been delivering value\-driven hospitality solutions since 1987\. Our diverse portfolio features renowned hospitality brands such as Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt, and IHG, highlighting our commitment to excellence in customized management. Our team is dedicated to building strong relationships and providing exceptional service that benefits guests, owners, and team members alike. Headquartered in Plano, Texas, and Newport Beach, California, we pride ourselves on fostering a culture of integrity and innovation.


Equal Opportunity Employer  

This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

  

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high\-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

  

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

  

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real\-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end\-to\-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.  

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day\-to\-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
* Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery
* Lead team and client meetings, ensuring timely follow\-up and holding project team members accountable
* Provide daily task coordination, action tracking and project evaluation
* Leverage data to measure and monitor progress against commitments and provide transparency to project team
* Coach clients on Agile practices and champion the right Agile frameworks based on the type of work
* Use effective decision making to control risk and minimize uncertainty while being proactive through strategic thinking to strive to find new and innovative ways to deliver successful results
* Implement streamlined, effective processes through change management
* Mentor and train entry level team members; play a key role in the interviewing and onboarding process for new Project Managers
* Operate as an innovative thought leader; contribute significantly to the overall growth and quality of the department through knowledge sharing and coaching on current best practices and market trends

 **Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in technology\-focused project management
* Minimum of 1\-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
* Experience managing and forecasting budgets
* Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience creating and maintaining a project plan from inception through completion
* Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end\-to\-end
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C\-Level management
* Excellent organizational, multi\-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
* Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem\-solving skills as required
* We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
* Bachelor’s degree

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in Agile, Project Management, or Business Process Management, highly preferred (or willingness to achieve identified certification within first 12 months of employment)
* Experience working with Salesforce, highly preferred

  

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

jobs.title: SOCIAL MEDIA & DIGITAL COMMUNICATIONS COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
**SOCIAL MEDIA \& DIGITAL** 

**COMMUNICATIONS COORDINATOR** 

**Location:** Concord, California

**Organization:** Refuge Outreach Services (ROS) **Programs:** Harvest of Hope Market \& Thrift Store **Reports To:** Executive Director

**Position Type:** Part\-Time or Full\-Time, based upon organizational needs

**Compensation:** To be determined based on experience and position structure

**POSITION SUMMARY** 

Refuge Outreach Services is seeking a creative, organized, mission\-driven **Social Media \& Digital Communications Coordinator** to develop and manage the organization’s social media presence and digital storytelling across major platforms.

This individual will help tell the story of Refuge Outreach Services, Harvest of Hope Market, and the Harvest of Hope Thrift Store while increasing community awareness, donor engagement, volunteer participation, partnerships, and support for our mission.

Our communications should consistently demonstrate our commitment to **“Transforming Charity into Dignity.”** 

The ideal candidate understands that nonprofit social media is more than posting photographs and announcements. It is about building relationships, telling meaningful stories, creating community, and inspiring people to participate in the mission.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES** 

**Social Media Management** 

Develop, manage, and maintain an active presence across appropriate platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, and other emerging platforms.

Create and maintain a consistent weekly and monthly content calendar.

Publish regular content highlighting:

* Harvest of Hope Market activities and impact • Harvest of Hope Thrift Store merchandise, promotions, and community impact
* Refuge Outreach Services programs and initiatives • Volunteer opportunities and volunteer recognition • Donor and community partner recognition • Community events
* Fundraising campaigns
* Food distributions and donations
* Behind\-the\-scenes operations
* Educational and community\-resource information • Impact stories and testimonials

**CONTENT CREATION \& STORYTELLING** 

Create high\-quality digital content including photographs, short\-form videos, reels, interviews, graphics, stories, and written posts.

Capture authentic stories demonstrating how Refuge Outreach Services is making a difference in the community.

Develop compelling storytelling around the people, volunteers, donors, businesses, churches, foundations, and community organizations participating in the mission.

Ensure that all storytelling involving individuals receiving services is handled with dignity, appropriate permission, sensitivity, and respect.

Never exploit hardship, poverty, or personal circumstances for social media engagement or fundraising.

**BRAND MANAGEMENT** 

Maintain consistent branding across all digital platforms. Ensure appropriate use of:

* Refuge Outreach Services identity
* Harvest of Hope Market identity
* Harvest of Hope Thrift Store identity
* Organizational logos
* Approved fonts and visual standards
* Photography and video
* Organizational messaging

Maintain consistent use of the core message: **“Transforming Charity into Dignity.”** 

Help establish a recognizable voice for the organization that is hopeful, professional, compassionate, community centered, and inspiring.

**COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT** 

Monitor social media accounts and respond appropriately to comments, messages, questions, and community inquiries.

Build relationships with followers, volunteers, donors, businesses, churches, nonprofit organizations, neighborhood organizations, and community partners.

Identify opportunities to collaborate with community organizations and local influencers who align with the mission of Refuge Outreach Services.

**FUNDRAISING \& DONOR ENGAGEMENT**

Work with the Executive Director and fundraising team to develop digital campaigns supporting fundraising initiatives.

Create social media content surrounding:

* Giving campaigns
* Special fundraising events
* Capital campaigns
* Giving Tuesday
* Year\-end giving
* Monthly giving
* Sponsorship opportunities
* Corporate partnerships
* Food and product donation drives
* Volunteer campaigns

Develop appropriate calls to action that encourage followers to **Give, Volunteer, Donate, Shop, Partner, and Share.** 

**HARVEST OF HOPE THRIFT STORE MARKETING** 

Develop a strong digital presence for the Harvest of Hope Thrift Store as an earned\-revenue component supporting the charitable mission.

Regularly feature interesting merchandise, new arrivals, special sales, seasonal items, donation opportunities, and customer experiences.

Communicate clearly how shopping and donating merchandise to the Thrift Store helps support the work of Harvest of Hope Market and Refuge Outreach Services.

**VIDEO \& SHORT\-FORM CONTENT** 

Develop regular short\-form video content for Instagram Reels, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and similar platforms.

Content may include volunteer spotlights, donor recognition, Market tours, Thrift Store finds, community partnerships, behind\-the\-scenes operations, event recaps, interviews, and impact stories.

Develop longer\-form video content when appropriate for YouTube, donor presentations, fundraising campaigns, and organizational storytelling.

**WEBSITE \& DIGITAL COMMUNICATIONS** 

Coordinate social media content with the organization’s website and broader communications strategy.

Assist with website updates, digital newsletters, email campaigns, event promotions, and online fundraising communications as assigned.

**CONTENT CALENDAR** 

Maintain a minimum **30\-day rolling content calendar**.

The calendar should identify planned posts, campaigns, events, video production, photography needs, fundraising initiatives, volunteer recruitment, community stories, and organizational announcements.

**ANALYTICS \& PERFORMANCE** 

Monitor social media performance and provide a simple monthly report to leadership.

**SAN MATEO COUNTY EVENT CENTER**


**BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT COORDINATOR \~ FULL\-TIME**

 **About the San Mateo County Event Center**

The San Mateo County Event Center is a public assembly facility that hosts a wide variety of events, produces the San Mateo County Fair, and operates the Jockey Club, a satellite wagering facility for horseracing. Reporting to the Director of Sales and Marketing, the Business Development Coordinator plays a key role in driving year\-round event sales and supporting the continued growth of the Event Center’s event business.

  


**Role**



The Business Development Coordinator manages sales opportunities and client relationships from initial inquiry through the contracting process, working with a diverse portfolio of large\- and small\-scale events, including consumer and public shows, trade shows, meetings, corporate events, and other special events. Responsibilities include developing new business, preparing proposals and quotes, negotiating contract terms, preparing contract documents for review and approval, conducting site tours, maintaining accurate sales records and forecasts, and coordinating with internal departments to ensure event requirements and venue policies are clearly communicated. The position requires a strong understanding of venue sales and event operations, with experience in the events, tourism, and hospitality industries providing an important foundation for identifying client needs, developing event opportunities, and building long\-term client relationships.

 **Essential Functions/Responsibilities**


*Essential and other important responsibilities and duties may include, but are not limited to the following:*

**Sales**


* Sales Process Management: Prepare proposals, negotiate contracts, and close sales, often managing the entire sales cycle.
* Serve as the point of contact for incoming sales inquiries, responding promptly to maximize revenue by providing information on availability, pricing, venue capacity, and SMCEC policies.
* Utilize event management software and maintain the calendar of all incoming sales opportunities and bookings.
* Lead Generation \& Sales: Proactively identify, qualify, and pursue new business opportunities through outbound calls, email outreach, networking, industry events, and other sales activities to generate new business and increase year\-round event bookings.
* Ensure clear internal communication by providing detailed event summaries to Event Coordinators and other departments.
* Collaborate with marketing to develop sales promotions and support initiatives that drive event bookings and enhance client engagement.
* Customer Relationship Management: Maintain relationships with existing clients to encourage repeat business and account growth.
* Attend local industry mixers and town hall meetings to network and promote SMCEC services.
* Responsible for various tasks as assigned during the annual San Mateo County Fair and other property\-wide events.


**Sales Administration**

* Prepare contracts and related sales documents for review and approval prior to issuance, ensuring all documents are accurate and comply with established venue policies and procedures; coordinate with Accounting and Event Coordinators to support accurate invoicing and a seamless client experience.
	+ Inclement Weather Shelter Invoicing: Process invoices for each Inclement Weather Shelter activation and any post\-activation documentation for billing.
* Reporting \& Forecasting: Maintain detailed up\-to\-date records of activities, pipelines, and revenue.
* Generate detailed lead tracking reports, pricing proposals, and contract documents to close sales opportunities.
* Assist with the development, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of CRM processes and systems.
* Perform additional duties as assigned.

  


**Qualifications**

  


**Required**


* Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in event sales, venue sales, hospitality sales, or a related field, including experience preparing proposals, negotiating contracts, and closing sales for small\- to large\-scale events.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple sales opportunities and client relationships through various stages of the sales cycle.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact professionally, courteously, and tactfully with clients, colleagues, vendors, and community partners.
* Strong organizational, time\-management, and follow\-up skills with excellent attention to detail.

**Who We Are:**


Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited, and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.


Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities, have served over 100 million meals, and continue to grow rapidly. Powered by technology and a network of 1,500\+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. At Fooda, we believe a workplace food program should be something employees love and look forward to every day.

**About Snapp**

Snapp is building AI for sports fans.

Our product helps fans follow their teams, manage fantasy leagues, track bets, get real\-time scores and analysis, and ask questions about sports through AI.

We're looking for a **Social Media \& Content Coordinator** who lives and breathes sports, social media, and internet culture.

This is a hands\-on, early\-career role supporting Snapp's social and content efforts across **organic social, paid social creative, and UGC creators**.

You won't be expected to own Snapp's entire social strategy. You'll work closely with our team to help execute it: creating and sourcing content, engaging with sports fans, developing creative for social ads, finding great UGC creators, and helping us produce more content, faster.

If you've grown a social following of your own, even better.

**What You'll Do**

**Support Organic Social**

You'll help keep Snapp active, relevant, and engaged across X, Instagram, TikTok, and other social platforms. You'll:

* Help create and publish daily organic content
* Monitor sports news, fantasy, betting, and trending conversations for content opportunities
* Help create memes, graphics, clips, short\-form videos, and social\-native posts
* Engage with fans through replies, comments, and quote posts
* Identify conversations and trending moments Snapp should participate in

A big part of this role is understanding **what people actually want to engage with**, not just filling a content calendar.

You'll work alongside our growth team to help develop and source creative for Meta, TikTok, and other paid channels. You'll:

* Identify organic content and concepts that could translate into strong ads
* Brainstorm hooks, creative concepts, and new angles
* Source videos, clips, screenshots, and other creative assets
* Help create variations of winning ads and concepts
* Organize our paid creative library and pipeline
* Monitor competitor ads and emerging creative trends
* Help identify why certain creative is performing
* Turn winning ideas into additional creative variations

You don't need to be an experienced media buyer. We're looking for someone who understands **content and creative** and is excited to learn how that translates into paid growth.

**Find \& Curate UGC Creators**

* Find sports, fantasy, betting, and lifestyle creators who fit the Snapp brand

We're looking for someone with a good eye for **potential**, not just someone who looks at follower counts.

**Drive Engagement**

We want Snapp to feel like part of the sports conversation, not a brand talking at people. You'll help:

* Reply to sports fans, creators, teams, and other accounts
* Jump into relevant conversations in real time
* Write replies that are funny, useful, or interesting

* Identify opportunities to turn engagement into new followers and users
* Experiment with different ways to increase comments, shares, and conversation

You should understand that sometimes **a great reply can be more valuable than the original post.**

We're looking for someone who:

* Is genuinely interested in sports
* Has a strong understanding of social media and internet culture
* Understands how sports fans communicate online
* Has strong instincts around what content will get attention
* Writes great captions, hooks, replies, and short\-form copy
* Is comfortable engaging with people online
* Understands TikTok, Instagram, X, and short\-form video
* Can identify good creators and content quickly
* Is highly organized and able to manage multiple projects at once
* Is comfortable moving quickly and testing lots of ideas

* Is interested in learning both organic and paid social

You do **not** need years of professional social media experience.

We're much more interested in whether you understand the internet and know how to create content people actually want to consume.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Title:** Account Manager  

**Classification:** Full Time – Hourly


**Pay Range:** $22\-$28

**Location:** Redwood City, Ca  

**Reports To:** Sales Manager  

  

**About the Company:**  

  

For 100 years and four generations of Hayward family leadership, Hayward Lumber has been committed to meeting and exceeding the needs of builders. Beyond full\-service lumberyards, we offer window, door and cabinet design centers, pro\-oriented hardware stores, and innovative building solutions designed to save time and money. Hayward Lumber is a family\-oriented company that treats every employee as such. Our average tenure companywide is over 10 years and we pride ourselves in creating an environment in which you can learn, grow, and prosper. Hayward Lumber provides a competitive compensation structure, as well as a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401K, and paid time off including vacation, holiday, and sick leave. Learn more at www.haywardlumber.com  

  

**Mission:**  

  

Hayward will be the most dependable supplier of products, services and solutions to the construction market, as it has been since 1919\.  

  

**Position Overview:**


We are seeking a motivated and results\-driven Account Manager to join our dynamic team. This role is pivotal in managing and growing a portfolio of existing accounts while building strong relationships with new and existing customers. This role is required to support all Hayward customers regardless of account assignment. The Account Manager will work closely with clients to understand their needs, deliver tailored solutions, and drive revenue growth. The Account Manager will also be tasked to support members of the outside selling team.

**Responsibilities:**

* Manage and grow sales and margin with a designated portfolio of accounts, ensuring client satisfaction and retention.
* Proactively manage and maintain accurate sales team quote pipeline and order pipeline in BisTrack.
* Support all Hayward customers regardless of account assignment.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, addressing inquiries and resolving issues promptly.
* Identify opportunities to expand business within the assigned accounts by understanding customer needs and offering relevant solutions.
* Proactively pursue cross\-selling and upselling opportunities to meet sales targets.
* Develop and maintain strong, long\-term relationships with clients.
* Conduct regular account reviews and site visits to understand customer operations and challenges.
* Collaborate with internal teams to develop account strategies and implement solutions tailored to customer goals.
* Stay informed about industry trends, market conditions, and competitor activities to provide valuable insights to clients.
* Track account performance and maintain accurate records in the ERP system including both orders and quotes.
* Prepare and deliver account performance reports, including forecasts and progress updates.
* From time to time the Account Manager will have the added duty of actively following up on outstanding payments if customer falls out of collection terms and the collection team unable to collect balances due.

**Qualifications:**

* Proven experience in account management, sales, or a related field, preferably within the lumber or building materials industry.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build and nurture relationships.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities effectively.
* Results\-oriented mindset with a demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales targets.
* Proficiency in CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Valid driver’s license and ability to travel to client sites as needed.
* Knowledge of lumber, building materials, or construction industry practices.
* Experience with market analysis and strategic account planning.

  

**We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.**  

  

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Hayward Lumber will recruit and select applicants for employment solely on the basis of their qualifications. Our Practices and Procedures, including those relating to wages, benefits, transfers, promotions, terminations and self\-development opportunities, will be administered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation and gender identity, age, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status and all other classes protected by the Federal and State Government. **Drug Free Employer.**

jobs.description:
**The application window is expected to close on:** 10/30/2026This role requires a hybrid schedule of two in\-office days per week at either the San Francisco or San Jose office, however, at least one in\-office day every two weeks must be spent at the San Jose office for sprint planning.
  
  

Meet the Team 
  
  

Cisco ThousandEyes is a Digital Experience Assurance platform that empowers organizations to deliver flawless digital experiences across every network – even the ones they don’t own. Powered by AI and an unmatched set of cloud, internet and enterprise network telemetry data, ThousandEyes enables IT teams to proactively detect, diagnose, and remediate issues – before they impact end\-user experiences.
  
  

ThousandEyes is deeply integrated across the entire Cisco technology portfolio and beyond, helping customers deploy at scale while also delivering AI\-powered assurance insights within Cisco’s leading Networking, Security, Collaboration, and Observability portfolios.
  
  

The Account Management team builds the foundational services that manage customer identities, access, entitlements, and contracts across Cisco ThousandEyes. Our work supports secure, reliable customer and internal experiences while providing a platform that other engineering teams can build on. We are a collaborative, technically ambitious team that values ownership, pragmatic delivery, and proactive improvements to architecture, reliability, and developer productivity.
  
  

Your Impact 
  
  

As a Lead Software Engineer, you will set the technical direction for the Account Management Platform and guide architecture across secure, scalable microservices, high\-throughput APIs, and customer\-facing web applications. Identify gaps in architecture and operations, then initiate and lead improvements that strengthen reliability, security, scalability, cost efficiency, and developer productivity. Lead high\-impact initiatives such as web application migrations, API and workflow modernization, and asynchronous service decoupling. Partner with engineering, product, security, customer success, and other stakeholders to align priorities, communicate complex decisions, and deliver results across organizational boundaries. Mentor software engineers and raise engineering standards so the team can deliver dependable platform capabilities and sustain long\-term technical progress.
  
 
  
  

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelors \+ 8 years of software engineering experience, or Masters \+ 6 years of software engineering experience, or PhD \+ 3 years of software engineering experience
* Experience designing, deploying, and maintaining solutions using Java, Kotlin, or Scala.
* Experience designing and operating distributed systems that integrate with identity and access management solutions, including microservices and APIs.
* Experience leading cross\-functional technical initiatives, software and system architecture design, and mentorship of software engineers.
* Experience delivering production software in an Agile/Scrum framework.


 
  
  

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience with IAM concepts, including authentication, authorization, single sign\-on, role\-based access control, and identity lifecycle management.
* Experience with IAM protocols and standards: OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, and SCIM.
* Experience defining technical roadmaps involving cloud\-native architectures, observability, automated testing, continuous delivery, and production operations.


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.description:

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Sunnyvale, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in a customer\-facing role working with stakeholders, driving customer technical implementations or transformation programs.
* Experience supporting customers in cloud operations (e.g., launch or capacity planning, product release management), cloud technical support, cloud escalation management, or cloud consulting.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* MBA or Master’s degree in a management, technical, or engineering field.
* Experience translating business requirements into technological solutions.
* Experience in application or workload migration to public cloud providers.
* Experience collaborating with teams, groups, business units, channel partners, systems integrators, and third\-party developers to deliver high\-impact solutions.
* Understanding of IT operations, database systems, networking, IT security, application development, service architecture, cloud\-native application development, hosted services, storage systems, or content delivery networks.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, problem\-solving, and client management skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will help customers successfully adopt Google Cloud products. You will lead the successful adoption of Google Cloud at organizations, guiding them through the strategic and technical facets of their Google Cloud transformation journey. You'll manage the successful delivery of Cloud Consulting engagements to drive customer adoption of Google Cloud services. In this role, you will regularly engage with various stakeholder groups, including leadership of enterprises and a cross\-functional and geographically dispersed team.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $140000 \- $204000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Accelerate customer adoption of Google Cloud by leading the implementation journey. Provide technical guidance and manage timelines, milestones, migration goal and business transformation strategies.
* Advocate for customer needs in order to overcome adoption blockers and drive new feature development. Lead across multiple work streams and teams to maintain customer momentum.
* Develop relationships with stakeholders to understand customer’s business, develop strategic roadmaps, and lead quarterly business reviews and executive sessions to better understand business and technical needs.
* Plan for customer events and launches, partnering with Support, Engineers, and Site Reliability Engineers to ensure customer success, and work with customers and Support to guide issues/escalations to resolution.
* Develop best practices and assets based on learnings from customer engagements to support initiatives to scale through partners and accelerate Google Cloud adoption.

jobs.title: Park Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
The Operations Specialist supports the day\-to\-day operation of Children’s Fairyland including Rides \& Admissions and Retail and ensures safety standards are maintained throughout the park. The position ensures all guests enjoy a fun, safe and memorable experience by training and supporting Park Ambassadors to succeed in their roles. Reporting to the Park Operations Manager, responsibilities include working closely with other departments and vendors, acting as a key responder for escalated park issues, and end of day cash handling.


**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**
----------------------------------------


### **Rides \& Admissions**


* Ensure Rides, Admissions and Gatekeeper positions are appropriately staffed to meet operational needs.
* Act as a subject matter expert in CFL safety procedures and regulations
* Monitor the performance of Ride Operators including adherence to all safety procedures and regulations, daily cleaning, managing height requirements;
* Monitor the performance of Admissions Staff and ensures cash handling and park policies are followed;
* Troubleshoot and resolve problems by contacting the appropriate departments and/or vendors as needed for resolution
* Collect daily ride sheets and report any ride issues to Park Operations Manager
* Ensure staff and guests comply with CFL park policies and regulations
* Manage end\-of\-day cash handling at various locations throughout the park

### **Day to Day Operations Support**


* Daily cash handling and Point\-of\-Sale issues and adjusting staff to operational needs. Cash handling responsibilities include preparing bank deposits, preparing change banks and collecting funds from donation boxes around the park.
* Regular daily observation of ride operations and guest service.
* Conduct frequent show walks to monitor the cleanliness of the park and employee areas.
* Administrative duties include running reports, documenting accidents, maintaining inventory, maintaining accurate records of daily ride sheets, updating daily attendance, and submitting the daily EOD report to Senior Leadership.
* Administer first aid and CPR in emergency situations
* Report safety and maintenance issues to Facilities Department
* Assist in the sweeping and clearing the park of guests
* Support special event production
* Support the MOD (Manager on Duty) to oversee the park as needed
* Scheduling of Park Ambassadors personnel to ensure all areas are adequately covered

### **Customer Service**


* Respond to customer issues including providing answers to guest inquiries, addressing guest concerns, issuing refunds and rainchecks
* Walk the park and monitor guests and staff
* Act as a lead and make decisions for customer service escalation

### **Supervision**


* Oversee all functions of Park Ambassadors.
* Support Park Ambassador Lead with daily operations
* Provide coverage to Park Ambassador Lead during scheduled rest periods
* Coordinate staff training including New Hire Orientation, ride operator training and cross training.
* Monitor park ambassador performance, coach and counsel staff
* Document performance issues and coordinate additional training as needed.
* Communicate all issues to the Park Operations Manager.
* Assist in handling staff shortages, recruiting and hiring.
* Schedule, train, and monitor the performance of Park Ambassadors;
* Partner with Retail Sales Manager to cross\-training Park Ambassadors
* Contribute to Daily Lineup Notes and Weekly Staff Guide
* Other duties as assigned

**Knowledge Skills \& Abilities**
---------------------------------


* Minimum 2 years’ experience leading a team of ten (10\) people or more in a busy, customer service based environment. Experience in an amusement park, museum or similar hospitality environment is preferred.
* Associate’s Degree or equivalent preferred
* Excellent interpersonal skills
* Proven ability to work in a multi\-faceted, fast paced, customer\-facing environment
* Intermediate level computer skills with working knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel and Google Workspace application suite

* Ability to track and maintain accurate records on multiple items and meet deadlines

* People\-orientation\- able to interact effectively, politely, and productively with all types of people from all types of backgrounds and experience and in all types of situations. Comfortable working with non\-English speaking and culturally diverse stakeholders
* Professional maturity to manage composure during stressful interactions
* Energetic, diplomatic, adaptable and with a good sense of humor.
* Passionate about the mission, vision, and goals of Fairyland and possess an understanding of how this position contributes to the organization’s success.
* Strong work ethic with an orientation toward constant innovation and process improvement.
* Impeccable integrity and honesty

jobs.title: Customer Success
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

  

Proofpoint is a global leader in human\- and agent\-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple: safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.

**How We Work:**


At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values:

**Bold** in how we dream and innovate

**Responsive** to feedback, challenges and opportunities

**Accountable** for results and best in class outcomes

**Visionary** in future focused problem\-solving

**Exceptional** in execution and impact

**Corporate Overview**  

Proofpoint is a leading cybersecurity company protecting organizations’ greatest assets and biggest risks: vulnerabilities in people. With an integrated suite of cloud\-based solutions, Proofpoint helps companies around the world stop targeted threats, safeguard their data, and make their users more resilient against cyber\-attacks. Leading organizations of all sizes, including more than half of the Fortune 1000, rely on Proofpoint for people\-centric security and compliance solutions mitigating their most critical risks across email, the cloud, social media, and the web.

  

We are singularly devoted to helping our customers protect their greatest assets and biggest security risk: their people. That’s why we’re a leader in next\-generation cybersecurity. Protection Starts with People.
  

  

**Vice President, Customer Support Threat Protection**

  

**About the Company**

We are a leading cybersecurity company committed to protecting people, data, and organizations from today's most advanced threats. Our mission is to help customers operate securely and confidently through innovative cloud\-based security solutions, world\-class services, and an unwavering focus on customer success.  



  

**Position Summary**


The Vice President of Threat Protection Customer Support is responsible for defining and executing the global customer support strategy for a high\-growth cybersecurity organization. This executive leader will drive customer satisfaction, operational excellence, technical support innovation, and business scalability across a worldwide support organization.  



  

Reporting to the VP, Global Customer Support \& Operations, the VP of Threat Protection Customer Support will lead a global team responsible for delivering exceptional support experiences through a combination of technical expertise, customer advocacy, AI\-powered service delivery, and operational rigor.  



  

This role serves as a key member of the Customer Success leadership team and acts as the voice of the customer across Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Security Operations, and Executive Leadership.  



  

**Key Responsibilities:**




**Strategic Leadership**

* Define and execute a multi\-year vision and roadmap for global customer support.
* Develop support strategies that improve customer retention, product adoption, and overall customer experience.
* Drive transformation initiatives leveraging AI, automation, self\-service, and predictive support capabilities.
* Build scalable operating models that support company growth, acquisitions, and new product introductions.

  

**Customer Experience \& Advocacy**


* Champion customer\-centric decision\-making across the organization.
* Establish programs to proactively identify customer risk, reduce friction, and improve business outcomes.
* Monitor and improve customer satisfaction metrics, including CSAT, NPS, retention, and support experience measures.
* Represent customer feedback and support trends for executive leadership and product teams.
* Establish differentiated support offerings aligned to customer segments and service levels. Global Support Operations
* Lead a worldwide 24x7 technical support organization utilizing follow\-the\-sun support models.
* Drive accountability for service level agreements, response times, resolution times, backlog management, and escalation handling.
* Establish operational frameworks, support processes, and governance mechanisms to ensure consistent service delivery globally.
* Optimize organizational structure, workforce planning, and capacity management.
* Manage support budgets while balancing customer experience and operational efficiency.

**Technical Excellence \& Innov**ation


* Drive adoption of AI, analytics, automation, and knowledge management capabilities to improve support outcomes.
* Ensure support teams maintain deep expertise in cybersecurity technologies, cloud services, integrations, and emerging threats.
* Establish proactive support capabilities using telemetry, monitoring, and predictive analytics.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on reducing customer effort and accelerating issue resolution. Cross\-Functional Leadership
* Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Security Operations, Customer Success, and Professional Services to improve customer outcomes.
* Create closed\-loop processes that translate customer issues, feature requests, and support data into product enhancements.
* Collaborate with Sales and Customer Success leadership on retention, expansion, renewals, and executive customer engagements. Talent \& Organizational Development

• Recruit, develop, and retain world\-class support leaders and technical talent. • Build leadership pipelines and succession plans for critical roles.


* Foster a high\-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration and inclusion.

  

**Why Proofpoint**  

Protecting people is at the heart of our award\-winning lineup of cybersecurity solutions,

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for **making a difference for small business** in your community? Are you looking for a career with **unlimited income potential**? Is **company culture** important to you? Or maybe you have been thinking about switching career paths and moving into sales?

**NFIB was chosen as a Glassdoor Top 50 Best Places to Work.** Whether you have some sales experience or are new to sales, NFIB will set you up for success with best\-in\-class training. **A career with NFIB provides a flexible work/life balance while still maintaining full\-time effort in the field.**  

Think of this as a hybrid work environment where you're not tied to an office location. Instead, your office is the work area you serve. Approximately 95% of your time will be spent in the field within your local market, meeting face\-to\-face with small business owners and growing NFIB membership.


***What’s in it for you:**** **W\-2 with full benefits** (medical, dental, vision, matching 401k, and more) \- **eligible after 30 days**
* **Up to 13 weeks** (1,000/wk) **performance\-based training pay** (or commission, whichever is greater)
* **Production\-based weekly commissions, monthly \& quarterly bonuses**
* **Yearly average compensation: $80,000 \- $200,000**
* **40%** of our sales force **earns 6\-figures** with the **top 10%** earning **over 200k**
* **UNCAPPED earning potential** (Straight Commission)
* **Monthly Mileage reimbursement**

***Who we are*****:**

**NFIB is the most trusted advocate for free enterprise**, promoting and protecting the rights of any individual to own, operate, and grow their business. **NFIB's advocacy has a profound impact on shaping public policies** by influencing


decision\-makers, raising awareness, and mobilizing public support. NFIB membership is the mechanism for small business owners to actively contribute to the development of policies that align with their values and concerns. **NFIB has been fighting for independent business owners** for over 80 years. We are the **Voice of Small Business** in Washington, D.C., and in all 50 state capitals. **NFIB is a nonprofit, nonpartisan, and member driven** organization.

  

We educate small business owners through in\-person prospecting (no appointment setting) using NFIB's success\-proven verbatim sales presentation. This is a hunter/closer sales position using an assumptive one\-call close with no account management after the sale. ***What you will be responsible for:**** Meeting small business owners through in\-person prospecting (no appointment setting)
* Memorizing and utilizing NFIB’s proven 5\-minute verbatim sales presentation
* Building quick rapport and delivering an engaging presentation
* Overcoming objections and closing the sale

Processing payment on the spot  
* 

  

***Requirements to win in this role:**** Strong work ethic
* Grit and relentless perseverance
* Self\-starter and ability to stick with a structured, proven sales model
* Desire for ongoing learning
* Quick\-witted, adaptable, and strategic
* Passion for the success of small business
* Sales experience **AND/OR** transferable skills
* Intermediate technical skills


A career with NFIB means being part of a team of truly extraordinary people working to promote and protect small business. You will be impacting your community while taking advantage of our competitive compensation, ongoing training, incentives, and generous benefits package. **Learn more about the NFIB’s culture here:** www.nfib.com/careers


Equal Opportunity Employer \- \#2026Oct

jobs.title: Entry Level Sales Representative - Spanish Required
jobs.description:
We are hiring an Entry Level Sales Representative to join our growing sales team. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working with people, communicating with customers, and developing professional sales skills. As an Entry Level Sales Representative, you will work directly with customers to explain AT\&T products and services, answer questions, and help customers find solutions that fit their needs.

You will receive training on AT\&T wireless products, plans, devices, and services. The Entry Level Sales Representative role provides hands\-on experience in sales, customer service, communication, and relationship building. Bilingual candidates who are comfortable communicating in both English and Spanish are encouraged to apply.

**Entry Level Sales Representative Responsibilities**

* Speak with customers in person to understand their needs and recommend appropriate AT\&T products and services.
* Explain wireless plans, devices, features, and service options clearly and accurately.
* Provide customer service in both English and Spanish when needed.
* Answer customer questions and address concerns throughout the sales process.
* Build positive relationships with customers through professional and effective communication.
* Assist customers with selecting products and services that fit their individual needs.
* Maintain accurate customer information, leads, and follow\-up records.
* Follow up with customers to answer questions and provide additional assistance.
* Represent AT\&T professionally during all customer interactions.
* Work toward Entry Level Sales Representative goals while maintaining a positive customer experience.

**Entry Level Sales Representative Qualifications**

* Bilingual in English and Spanish required.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable speaking with customers in a face\-to\-face environment.
* Motivated, dependable, and willing to learn.
* Ability to work in a goal\-oriented sales environment.
* Strong organization and follow\-up skills.
* Previous sales or customer service experience is helpful but not required.
* Ability to learn product information and communicate it clearly to customers.

This Entry Level Sales Representative position offers an opportunity to gain hands\-on sales experience while developing valuable communication, customer service, and professional skills.

Pay: $64,000\.00 \- $72,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Professional development assistance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sales Representative - Walnut Creek, CA
jobs.description:
**About Zedcor Inc.**



Zedcor Inc. (TSX\-V:ZDC) is disrupting the traditional physical security industry through its proprietary MobileyeZ™ security towers by providing turnkey and customized mobile surveillance and live monitoring solutions to blue\-chip customers across North America. The Company continues to expand its established platform of over 1,200 MobileyeZ™ towers in Canada and the United States, with emphasis on industry leading service levels, data\-supported efficiency outcomes, and continued innovation. Zedcor services the Canadian market through equipment and service centers currently located in British Columbia, Alberta, Manitoba, and Ontario. The Company continues to advance its U.S. expansion which now has the capacity to service markets throughout the Midwest with locations throughout Texas Colorado, Arizona, Nevada and Florida.



For more information, check out www.zedcor.com.

 **Position Overview**



Zedcor is looking to add to our existing sales organization in the **Walnut Creek, CA** area. **We are looking to hire Sales Representative**. Sales Representatives are a crucial position as we continue to execute our growth strategy throughout the state of California. This position is perfect for you if you have excellent interpersonal skills, are confident, articulate, ambitious, adaptable and are not scared to share your ideas to push the company forward. In exchange for your talents, we offer an attractive base salary, a company vehicle, great benefits, the opportunity to work as part of a growing team and most importantly, an industry leading uncapped commission plan. This role is responsible for securing new customers and successfully managing the sales pipeline required to achieve a plan.

 **Key Responsibilities**


* You have a large existing network in, but not limited to, the construction, Petrochemical, renewable, Energy and infrastructure sectors.
* Travel to client locations within a designated territory to meet with clients, educate clients on Zedcor services and complete sales contracts.
* Follow up on sales leads generated through website, lead generation tools, networking, phone calls or other sources.
* Prospect potential customers use various direct methods such as cold\-calling, face to face meetings, and indirect methods such as B2B sales.
* Communicate proactively with all customers quarterly, to strengthen and expand relationships.
* Complete weekly sales reports, ensuring KPI’s are met or exceeded.
* Gather market data on pricing, client needs, client size, etc.
* Adhere to processes and contract terms as determined by management.
* Develop an intimate knowledge of product offerings and become an expert on providing solutions to solve client problems.
* Build, develop and maintain profitable business partnerships and relationships which promote long\-term success for both client and Zedcor.
* Attend trade shows/training sessions when necessary to learn about new products and grow knowledge of product offerings.
* Establish and maintain a high level of customer satisfaction.
* Work with management to develop and monitor sales strategy and KPIs.
* Complete CRM daily inputting to have a clear pipeline of new business.
* Perform other duties as requested.

  


**Qualifications \& Requirements**


* Strong hunting skills with a focus on building new business.
* Ability to present in large group settings.
* 3\+ years of professional sales experience in business development or B2B sales.
* Prior outside sales in equipment rental solutions to multiple industries considered an asset.
* Knowledge of the security industry, and specifically industrial camera solutions, is beneficial but willing to train the right candidate.
* Excellent professional written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to build strong relationships with customers, problem solve and provide solutions.
* Strong negotiation skills
* Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office Suite including Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook
* Self\-Starter, driven and motivated to work independently with little oversight.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced competitive environment that is results\-driven.
* Proven track record in prospecting, qualifying, and closing accounts over the phone and in person.
* Successful relationship building \- external and internal.
* Sound decision making and strategic thinking.
* Experience in CRM software
* Strong ability to work independently to efficiently manage the assigned territory and accounts.
* Candidate must be willing to travel in assigned territory– approximately 90% of your time will be outside of the office within your territory being home almost every night, some overnight travel will be required on a case\-by\-case basis.
* Class C driver’s license with clean drivers abstract required.
* Full Background check required.
* **Must be based in Walnut Creek, CA**.

  


**Why Join Zedcor?**



At Zedcor, you won’t just maintain systems, you’ll help build and shape the future of security technology. We provide the tools, mentorship, and the environment to help you thrive and grow in your career. If you’re looking to take your skills to the next level, Zedcor offers a dynamic and rewarding opportunity.

  

Zedcor Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and maintains the policy of recruiting and retaining the best\-qualified personnel who demonstrate the ability to perform competently and work well with others. It is the policy of Zedcor to provide equal employment opportunity regardless of race (including traits historically or culturally associated with race, such as hair texture and protective hairstyles), religion (including religious dress and religious grooming), color, age (40 and over), genetic information, disability (mental and physical), medical condition (as defined under state law), national origin (including language use restrictions and possession of a driver’s license issued under section 12801\.9 of the California Vehicle Code), ancestry

**Position:**  

Inside Sales Representative II \- IPE
  
  

**Job Description:**  

Arrow Electronics is a global provider of products, services, and solutions to industrial and commercial users of electronic components and enterprise computing solutions. Arrow Electronics guides innovation forward for over 220,000 leading technology manufacturers and service providers. With 2025 sales of $30\.9 billion, Arrow develops technology solutions that improve business and daily life. The company maintains 228 locations worldwide with over 85 countries served.
  
  

Arrow brings technology solutions to a breadth of markets, including telecommunications, information systems, transportation, medical, industrial, and consumer electronics. Arrow provides specialized services and expertise across the entire product lifecycle. Arrow does this by connecting customers to the right technology at the right place, time, and price. Arrow provides extraordinary value to customers and suppliers \- the best technology companies in the world \- and connects them through the companys industry\-leading services.
  
  

As an IPE Inside Sales Representative, you will be selling Arrow’s line card of passive, electromechanical, and connector products, and be the daily contact for customers and suppliers.
  
  

**What You’ll Be Doing:**  

* Managing the overall account relationship by providing strategic service and support to the assigned customer base. Maximize margins, gain market share, and drive value\-added solution selling.
* Working with internal and external resources, provide customer service, often facilitating work of others in quoting, fulfilling demand, ensuring on\-time delivery of orders, providing engineering support, and troubleshooting other customer problems.
* Functioning as key liaison between suppliers and customers to build and establish long\-term business partnerships for Arrow.
* Responsible for Sales Excellence through the development and management of customer strategy in assigned account territory.
* Sell and drive Solutions Selling within the approved account level strategy. Requires knowledge of the competitive landscape in the market and the ability to make sales decisions based on that information.
* Responsible for on\-going Sales Support activities for the Order to Invoice process. Owns the customer interface for backend Quality processes: corrective actions, Field Quality Reports. Owns and Maintains Perfect Order Index (POI) and Inventory integrity to minimize write\-offs/bill backs.
* Owns the customer interface for important Credit and Financial Information as well as coordination of all available resources and support functions.

* Strong communication, negotiating, and organization skills
* Strong customer service and sales skills.
* This role will perform work covered by International Traffic in Arms Regulations. Viable candidates for this position must be eligible for an export license or be a U.S. Person (which includes but is not limited to U.S. citizens or nationals, lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees).


**Work Arrangement:**  

* Hybrid 3 days in office in ourSan Jose branch, and the other 2 days working from home

At Arrow, we recognize that financial rewards and great benefits are important aspects of an ideal job. That’s why we offer competitive financial compensation, including various compensation plans and a solid benefits package.
  
  

* Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
* 401k, With Matching Contributions

* Health Savings Account (HSA)/Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) Options

Premier Global Links LLC is hiring a **Junior Sales Development Representative (SDR)** to help build and scale outbound sales development for an AI\-powered CAD technology company serving the manufacturing and engineering market.


This is an early\-career opportunity for a strong communicator who enjoys research, writing, outreach, and starting conversations with prospective customers. You will work closely with product and leadership teams to identify target accounts, develop personalized messaging, and create qualified sales opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Research and build target account lists across manufacturing, machine shops, and hardware companies.

* Conduct outbound prospecting and initiate conversations with potential customers.

These customers are expanding, evolving, and navigating increasingly complex technology decisions, requiring a consultative seller who can build trust, uncover business needs, and position solutions that create measurable value. jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
Hybrid  

  

JOB PURPOSE:
  

Conduct clinical research and work independently on progressively more complex projects/assignments. Independently manage significant and key aspects of a large study or all aspects of one or more small research studies.
  

  

CORE DUTIES:
  

Oversee subject recruitment and study enrollment goals. Determine effective strategies for promoting/recruiting research participants and retaining participants in long\-term clinical trials.
  

Oversee data management for research projects. Develop and manage systems to organize, collect, report, and monitor data collection. Extract, analyze, and interpret data.
  

Develop project schedules, targets, measurements, and accountabilities, as assigned. Lead team meetings and prepare/approve minutes.
  

Formally supervise, train, and/or mentor new staff or students, as assigned, potentially including hiring, preparing or assisting with the preparation of performance evaluations, and performing related duties, in addition to instruction on project work.
  

Audit operations, including laboratory procedures, to ensure compliance with applicable regulations; provide leadership in identifying and implementing corrective actions/processes. Monitor Institutional Review Board submissions, and respond to requests and questions.
  

Collaborate with principal investigators and study sponsors, monitor and report serious adverse events, and resolve study queries.
  

Provide leadership in determining, recommending, and implementing improvements to policies/processes; define best practices.
  

Develop study budget with staff and principal investigator, identifying standard of care versus study procedures. Track patient and study specific milestones, and invoice sponsors according to study contract.
  

Ensure regulatory compliance. Regularly inspect study document to ensure ongoing regulatory compliance.
  

Work with principal investigator to ensure Investigational New Drug applications are submitted to the FDA when applicable. Ensure Institutional Review Board renewals are completed.
  

  

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:
  

  

Education \& Experience:
  

Bachelor's degree in a related field and two years of experience in clinical research, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  

  

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
  

Strong interpersonal skills.
  

Proficiency in Microsoft Office and database applications.
  

Experience with research protocols and regulatory or governing bodies, which include HIPAA and FDA regulations, Institutional Review Board requirements, and Good Clinical Practices.
  

Knowledge of medical terminology.
  

  

Required experience:
  

2\+ years
  

  

Top 3 requirements to hire:
  

Oncology treatment trials, Phase I, EPIC and onsite at a health institution (not looking for CRO or Pharma CRA experience)
  

  

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
  

Frequently stand, walk, twist, bend, stoop, squat and use fine light/fine grasping.
  

Occasionally sit, reach above shoulders, perform desk based computer tasks, use a telephone and write by hand, lift, carry, push, and pull objects that weigh up to 40 pounds.
  

Rarely kneel, crawl, climb ladders, grasp forcefully, sort and file paperwork or parts, rarely lift, carry, push, and pull objects that weigh 40 pounds or more.
  

Ability to drive day or night, if applicable.
  

  

Notes:
  

Hybrid
  

Number of hours per week: 40

jobs.description:
**OUR STORY**



From an idea in one man's garage to an essential in every man's shower, Every Man Jack was created to give men everywhere clean, effective personal care that stands up to any adventure.  

  

Born in 2007 at the base of Mt. Tam, near the great redwood forests of Northern California, Every Man Jack was founded to fill a gap in the men's care space. To remove the bravado and harsh chemicals that choked the industry, and focus instead on simple, clean products accessible to regular guys.  

  

That belief is right in our name: the phrase “Every Man Jack” traces its origins back several centuries, when it meant “everybody without exception.”  

  

Today it still means quality within reach. It stands for the man who fixes what's broken, who builds, and who welcomes the unknown. We're for the man whose routine belongs on the trail, in the surf, and under open skies. He's ready for the next story worth remembering.

jobs.title: Lead, Growth Marketing
jobs.description:
**Who we are**


We're Redis. We built the product that runs the fast apps our world runs on. (If you checked the weather, used your credit card, or looked at your flight status online today, you’re welcome.) At Redis, you’ll work with the fastest, simplest technology in the business—whether you’re building it, telling its story, or selling it to our 10,000\+ worldwide customers. We’re creating a faster world with simpler experiences. You in?

**Why would you love this job?**
--------------------------------


Redis is the platform developers trust for real\-time data—and the platform an increasing share of AI applications are built on. Now, the audience discovering and evaluating Redis is no longer exclusively human. AI agents can identify a need, decide which solution fits, review technical documentation, and create a new account within one continuous session.


The Lead, Growth Marketing owns the Redis digital surface for both agents and humans. This includes the website, SEO, answer engine optimization, generative engine optimization, conversion\-rate optimization, and the measurement system that connects discovery to pipeline, account creation, and activation.


Your central challenge is to streamline agent\-led growth: making Redis easy for agents to discover, understand, recommend, evaluate, and select while ensuring the same digital experience converts human developers and buyers.


This is a hands\-on strategic leadership role for a builder who wants to create a new kind of digital growth system at a high\-growth, pre\-IPO company. You’ll define the strategy, direct external specialists, contribute to the highest\-priority work, measure the outcomes, and continuously improve the system with data.


You should be as comfortable presenting a strategy to executives as you are opening an AI tool and building a working campaign prototype from a blank page in 30 minutes.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* **Own the Redis digital surface**. Set the strategy for how agents and humans discover, understand, evaluate, and convert across Redis’s website, documentation pathways, organic presence, and AI surfaces.
* **Lead agent\-driven growth**. Build a low\-friction journey in which an agent can identify the right Redis solution, review the relevant documentation, and create an account in a single session.
* **Own SEO, AEO, and GEO.** Establish the strategy for search engines, AI answer engines, generative search, assistants, and coding agents so Redis is accurately represented, cited, recommended, and selected.
* **Own website strategy.** Define the platform story, information architecture, page priorities, content pathways, and contextual\-conversion model. Partner with web engineering on implementation and feasibility.
* **Lead CRO and experimentation**. Maintain a rigorous testing roadmap across high\-intent pages, documentation journeys, sign\-up flows, and other critical conversion points.
* **Build the measurement system**. Connect human and agent discovery to meaningful outcomes, including visibility, citations, recommendations, documentation engagement, account creation, conversion, activation, and pipeline.
* **Turn data into action.** Use performance data to improve the strategy, prioritize the roadmap, reallocate resources, and decide what to scale, revise, or stop.
* **Direct external specialists**. Set priorities and scopes of work for contractors and an agency partner, review output, and redirect capacity as business needs change.
* **Align the digital growth engine**. Partner with content, developer relations, product, engineering, paid media, and executive leadership so Redis presents one connected path from discovery to adoption.

**What you’ll need to have**
----------------------------

* Typically 7\+ years in digital growth or GTM marketing, including meaningful experience inside high\-growth B2B SaaS, infrastructure, or AI\-adjacent companies.
* A record of building or materially improving digital growth systems where the strategy and operating model were not already fully defined.
* Deep experience owning website strategy, digital conversion, and organic growth—not simply supporting those functions.
* Experience developing integrated SEO, AEO, or GEO strategies across traditional search, generative search, AI assistants, answer engines, or coding agents.
* An understanding of how content, documentation, citations, authority, structured information, and technical foundations influence AI recommendations and technology selection.
* Experience defining measurement for emerging digital journeys, including the ability to connect leading signals to account creation, activation, pipeline, or revenue.
* Direct ownership of a CRO and experimentation program, with strong analytical and statistical judgment.
* Experience defining email and GTM\-orchestration strategy while directing specialists who handle implementation and ongoing operations.
* Demonstrated use of AI tools and agents to research, plan, build, analyze, or optimize marketing programs.
* AI\-native operating fluency: you can rapidly turn a business objective into a credible campaign, journey, or workflow prototype and then improve it with judgment and data.
* Experience directing contractors and agency\-staffed specialists, including scoping work, setting priorities, reviewing output, and reallocating capacity.
* Strong executive communication and the willingness to move between strategy and hands\-on work.

**We give back to our employees:**


Our culture is what makes Redis a fun and rewarding place to work. To support you at work and beyond, we offer all our US team members fantastic benefits and perks:

* Competitive salaries and equity grants
* Unlimited time off to promote a healthy work\-life balance
* H/D/V coverage along with 401K, FSA, and commuter benefits
* Frequent team celebrations and recreation events
* Home internet \& phone stipend

Our programs are dedicated to supporting the social and emotional learning of participants by providing choice\-based activities that empower student voices, and delivery methods that develop compassion, understanding, and kindness. A Program Coordinator (PC) in one of our afterschool programs supports and collaborates with the Program Director (PD) to facilitate daily program operations. In addition to helping implement childcare and enrichment activities serving elementary school children onsite in a NYC public school facility, every day that schools are in session, the PC will help develop and maintain relationships with essential stakeholders, including: school administration, faculty and staff; parents and families, and \- most importantly \- children.

**Role and Responsibilities**

* Support a diverse program staff of varying levels of experience and skill
* Support all aspects of onsite operations of the afterschool program
* Develop and maintain relationships with important stakeholders
* Promote the program within the school community to increase enrollment
* Ensure program safety and compliance with all SACC regulations, DOE regulations, and IF policies
* Greet students during snack time and take attendance.
* Oversee dismissal and transition of students between activities and end\-of\-day.
* Work with teachers to provide a safe environment for children.
* Work with teachers and appropriate other staff and consultants to provide individualized support to children through assessments, development, and/or implementation of individual education plans.
* Maintain open and ongoing communication with the program director, activity specialists, and other staff.
* Work with Activity Specialists and Education Specialists to prepare and implement daily activities.
* Support quality assessment and foster continual improvement
* Treat all people with compassion and kindness
