jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
As an employee of Boehringer Ingelheim, you will actively contribute to the discovery, development, and delivery of our products to our patients and customers. Our global presence provides opportunity for all employees to collaborate internationally, offering visibility and opportunity to directly contribute to the companies' success. We realize that our strength and competitive advantage lie with our people. We support our employees in several ways to foster a healthy working environment, meaningful work, mobility, networking, and work\-life balance. Our competitive compensation and benefit programs reflect Boehringer Ingelheim's high regard for our employees.


The Inside Sales Representative is responsible for generating sales and market share growth and enhance profitability with assigned veterinary clinics and customers. This role focuses on managing and expanding existing accounts as well acquiring new accounts. The position holder accomplishes this through virtual sales calls, proactive communication, and strategic planning. The incumbent is responsible for building strong relationships with all the key customer stakeholders as well as responsible for virtual Boehringer technical product and sales training of account staff.


**Duties \& Responsibilities**
------------------------------


Sales Development:


* Identifies and pursues sales opportunities virtually with accounts.
* Develops and maintains a pipeline of prospective accounts.
* Meets sales objectives and supports attainment of business unit performance objectives.
* Completes objectives including achieving sales plan while operating within specified expense budget.
  

  

Account Management and Engagement:


* Develops an excellent knowledge base of all assigned clinics, including the products they stock, their business objectives, their decision\-making processes, the key staff members, and technology footprint.
* Addresses customer inquiries, resolves issues and provides appropriate solutions to meet their needs.
* Tracks and analyzes account performance, providing insights and recommendations to improve sales outcomes.
* Within each clinic, identifies key clinic team members and builds relationships with the decision\-makers and staff, understanding their goals, challenges and needs.
* Conducts regular virtual calls with customers to nurture relationships and identify additional sales opportunities.
* Organizes, participates, and leads virtual events, webinars, and meetings to promote Boehringer's products and services.
* Keeps all business plans up to date on an ongoing basis, sharing its content with appropriate Pet and cross functional team members.
  

  

Sales Strategy:


* Analyzes account information to optimize customer calls and create annual business plan for execution.
* Executes business plan that incorporates sales strategies and tactics to achieve individual and team sales goals.
* Monitors market conditions and competitive activities for changes that impact the business and adjust business plan and sales strategies appropriately.
* Utilizes highly effective selling skills to convince customers to buy Boehringer products.
* Maintains and utilizes expert product knowledge and highly effective selling skills to influence customers to support the use of Boehringer promoted products.
* Executes brand strategies to ensure a consistent company sales and marketing message.
* Uses appropriate Boehringer sales training techniques to facilitate the sale.
  

  

Reporting and Administration:


* Utilizes CRM tools to create pre\-call plans.
* Keeps current account records concerning activities; communicates timely, accurately, and meaningfully with Management.
* Utilizes CRM tool and supporting analysis to plan activity, report, monitor samples and maintain customer records.
  

  

Market and Industry Knowledge:


* Responsible for development of market, customer, and industry knowledge along with further development of technical product knowledge is imperative.
* Ensures effective utilization and management of internal and external resources.
* Performs customer/consumer training meetings and supports convention and professional association business building opportunities.
**Requirements**
----------------


* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Minimum of two to five (2\-5\) years of relevant sales experience in a competitive selling market in an Inside Sales environment.
* Animal Health or related industry experience preferred.
* Must demonstrate an aptitude and desire to sell and gain market share.
* Ability to work with general supervision in a matrix team environment.
* General knowledge of industry practices, techniques, and standards.
* Experience presenting to various size audiences.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills (verbal and written).
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Strong learning agility.
* Proficiency in various business software applications.
* Ability to travel occasionally.
  

  

**Eligibility Requirements** :


* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without restriction.
* Must be willing to take a drug test and post\-offer physical (if required).
* Must be 18 years of age or older.

jobs.title: Young Lawyers Division - Program Specialist
jobs.description:
The American Bar Association (ABA) was founded on a commitment to advance the rule of law in the United States and beyond by providing practical resources for legal professionals, conducting law school accreditation, developing model ethics codes and more. Today, the ABA remains a member\-based organization that works to ensure access to justice for all, a fair legal process, and respect for the rule of law at home and across the globe.
  
  

The ABA is committed to service and refining the standards that guide the legal profession. ABA staff are provided multiple types of continuing education and career development opportunities. Your work will help eliminate bias, enhance diversity, and advance the rule of law throughout the US and around the world.
  
  

The ABA recognizes the value staff contribute to our success through a generous benefits package that protects their health and their financial security. The ABA’s wide array of benefit offerings include 401(k), medical, dental, vision, flexible spending accounts, health spending accounts, supplemental life and disability insurance, prepaid legal programs, and a complimentary membership to the American Bar Association, which offers additional benefits.
  
  

Flexible/hybrid work arrangements may be available for residents of CA, DC, IL, IN, MD, MI, MN, TX, VA, and WI. Residency requirements may apply. ABA employees are eligible to apply for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program (PSLF).
  
  

Job Summary/General Purpose of Job
  
* The Program Specialist is responsible for the management and implementation of programs, projects, and activities of the entity. Has oversight responsibility for the entity's program/project budgets and provides substantive support and direction to the Chairs of the projects and is responsible for the execution of the programs/projects, including, but not limited to budgeting of resources, fundraising for projects that require outside funding support, marketing of projects and activities, and oversight of meetings and special events.


Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities
  
* Manages the day\-to\-day organization and implementation of one or more programs or projects, including planning projects, overseeing budgets, and ensuring compliance with ABA policies.
* Advises member leaders on strategy and procedures, including analysis of opportunities and risks, to ensure projects move forward in a productive manner.
* Serves as principal point of contact for projects, both internally and externally. Initiates regular communications with member leaders and staff, including reporting on progress and results.
* Coordinates with other interested entities on joint projects, proactively seeking both internal and external partners. This responsibility may include solicitation and management of sponsorship revenue.
* Supervises one or more staff members, directly or indirectly, as appropriate to the project.
* Responsibilities may include recruitment, orientation, ongoing mentoring and annual performance evaluations.
* Performs other related duties as required.


Required Education, Qualifications, Experience
  
* Possession of a bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university and at least three years' experience; OR, possession of a high school diploma or GED and at least five years’ relevant professional experience.
* Intermediate level proficiency with MS Office suite.


Preferred Education, Qualifications, Experience
  
* Management and/or supervisory experience, preferably in an association or non\-profit setting to include analytical problem solving ability, and programmatic and policy development.
* Prior experience overseeing budgets and planning meetings is strongly preferred.
* Experience fundraising preferred.


Physical Requirements
  
* Typical office work environment.


Extent of Travel Required in the Job
  
* As a normal course of business, this job will typically require travel of less than 15% of the time.


**The American Bar Association is an Equal Opportunity Employer:** Disability/Veteran. In compliance with the ADA Amendments Act (ADAAA), if you have a disability and would like to request an accommodation in order to apply for a position with the American Bar Association, please call 312\-988\-5188\.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
### **Who We Are**



At ERC Pathlight, we're on a mission to change lives—and we're looking for people who feel called to do the same.



As one of the nation's leading treatment providers for eating disorders and mood, anxiety, and trauma\-related conditions, we bring innovative, evidence\-based, and deeply compassionate care to patients across the country. With multiple locations nationwide and extensive virtual programming, we meet patients exactly where they are and help them move toward lasting recovery.



Founded in 2008 by renowned psychiatrists and psychologists, ERC Pathlight now supports more than 6,000 patients each year. And as the need for world\-class mental health care continues to rise, our commitment is stronger than ever: to expand access, elevate the standard of care, and empower every patient to rebuild their life with dignity and hope.


### **Why Join Us**



When you join ERC Pathlight, you become part of a team that shows up every day to make a real difference. You'll work alongside passionate clinicians, dedicated support staff, and mission\-driven leaders who believe in collaboration, growth, and doing the right thing—always.



Here, your work matters. Your ideas matter. **You** matter.



If you're energized by purpose, motivated by impact, and ready to help transform the future of mental health treatment, you belong here.


**Come build hope. Come save lives. Come grow with us.**


**What you'll be doing:**



Schedule: Part time NOC (nights) (Tuesday/Saturday)



The Program Coordinator (PC I, PC II, PC III) is responsible for the direct care of inpatient, residential, and partial hospitalization patients by providing patient supervision and support. The PCs provide structure and boundaries for our patients. They provide bathroom and milieu support as well as contribute to the implementation of therapeutic programming which may include care delivery and program documentation. The PCs provide mealtime support, supporting patients with their dietary needs, and supervising patients at meals and snacks.



The PC should be able to:


* Be willing and able to work at all ERC Pathlight local sites as assigned
* Be compliant with certification and regulatory requirements for each practice location
* Maintain a flexible schedule to meet organizational staffing needs
* Be available to work weekends and holidays as required
* Be available to work on\-call shifts based on business needs, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local labor laws


**Essential duties and responsibilities:**


* Milieu Management, including (but not limited to) the following:
* Maintains daily program structure by following program schedule
* Completes observation rounds and safety checks as ordered by physician
* Works with patients on de\-escalation and implementing coping skills per treatment plan
* Conducts room searches and luggage searches
* Takes patients out on fresh air breaks and mindful movement exposures
* Provides ongoing bathroom monitoring
* Take patient vital signs, weights, urine Specific Gravity (may vary by location and program)
* Group Facilitation
* Participates in group facilitation
* Compliant with documentation in EHR for group facilitation
* Supports group outings
* Meal Support, including (but not limited to) the following:
* Participates in all meals and snacks with patients as needed per facility
* Provides meal support through coaching and skills per treatment team at eating disorder treatment locations (when not assigned to an eating disorder treatment location, performs other duties as assigned based on program and operational needs)
* Provides administrative support as needed around mealtimes
* Ensures adherence to allergy\-safety system
* Administrative Support
* Complete all appropriate documentation as needed in compliance with standards (some indicated above) including but not limited to patient observations, meals, and events that occur during shift
* Provides patient transportation as needed for medical appointments (may vary by location and program)
* Supports additional transportation needs, including but not limited to outings, grocery shopping, or other facility needs
* May provide support for additional food procurement as needed once per week
* Distributes mail and packages daily


**Must haves:**



Program Coordinator I (PC I)


* High School Diploma or GED (required)
* Valid driver's license with safe driving record: required only at locations operating company vehicles or requiring driving on behalf of the company (required)
* Washington teammates must hold a state credential (may be pending at time of hire) (required)
* ServSafe certification may be required depending on state and local licensing regulations (required)
* Mental Health/Psych Tech or CNA certification (preferred)


Program Coordinator II (PC II)


* High School Diploma or GED (required)
* Minimum of one (1\) year of direct patient care experience (required)
* Valid driver's license with safe driving record: required only at locations operating company vehicles or requiring driving on behalf of the company (required)
* Washington teammates must hold a state credential (may be pending at time of hire) (required)
* ServSafe certification may be required depending on state and local licensing regulations (required)


Program Coordinator III (PC III)


* Bachelor's degree in behavioral health or related field (required)
* Minimum of six (6\) months of experience in a behavioral health or related field (required)
* Valid driver's license with safe driving record: required only at locations operating company vehicles or requiring driving on behalf of the company (required)
* Washington teammates must hold a state credential (may be pending at time of hire) (required)
* ServSafe certification may be required depending on state and local licensing regulations (required)

jobs.title: Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Agency Overview**  


Agency EA, a part of EA Collective, is a 100% employee\-owned, award\-winning experiential marketing agency specializing in live, virtual, and hybrid experiences for global brands. Known for its ability to blend strategy, creativity, and flawless execution, Agency EA partners with clients to bring their brands to life through impactful events, immersive environments, and engaging digital activations. As the flagship agency of EA Collective, Agency EA benefits from the broader collective’s creative resources and industry\-leading expertise to innovate and deliver unforgettable experiences that resonate with audiences and achieve business objectives.
We are looking for dreamers and doers who have the passion to champion big ideas and the talent to bring them to life. A place of acceptance and open dialogue, we strive to foster a culture where differences are not just valued, but celebrated. Come do your best and be your best in a casual yet vibrant workplace where we prioritize professional and personal growth, commit to causes we believe in, and ensure a diverse and inclusive community.
This position is based in Chicago and will involve a combination of remote and in\-office work.
**Role Summary:**
The Production Coordinator will support EA’s Production Department, both internally in
pre\-production and onsite for client events. This entry\-level position requires an eager individual
with a strong work ethic and the desire to learn and grow in a fast\-paced environment.
**Responsibilities:**
* Provide coordination and project management support to the project’s lead producer to ensure success of the program.
* Support all live, hybrid, virtual event logistics and timelines conception to completion.
* Work on multiple projects and assignments with a variety of production and cross\-department team members.
* Employ strong problem\-solving skills and provide recommendations to assigned project deliverables.
* Research and gather information in planning the execution of events.
* Sourcing caterers, giveaways/swag, hotel blocks, production supplies, vendors, venues, etc.
* Anticipate project needs to meet deadlines.
* Serve as liaison between vendors, venues staff and clients regarding event details.
* Work onsite during production for events as needed.
* Provide status reports to the Production Team as necessary.
* Coordinate and attend site visits if need arises.
* Coordinate communication with speakers/talent for scheduling technical checks and/or pre\-recorded content.
* Support the creation and management of production schedules as well as both internal and client facing project decks, as required.
* Assist producers in processing invoices and check requests.
* Additional responsibilities as assigned.

**Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent field experience in the event industry.
* 1\-2 years events industry experience preferred.
* Experience/knowledge in backend management of various meeting platforms including but not limited to Zoom host, Google Hangouts, Teams, Webex, etc.
* Knowledge of virtual event platforms is a plus.
* Event platforms including but not limited to Cvent, Swoogo, Swapcard, Kaltura, etc.
* Proficiency in the latest versions of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Keynote.
* Experience in G Suite products and Asana a plus.
* Client\-centric mentality.
* Take initiative and demonstrate confidence.
* Superior attention to detail.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to multi\-task across multiple projects, work independently and contribute to a team environment.
* Organizational and project management skills.
* Eager to learn in a fast paced, ever changing environment.
* Strong work ethic and desire to succeed.
* Some travel required.

Compensation will be based on experience and will range from $50,000 to $60,000\.

jobs.title: Event Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**


We believe a workplace food program is something employees should love and look forward to every day. Powered by technology and a network of over 2,000 restaurants, Fooda feeds hungry people at work through our ongoing food programs located within companies and office buildings. Every day, each Fooda location is served by a different restaurant that comes onsite and serves fresh lunch from their chef’s unique menu. Fooda operates in over 20 major US cities and continues its expansion across the United States. Eight out of ten employees believe Fooda is one of their company’s top perks.


Fooda is currently recruiting for a part time Event Coordinator in our Chicago market. This is an excellent opportunity for candidates with a hospitality or events background who are eager to learn about food service, work with great customers, and support a broad network of excellent local restaurants.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Support Fooda events in a variety of capacities, including: being onsite to set\-up, tear down, clean equipment and site areas, problem\-solve, and ensure high quality set\-up and customer experience
* Gain competency with Fooda’s technology and standard operations procedures
* Problem\-solve for issues such as incorrect orders, late deliveries, late restaurant arrivals, or incorrect email communication
* Troubleshoot technical issues with point\-of\-sale (POS) system, onsite technology, and TV menu boards
* Conduct onsite Fooda promotions and mobile app coaching
* Provide real\-time onsite customer service to resolve issues promptly directly with the consumer
* Facilitate audits of restaurant event set\-up to ensure consistency and high quality
* Escalate issues to Operations Manager when necessary to keep them informed or help problem solve
* Critical hours are over lunch Monday \- Thursday (10:30 am – 1:30 pm) but responsibilities may span 8am\-4pm, depending on the market and need

**Who You Are:**

* You love building relationships with customers and enjoy customer service
* You are friendly, high energy and love interacting with other people
* You are savvy with technology and will be comfortable in a fast\-paced start\-up

jobs.title: Client Experience Coordinator
jobs.description:
Let's be honest: families don't remember the name of a scheduling system. They remember the person who made their week easier.



At North Shore Pediatric Therapy, that person is the Family Child Advocate (FCA) — the calm in the chaos, the voice of reassurance, the behind\-the\-scenes orchestrator ensuring every child gets the care they deserve and every clinician walks into a day that runs smoothly.



Here, FCAs are trusted partners to families, real\-time problem solvers, and key players in providing the exceptional experience NSPT is known for. When a parent is overwhelmed, a child needs an urgent reschedule, or a clinic is juggling 30 moving pieces at once… **you're the one who turns stress into solutions.**



This is a **full\-time, in\-center position** with a **schedule of 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM****.** You'll primarily work from our Chicago (Bucktown), IL location. Approximately 50% of your time will be spent in the community building relationships. Compensation ranges from $21\-25 per hour, based on experience and qualifications.


**Why This Role Matters**
-------------------------



Every hour of therapy counts — for a child learning to eat independently, say their sibling's name, or build the confidence they've never had before. You make those moments possible by keeping schedules full, communication clear, and families supported.



Across our centers, our therapists, Clinical Directors, and families will tell you the same thing: "I don't know what we'd do without our FCA."


**Who Thrives in This Role**
----------------------------


* A natural helper who finds joy in making someone's day smoother.
* A multitasker who can juggle 10 moving pieces without losing the warmth in their voice.
* A communicator who knows how to spin chaos into clarity.
* A schedules\-and\-systems thinker who loves finding the fastest path to a solution.
* A relationship\-builder who wants families to feel seen, supported, and appreciated.


If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply!


**What** **You'll** **Do**
--------------------------


**Family Experience \& Operations**


* Be the go\-to support for families (schedule changes, questions, updates)
* Turn cancellations into makeups and keep schedules running smoothly
* Make real\-time adjustments as things shift
* Partner with Clinical Directors and therapists
* Keep the clinic organized, stocked, and running efficiently


**Marketing \& Growth (****50%)**


* Support local outreach efforts (schools, events, community partners)
* Help coordinate and host tours for prospective families
* Assist with center events and family engagement initiatives
* Drive online reputation (reviews, testimonials, family follow\-ups)
* Partner with leadership on simple, high\-impact marketing efforts
* Be the face of the center in the community

**Why** **You'll** **Love Working Here**
----------------------------------------



You're not just managing logistics — you're shaping a family's entire experience of therapy. You'll join a supportive team, build real relationships with families, and play a vital part in helping kids access the care they need.



If you're looking for a role where every day is meaningful and every detail matters, we'd love to talk.

jobs.description:
**Summary**



The CRM \& Lifecycle Marketing Coordinator will keep Topstep's CRM instance clean, organized, and running smoothly. This role owns the day\-to\-day operational health of the CRM: database hygiene, subscription management, folder and file organization, campaign setup and tracking, and QA, and will provide hands\-on execution support for lifecycle and evergreen email programs.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-obsessed, and comfortable owning recurring, process\-driven work. You're curious about marketing technology and enjoy exploring and standing up new tools, and you take pride in a well\-maintained system that others can rely on. You will work closely with the Sr. Lifecycle \& CRM Marketing Lead and collaborate with Creative and QA partners to keep lifecycle communications running without a hitch


**Key Responsibilities**


**CRM Platform \& Database Management**


* Keep contact lists clean and healthy: merge duplicate records, process unsubscribes/unbounce requests, and audit subscription and preference center settings to ensure they work as intended.
* Maintain the folder structures and naming conventions for content, creative, and file assets within HubSpot so teams can find what they need.
* Explore and evaluate new HubSpot tools and features as they roll out (e.g., AI features, surveys, HubDB, ASO) and lead hands\-on setup and configuration.
* Serve as the go\-to owner for day\-to\-day CRM hygiene and platform upkeep.


**Campaign \& Lifecycle Execution Support**


* Support lifecycle and evergreen email programs by monitoring for breaks or errors, tracking send volume, and flagging opportunities for improvement.
* Set up and configure campaigns in the CRM to ensure proper tracking and attribution of email performance.
* Partner with QA teams to run pre\-send testing (rendering, links, personalization tokens, deliverability) across lifecycle and campaign emails.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Work closely with Engineering, Marketing Operations and Analytics teams.
* Coordinate with Creative and Brand partners on asset intake, organization, and file handoffs.
* Support QA and testing partners to ensure every send meets quality standards before launch.


**Required Qualifications and Key Competencies**


* 3\+ years of experience in email marketing operations, CRM administration, or marketing operations.
* Highly detail\-oriented and organized, with a strong sense of ownership over recurring, process\-driven work.
* Experience with database hygiene practices such as deduplication, list segmentation, and subscription/preference management.
* Familiarity with QA and testing processes for email campaigns.
* Basic email building and scheduling experience.
* Experience in Google slides for process document creation.
* Must have basic HTML knowledge (CSS and Handlebar (Or equivalent) is a plus).
* Curiosity and comfort exploring and adopting new marketing technology and tools.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate cross\-functionally with Creative, QA, and Marketing partners.


**Preferred Qualifications and Key Competencies**


* Hands\-on HubSpot experience.


**Company Culture \& Perks**


* Topstep is an engaging working environment which ranges from fully remote to hybrid. We foster a culture of collaboration with cameras on during meetings and a robust Slack environment for communication.
* Seven Company\-paid Holidays and generous Family Leave. Paid time off is front\-loaded.
* Competitive 401(k) matching, health, dental, and vision insurance is offered for full time employees.
* Vacations are encouraged with a bonus for taking 5 consecutive days. Employee referrals are bonused. Topstep offers a food and groceries budget and contributes towards health and wellness.


**New Hire Base Salary Range**


* $33\.65 \- $40\.87 hourly.
* Bonus: This position is eligible for a performance\-based bonus as provided by the plan terms and governing documents.
* The compensation offered will take into account internal compensation structure and may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors.


**Equal Opportunity Employer**



Topstep is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all employees and applicants are valued. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.


**Interested in the role? Apply today with your resume!**

jobs.title: Account Manager (Chicago)
jobs.description:
In 1989, Wikoff’s first continual improvement department was established, adopting a Total Quality Management approach. Over the years, the department has matured and expanded its vision to include not only oversight of the quality management system, but also training programs and employee safety while adopting other improvement methodologies such as lean and six sigma.
  
  

Role
  
At Wikoff Color Corporation, we’re proud to be employee\-owned, which means every team member has a stake in our success. We believe in building a workplace where people feel valued, empowered, and invested in the future.
  
  

We are seeking a motivated and results\-driven Ink and Pressroom Products Salesperson to join our sales team. The successful candidate will be responsible for promoting and selling a range of Wikoff products to new and existing clients. This role involves prospecting, managing customer relationships, providing technical product knowledge, and achieving sales targets within an assigned territory. It is expected the candidate will drive revenue growth through consultative selling. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter with a passion for sales, excellent communication skills, and a proven track record in Ink, Coatings or Chemical environments
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Identify and develop new business opportunities through prospecting, cold calling, networking, inbound lead follow\-up and industry events.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing customers to ensure ongoing satisfaction and repeat business.
* Understand customer needs and recommend appropriate products or solutions.
* Conduct product demonstrations and deliver technical presentations to clients.
* Collaborate with technical and development teams to understand technical specifications and tailor offerings to client requirements.
* Negotiate pricing, terms, and conditions of sales agreements.
* Prepare quotes, proposals, and contracts.
* Maintain accurate records of sales activities, customer interactions, and opportunities using CRM (eChempax) software.
* Stay up to date on industry trends, market conditions, and competitors.
* Attend trade shows, conferences, and sales meetings as required.
* Ensure all competitive pricing insights are shared with the Market Manager and Regional Sales Leader in a timely manner for analysis and action.
* Develop key account plans, including sales summaries, key personnel, account strategy and an annual action plan.
* Organizing sales territory to efficiently call on current and prospective customers, coordinating all accounts with your supervisor and technical support personnel.
* Working through the Chief Commercial Officer and Regional Sales Leader in coordinating major or national accounts as they relate to local activity in communicating to corporate and other branches.
* Making recommendations to management regarding improvements in products, packaging, shipping methods, service or billing methods and procedures to prevent future complaints and following up on recommendations to ensure customer satisfaction.
* Working with field technical and production personnel to supply a current formula or produce a product that satisfies the customer’s requirement at a competitive price within material and manufacturing guidelines.
* Working with Corporate Credit and Collection to resolve delinquent accounts.
* Provide a forward\-looking 12\-month sales forecast by major customers and all others within the territory on a monthly cadence.
* Report on YTD sales performance on a periodic (monthly or quarterly) basis to the Regional Sales Leader and the Chief Commercial Officer
* Actively update and report monthly on territory sales pipeline value, opportunity progress, wins and losses and suggestions for advancing projects.
* Ensure that all sales team members adhere to company policies and procedures
* Execute your individual sales development plan to improve selling skills and effectiveness.
* Create the annual sales budget from the bottom\-up, customer by customer basis.


**Competencies:**  

* Technical aptitude and ability to understand complex products
* Customer\-centric approach
* Time management and organizational skills
* Strategic thinking, analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Persistence and resilience under pressure
* Familiarity with lead generation tools and sales automation platforms


Education/Experience
  
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Industrial Technology, Chemistry or a related field (preferred but not mandatory) Industry experience in lieu of a college degree will be considered.
* Proven experience in B2B sales (3 to 6 years), preferably within the Ink, Coating or Printing Industry.
* Strong knowledge of printing products or equipment.
* Demonstrate excellent customer service skills
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Self\-motivated with a strong drive to meet and exceed sales targets.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Ability to travel within assigned territory ( \>50%) and to meet customer contact metrics
* Proficiency with CRM systems and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Have good math skills to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commission, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume
* Results\-oriented with a focus on exceeding sales targets.


**Working Conditions:**  

* This role is field\-based where most of the time will be spent with customers and a fraction of the time will be spent in a home or branch\-based office.


**Effort/Physical Demands:**  

* Ability to sit for long periods of time
* Lifting/pushing/pulling up to 25 lbs

jobs.title: Commercial Lines Account Manager, High Growth Ventures
jobs.description:
**A path for every ambition.**

  

At HUB, we believe the best work happens when people are given real space to grow and then given the autonomy to exercise it. We power progress and protect ambition: for the clients who count on us, and equally for the people who make that possible every day.


We’re creative thinkers and determined doers, guided by values that show up in how we work together: with empathy, adaptability, accountability and a genuine commitment to one another’s success. We foster bold ideas, celebrate curiosity and share what we know. Because when people grow, the work they do grows with them.

  

Our purpose is deeply human: to help people navigate the world on their terms, at their speed, toward their future. We hold that same commitment to the people building careers here.

  

Whether you’re starting out or leveling up, you’ll find the resources to evolve, the support to take on more and a team ready to back you at every stage.

  

Your ambition has a home here.

 **About HUB**


In a rapidly changing world, HUB advises businesses and individuals on how to prepare for the unexpected. As one of the world’s largest insurance brokers, our focus is dedicated to providing our customers with the peace of mind that what matters most will be protected — through unrelenting advocacy and tailored insurance solutions that put our clients in control. Our growing team of professionals across North America represents a broad, deep, and one\-of\-a kind aggregation of entrepreneurs and leaders recognized for their excellence throughout the insurance community.

 **Why Choose HUB?**


Throughout our network of more than 700 HUB offices in North America, we offer a competitive, exciting, and friendly work environment that strategically positions our employees for longevity and success. At HUB, we believe in investing in the future of our employees and provide continuous opportunities for growth and development. Our entrepreneurial culture fosters an environment that empowers our people to make the best decisions for our customers and organization, focusing on expanding the industry knowledge of our insurance professionals to better serve our valued clients. We are committed to providing you with competitive and flexible benefits options that are rooted in your current needs yet evolves as your needs change over time. Join us in taking the first step toward creating a future that combines a diverse, challenging work environment with financial security and career satisfaction.

 **We are the perfect fit if you:**

* are seeking a progressive work environment at a rapidly growing organization
* have a desire to help others protect their future
* have an entrepreneurial spirit and are challenged by the opportunity to grow the business
* are focused on learning and development to enhance your industry knowledge and expertise
* are a self\-starter willing to invest time and energy to learn the technical aspects of our business
* believe in integrity and building success by developing relationships with others

 **Summary**


As a Commercial Lines Account Manager (High Growth Ventures), you will provide critical support to our customers through account management, claims management, day\-to\-day client oversight, and underwriting services that make us a leading sales and service organization in the insurance industry. Our work spans fresh food sourcing, whole harvest innovation, corporate partnerships, and community impact programs across the country.

**The Opportunity**

Planet Harvest is seeking a Social Media \& Content Marketing Manager to lead the day\-to\-day development and execution of our social media and content strategy.

This is a hands\-on role for a strong storyteller and content creator who can turn the work happening across Planet Harvest, from farms and food innovation to corporate partnerships and community impact, into compelling content that builds awareness, engagement and brand visibility. The ideal candidate combines strong strategic thinking with a willingness to execute. This person will own the content calendar, manage Planet Harvest's social channels, create and capture content, support partner amplification, and help build a consistent and differentiated Planet Harvest brand presence.

This role reports to the SVP, Brand \& Community Impact and will work closely across the organization and with external partners.

**What You’ll Do**

Own Social Media \& Content

* Develop and manage Planet Harvest's social media and content strategy, with an initial focus on LinkedIn and Instagram.
* Own the editorial calendar, including planning, creating, scheduling and publishing content.
* Write compelling social copy and develop content across video, photography, graphics and other formats.
* Manage day\-to\-day community engagement and identify opportunities to grow Planet Harvest's audience and visibility.
* Stay current on social trends, platform changes and emerging content formats.

Bring the Planet Harvest Story to Life

* Identify and develop stories across Planet Harvest's work in agriculture, food, innovation, partnerships and community impact.
* Interview farmers, partners, employees and community organizations to uncover authentic stories and perspectives.
* Translate complex or behind\-the\-scenes work into accessible, engaging content.
* Develop stories that demonstrate Planet Harvest's impact and reinforce the company's broader brand positioning.
* Build and maintain a strong library of photo, video and storytelling assets.

Capture Content in the Field

* Develop content plans for key Planet Harvest events, farm visits, food distributions and partner activations.
* Attend select activations and events to personally capture photo, video and social content.
* Create timely, engaging content from the field while identifying opportunities for longer\-form and evergreen storytelling.

Support Marketing \& Partnerships

* Develop content that supports brand awareness, customer acquisition and strategic partnerships.
* Create social and communications toolkits that make it easy for corporate and community partners to amplify Planet Harvest initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for collaborative content, partner posts and executive amplification.
* Work closely with internal teams to ensure content supports company priorities and key initiatives.

Measure \& Optimize

* Track social media and content performance and establish regular reporting.
* Monitor audience growth, reach, engagement and content performance.
* Use data and insights to continuously improve content strategy and execution.
* Identify which stories, channels and formats are most effective in building awareness and engagement.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 4–7 years of experience in social media, content marketing, brand marketing, communications or a related field.
* Strong writing, editing and storytelling skills.
* Demonstrated experience managing brand social media channels, particularly LinkedIn and Instagram.
* Experience creating short\-form video, photography and visual social content.
* Ability to personally take content from idea through execution—from identifying the story and capturing assets to writing, publishing and measuring performance.
* Strong creative instincts and an understanding of what makes content engaging and shareable.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects, partners and deadlines.
* Self\-starter who can independently identify opportunities and move work forward.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
* Collaborative and comfortable working with a range of stakeholders, from farmers and nonprofit partners to corporate executives.
* Willingness to travel periodically for events, activations, farm visits and content capture.

**Nice to Have**

Experience in food, agriculture, sustainability, health and wellness, corporate social impact or purpose\-driven brands is a plus, as is experience with executive thought leadership, partner collaborations, PR, graphic design, photography or video editing.

**Who You Are**

You are a storyteller and a doer. You see the story before someone has to ask you to tell it. You are as comfortable developing a content strategy as you are capturing an iPhone video at an event, writing the caption and getting it published.

You are curious, creative and highly organized. You know how to take a big idea and turn it into content people actually want to engage with. You enjoy working across teams and with external partners, but you don't need a large team or agency to make things happen.

Most importantly, you are excited by the opportunity to help build the voice and visibility of a growing company working at the intersection of food, agriculture, innovation and community impact.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly.

**National Forest Foundation (NFF)** is pleased to offer an exempt, full\-time, 2\-Year term position that will support the Southern California Ignition Reduction Program (SCIRP), a public\-private partnership of governmental agencies and their partners working together to reduce human\-caused ignitions, primarily along roadsides.

**About the NFF:** As the official national partner to the US Forest Service (USFS), the National Forest Foundation was chartered by Congress in 1990\. Today, the NFF advances forest resiliency, healthy watersheds and wildlife habitat, and recreation for all by working with communities and organizations across the country. The Foundation has grown significantly in the last few years in programmatic impact, revenue and support, and organizational capacity. NFF leads with impact, deploying roughly 90% of its expenses towards projects and programs across the country’s 193\-million\-acre National Forest System. NFF is forward\-thinking and innovative, with ambitious strategies and goals to advance and prepare forests for a new economy.

**Position Function:** The Southern California Project Coordinator reports to the Southern California Program Director and will work closely with key members of SCIRP, including the USDA Forest Service, California Department of Conservation, California Department of Transportation, and California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection.


The Project Coordinator will support project development and implementation of roadside ignition projects; coordinate with federal, state, and private partners; and support fundraising efforts for projects. This position will work with their supervisor and key members of SCIRP to support project solicitation, project prioritization, and development of the 10\-Year Project Portfolio and Master Plan.


**Position Duties and Responsibilities:** The Southern California Project Coordinator will:

* Work closely with the key SCIRP members and teams to develop project pipeline tools that will support project prioritization, planning, and implementation.
* Support development of the 10\-Year Project Portfolio and Master Plan.
* Develop relationships and facilitate communication between SCIRP partners and project leads.
* Develop agendas, facilitate, and document takeaways for meetings among SCIRP partners and project leads.
* Coordinate with agency partners to complete environmental review, including coordinating associated activities and processes as needed.
* Coordinate and oversee site visits with SCIRP partners and project leads.
* Provide regular updates to the SCIRP Executive Committee and Core Team.
* Work with NFF staff and SCIRP members to secure funds from government sources, foundations, corporations, and individuals to support projects.
* Support preparation of progress and funding reports for federal, state, and local government funding sources as well as for philanthropic support from corporations, foundations, and individuals.
* Oversee the advertisement, negotiation, and award of contracts for services related to SCIRP projects.
* Maintain a breadth of knowledge about current trends, emerging issues, policy interventions, and innovations related to wildfire risk reduction and relevant land management policy and regulations.

**Education and Qualifications:** NFF expects the Southern California Project Coordinator to possess the following educational and experiential qualifications:

* Minimum of an undergraduate degree in natural resource management, biological sciences, environmental policy, or another related field (or equivalent experience).
* Minimum of three (3\) years’ experience in project management, government agency relations, or natural resource management.
* Familiarity with the US Forest Service, California Department of Conservation, California Department of Transportation, and California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection.
* Knowledge of Southern California and Central Coast natural resource management and policy principles, practices, and concepts sufficient to perform the full range of activities connected with planning and coordinating natural resources projects.
* Knowledge of and experience in U.S. Forest Service and/or State of California land management policies, procedures, and regulations.
* Experience working effectively in collaborative efforts with individuals or groups that have a multitude of views.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.

**Abilities and Skills:** NFF expects the Southern California Project Coordinator to possess the following proven abilities and skills:

* Ability to work collaboratively to manage projects with multiple partners, including advanced communication skills and coordination and facilitation skills.
* Ability to represent the NFF in a clear and professional manner through excellent written and oral communication skills and excellent interpersonal skills.
* Ability to effectively set priorities, manage timelines, and create workflows, while managing a variety of projects and tasks to successful completion.
* Ability to utilize a variety of document and data management platforms.
* Ability to work well and be flexible in a team\-oriented environment.
* Self\-driven and motivated to stay focused and productive in a fully remote work environment
* Must have valid U.S. driver’s license and clean driving record.
* Ability and willingness to travel when required to project sites in Southern California and Central Coast, as needed.
* Excellent analytical skills with a strong attention to detail.

**Location:** The location for this position is Southern California in a community near the Los Padres, Angeles, San Bernardino, or Cleveland National Forests. Applicants must be able to travel regularly throughout the Central Coast and Southern California. Compensation: $65,000 – $80,000 annually, depending on experience.


You are the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks. You know how good it feels when the systems, the paperwork, and the people all move together without friction, and you're the reason it does.

You sit at the center of operations and production, across every project instead of inside just one, keeping schedules on track, the paperwork flowing, and the admin noise away from the people who need to be producing. * Track in\-house and out\-of\-house creator schedules across every active project, catching double\-bookings and conflicts before they become problems.

* Own day\-to\-day coordination with facilities, IT, and general office needs, knowing when to keep leadership out of the loop on things that don't need them.
* Flag where manual processes can be simplified or automated, and bring recommendations forward as we grow.

5–7 years in operations, business operations, or production administration at an agency, production company, or fast\-moving small business, with real ownership of systems.


You've managed multiple concurrent workstreams without losing the thread, and you catch what's off before anyone has to point it out.


You've managed paperwork, vendor communications, and internal coordination across multiple people and projects at the same time.


You're comfortable with ops/HR/finance platforms and tools or you're a fast learner who can get up to speed on systems like Rippling, Wrapbook, Ramp or similar quickly.


Comfortable holding sensitive information, employee records, financial data, system access, and you understand why that trust matters.


You think in systems, not tasks. You see the pattern behind a one\-off problem and fix the pattern.


You're proactive, not reactive. You see what needs to happen next and you do it without being told.


You communicate clearly and follow through relentlessly, including when you need to flag something to someone senior to you.


Proficient in Google Workspace (G\-Suite). Google Sheets, shared drives, and organized folders are your natural habitat.


Responsive, autonomous, and equipped to work in a non\-traditional creative setup.

#### **Bonus if you also bring**


Formal training or prior hands\-on experience handling confidential HR and payroll data.

Agency or production company background.


Tech\-savvy — you pick up new software quickly and you don't wait for someone to hold your hand through it. We use a mix of tools and you won't always get a tutorial.


A genuine interest in figuring out what should be systematized or automated as a company scales, rather than just running the process as it exists today.

#### **Why Race Service?**


We are an Automotive Culture Hub and Creative Agency. Our mission: reshape automotive culture. We work at the intersection of content, strategy, experiential, and design for some of the most iconic brands in the world.


But what makes us different isn't the clients. It's our people.


We operate like a sports team. Everyone brings their best. Everyone feels the win and the loss together. The work we make isn't just deliverables. It's cultural moments that carry a piece of who we are. We reward initiative, autonomy, and bold thinking.


We believe the work you choose and the people you choose it with define the life you live.


If that sounds like your kind of life, hit apply.

iHeartMedia Markets

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it! iHeartMedia, **the number one audio company in America**, reaches 90% of Americans every month \- a monthly audience that’s **twice the size of any other audio company** – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad\-supported music streaming service. Only one company in America has the \#1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

**What We Need:**


We’re seeking a Social Media Manager to work in the iHeartRadio Los Angeles group of stations. In this role, you’ll be focused on increasing digital listening, follower engagement, brand recognition, brand affinity, and ultimately drive overall growth. The ideal candidate will understand the responsibility that comes with leading social media for multiple major brands.
  

  

This position requires openness to a flexible schedule as there may be work needed on occasional nights and weekends.  



**What You'll Do:**

  

* Manage and maintain regular posting schedule of content and editorial pieces on Los Angeles stations with a heavy focus on the Alternative Rock genre.
* Coordinate with various departments and help guide on\-air personalities to maximize listening opportunities through their personal and station social channels.
* Respond to music and pop culture events and use those opportunities to introduce new fans to the iHeartRadio ecosystem.
* Track social media analytics to use to judge prior campaigns and future strategies.
* Work closely with the Digital Program Director on developing and carrying out the plan for each station to increase digital listening, social engagement and other KPIs in line with iHeartRadio’s overall strategy.
* Be responsible for all social media touchpoints for the music fandoms, including new releases, social first campaigns and any other interaction to boost fan and community engagement.
* Work with on\-air talent to find ways to localize/personalize content, making it more relevant and engaging on station social platforms.
* Covering both local LA\-station events and national iHeartRadio tentpole events to capture content and posting real\-time event coverage.
* Writing and editing compelling social media copy with the purpose of engaging our fans, while leading community engagement.

  



**What You'll Need:**

* Minimum of 2\+ years of experience working in social media or digital marketing, entertainment or music industries preferred.
* The position requires urgency, curiosity, creativity, the ability to collaborate with a team and consistently meet deadlines.
* The role requires a person with excellent communication and strong organizational skills.
* Always on your phone, with a healthy appetite for Alternative music, pop culture and entertainment.
* In\-depth knowledge of the latest best practices, tools, and trends on social media platforms (Facebook, Facebook Live, Instagram, Instagram Stories, IGTV, Instagram Live, X, YouTube, TikTok, Twitch etc.), as well as sponsored/partner content protocols.
* Strong writing, proof\-reading, and copyediting skills.
* You know how to capture and create on the fly content when covering events IRL and virtually.
* Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite and/or Canva.

  



**What You'll Bring:**

* Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
* Accountability for own work and desire to provide guidance to new team members
* Ability to contribute to several projects at the same time under a moderate level of direction
* Application of objective judgement, technical skills and prior experience to solve business problems
* Strong written and verba

new_jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
new_jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for **making a difference for small business** in your community? Are you looking for a career with **unlimited income potential**? Is **company culture** important to you? Or maybe you have been thinking about switching career paths and moving into sales?

**NFIB was chosen as a Glassdoor Top 50 Best Places to Work.** Whether you have some sales experience or are new to sales, NFIB will set you up for success with best\-in\-class training. **A career with NFIB provides a flexible work/life balance while still maintaining full\-time effort in the field.**  

Think of this as an in\-field work environment where you're not tied to an office location. Instead, your office is the work area you serve. Approximately 95% of your time will be spent in the field within your local market, meeting face\-to\-face with small business owners and growing NFIB membership.


***What’s in it for you:**** **W\-2 with full benefits** (medical, dental, vision, matching 401k, and more) \- **eligible after 30 days**
* **Up to 13 weeks** (1,000/wk) **performance\-based training pay** (or commission, whichever is greater)
* **Production\-based weekly commissions, monthly \& quarterly bonuses**
* **Yearly average compensation: $80,000 \- $200,000**
* **40%** of our sales force **earns 6\-figures** with the **top 10%** earning **over 200k**
* **UNCAPPED earning potential** (Straight Commission)
* **Monthly Mileage reimbursement**

***Who we are*****:**

**NFIB is the most trusted advocate for free enterprise**, promoting and protecting the rights of any individual to own, operate, and grow their business. **NFIB's advocacy has a profound impact on shaping public policies** by influencing


decision\-makers, raising awareness, and mobilizing public support. NFIB membership is the mechanism for small business owners to actively contribute to the development of policies that align with their values and concerns. **NFIB has been fighting for independent business owners** for over 80 years. We are the **Voice of Small Business** in Washington, D.C., and in all 50 state capitals. **NFIB is a nonprofit, nonpartisan, and member driven** organization.

  

We educate small business owners through in\-person prospecting (no appointment setting) using NFIB's success\-proven verbatim sales presentation. This is a hunter/closer sales position using an assumptive one\-call close with no account management after the sale. ***What you will be responsible for:**** Meeting small business owners through in\-person prospecting (no appointment setting)
* Memorizing and utilizing NFIB’s proven 5\-minute verbatim sales presentation
* Building quick rapport and delivering an engaging presentation
* Overcoming objections and closing the sale

Processing payment on the spot  
* 

  

***Requirements to win in this role:**** Strong work ethic
* Grit and relentless perseverance
* Self\-starter and ability to stick with a structured, proven sales model
* Desire for ongoing learning
* Quick\-witted, adaptable, and strategic
* Passion for the success of small business
* Sales experience **AND/OR** transferable skills
* Intermediate technical skills


A career with NFIB means being part of a team of truly extraordinary people working to promote and protect small business. You will be impacting your community while taking advantage of our competitive compensation, ongoing training, incentives, and generous benefits package. **Learn more about the NFIB’s culture here:** www.nfib.com/careers


Equal Opportunity Employer

new_jobs.title: Project Coordinator- Regulatory
new_jobs.description:
**ETERNA MANAGEMENT, LLC**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Job Title:**

Project Coordinator – Regulatory

**Department:**

Regulatory Affairs / Quality

**Reports To:**

\[Regulatory Affairs / Quality Manager]

**Location:**

2901 Daimler Street, Santa Ana, CA

**Employment Type:**

Full\-Time

**FLSA Classification:**

Non\-Exempt (Hourly)

**Pay Range:**

$25\.00 – $27\.00 per hour

**Position Summary**

The Project Coordinator – Regulatory supports Eterna Management, LLC in planning, tracking, and executing projects within a highly regulated manufacturing and third\-party logistics (3PL) environment. This role coordinates timelines, documentation, and cross\-functional communication to ensure projects are completed accurately, on schedule, and in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter who takes initiative without constant direction, is exceptionally detail\-oriented, and understands that in a regulatory environment, accuracy and documentation are non\-negotiable.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and track regulatory, quality, and operational projects from initiation through completion, including timelines, milestones, deliverables, and action items.
* Maintain organized, audit\-ready project files, logs, and records in accordance with company document control and record\-retention requirements.
* Assist with the preparation, review, and submission of regulatory documentation, registrations, renewals, certificates, and compliance reports.
* Track regulatory deadlines, license and permit renewals, and required filings; proactively notify stakeholders of upcoming due dates.
* Support internal audits, customer audits, and regulatory inspections by gathering documentation, preparing binders, and tracking corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) to closure.
* Coordinate cross\-functionally with Quality Control, Production, Lab, Warehouse, Safety, and Management to gather information and keep projects moving.
* Schedule and facilitate project meetings; prepare agendas, record meeting notes, and distribute and follow up on action items.
* Review documents, labels, specifications, and records for accuracy, completeness, and consistency, and escalate discrepancies promptly.
* Assist in drafting, updating, and routing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and forms for review and approval.
* Prepare status reports, trackers, and summaries for leadership on project progress, risks, and open items.
* Monitor changes in applicable regulations and industry guidance as directed and communicate relevant updates to the team.
* Maintain confidentiality of proprietary, customer, and regulatory information.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

**Education and Experience:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business, Science, Regulatory Affairs, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of two (2\) years of project coordination, administrative, compliance, or quality support experience.
* Experience in a regulated industry (e.g., dietary supplements, food, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, hemp/CBD, or medical devices) strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with cGMP, document control, audit processes, or CAPA systems preferred.

**Skills and Abilities:**

* **Self\-Starter:** Works independently, takes ownership of assignments, and identifies next steps without waiting for direction.
* **Detail\-Oriented:** Exceptional accuracy and thoroughness; catches errors and inconsistencies before they become compliance issues.
* **Organized:** Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines at once.
* **Communicator:** Clear, professional written and verbal communication with employees at all levels.
* **Technical:** Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint); experience with project\-tracking tools is a plus.
* **Integrity:** Exercises sound judgment, handles confidential information with discretion, and escalates concerns appropriately.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) a plus.

**Physical Requirements and Work Environment**

This position is primarily performed in an office setting, with regular visits to production, laboratory, and warehouse areas. **SOCIAL MEDIA \& DIGITAL** 

**COMMUNICATIONS COORDINATOR** 

**Location:** Concord, California

**Organization:** Refuge Outreach Services (ROS) **Programs:** Harvest of Hope Market \& Thrift Store **Reports To:** Executive Director

**Position Type:** Part\-Time or Full\-Time, based upon organizational needs

**Compensation:** To be determined based on experience and position structure

**POSITION SUMMARY** 

Refuge Outreach Services is seeking a creative, organized, mission\-driven **Social Media \& Digital Communications Coordinator** to develop and manage the organization’s social media presence and digital storytelling across major platforms.

This individual will help tell the story of Refuge Outreach Services, Harvest of Hope Market, and the Harvest of Hope Thrift Store while increasing community awareness, donor engagement, volunteer participation, partnerships, and support for our mission.

Our communications should consistently demonstrate our commitment to **“Transforming Charity into Dignity.”** 

The ideal candidate understands that nonprofit social media is more than posting photographs and announcements. It is about building relationships, telling meaningful stories, creating community, and inspiring people to participate in the mission.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES** 

**Social Media Management** 

Develop, manage, and maintain an active presence across appropriate platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, and other emerging platforms.

Create and maintain a consistent weekly and monthly content calendar.

Publish regular content highlighting:

* Harvest of Hope Market activities and impact • Harvest of Hope Thrift Store merchandise, promotions, and community impact
* Refuge Outreach Services programs and initiatives • Volunteer opportunities and volunteer recognition • Donor and community partner recognition • Community events
* Fundraising campaigns
* Food distributions and donations
* Behind\-the\-scenes operations
* Educational and community\-resource information • Impact stories and testimonials

**CONTENT CREATION \& STORYTELLING** 

Create high\-quality digital content including photographs, short\-form videos, reels, interviews, graphics, stories, and written posts.

Capture authentic stories demonstrating how Refuge Outreach Services is making a difference in the community.

Develop compelling storytelling around the people, volunteers, donors, businesses, churches, foundations, and community organizations participating in the mission.

Ensure that all storytelling involving individuals receiving services is handled with dignity, appropriate permission, sensitivity, and respect.

Never exploit hardship, poverty, or personal circumstances for social media engagement or fundraising.

**BRAND MANAGEMENT** 

Maintain consistent branding across all digital platforms. Ensure appropriate use of:

* Refuge Outreach Services identity
* Harvest of Hope Market identity
* Harvest of Hope Thrift Store identity
* Organizational logos
* Approved fonts and visual standards
* Photography and video
* Organizational messaging

Maintain consistent use of the core message: **“Transforming Charity into Dignity.”** 

Help establish a recognizable voice for the organization that is hopeful, professional, compassionate, community centered, and inspiring.

**COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT** 

Monitor social media accounts and respond appropriately to comments, messages, questions, and community inquiries.

Build relationships with followers, volunteers, donors, businesses, churches, nonprofit organizations, neighborhood organizations, and community partners.

Identify opportunities to collaborate with community organizations and local influencers who align with the mission of Refuge Outreach Services.

**FUNDRAISING \& DONOR ENGAGEMENT**

Work with the Executive Director and fundraising team to develop digital campaigns supporting fundraising initiatives.

Create social media content surrounding:

* Giving campaigns
* Special fundraising events
* Capital campaigns
* Giving Tuesday
* Year\-end giving
* Monthly giving
* Sponsorship opportunities
* Corporate partnerships
* Food and product donation drives
* Volunteer campaigns

Develop appropriate calls to action that encourage followers to **Give, Volunteer, Donate, Shop, Partner, and Share.** 

**HARVEST OF HOPE THRIFT STORE MARKETING** 

Develop a strong digital presence for the Harvest of Hope Thrift Store as an earned\-revenue component supporting the charitable mission.

Regularly feature interesting merchandise, new arrivals, special sales, seasonal items, donation opportunities, and customer experiences.

Communicate clearly how shopping and donating merchandise to the Thrift Store helps support the work of Harvest of Hope Market and Refuge Outreach Services.

**VIDEO \& SHORT\-FORM CONTENT** 

Develop regular short\-form video content for Instagram Reels, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and similar platforms.

Content may include volunteer spotlights, donor recognition, Market tours, Thrift Store finds, community partnerships, behind\-the\-scenes operations, event recaps, interviews, and impact stories.

Develop longer\-form video content when appropriate for YouTube, donor presentations, fundraising campaigns, and organizational storytelling.

**WEBSITE \& DIGITAL COMMUNICATIONS** 

Coordinate social media content with the organization’s website and broader communications strategy.

Assist with website updates, digital newsletters, email campaigns, event promotions, and online fundraising communications as assigned.

**CONTENT CALENDAR** 

Maintain a minimum **30\-day rolling content calendar**.

The calendar should identify planned posts, campaigns, events, video production, photography needs, fundraising initiatives, volunteer recruitment, community stories, and organizational announcements.

**ANALYTICS \& PERFORMANCE** 

Monitor social media performance and provide a simple monthly report to leadership.

new_jobs.title: Park Operations Specialist
new_jobs.description:
The Operations Specialist supports the day\-to\-day operation of Children’s Fairyland including Rides \& Admissions and Retail and ensures safety standards are maintained throughout the park. The position ensures all guests enjoy a fun, safe and memorable experience by training and supporting Park Ambassadors to succeed in their roles. Reporting to the Park Operations Manager, responsibilities include working closely with other departments and vendors, acting as a key responder for escalated park issues, and end of day cash handling.


**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**
----------------------------------------


### **Rides \& Admissions**


* Ensure Rides, Admissions and Gatekeeper positions are appropriately staffed to meet operational needs.
* Act as a subject matter expert in CFL safety procedures and regulations
* Monitor the performance of Ride Operators including adherence to all safety procedures and regulations, daily cleaning, managing height requirements;
* Monitor the performance of Admissions Staff and ensures cash handling and park policies are followed;
* Troubleshoot and resolve problems by contacting the appropriate departments and/or vendors as needed for resolution
* Collect daily ride sheets and report any ride issues to Park Operations Manager
* Ensure staff and guests comply with CFL park policies and regulations
* Manage end\-of\-day cash handling at various locations throughout the park

### **Day to Day Operations Support**


* Daily cash handling and Point\-of\-Sale issues and adjusting staff to operational needs. Cash handling responsibilities include preparing bank deposits, preparing change banks and collecting funds from donation boxes around the park.
* Regular daily observation of ride operations and guest service.
* Conduct frequent show walks to monitor the cleanliness of the park and employee areas.
* Administrative duties include running reports, documenting accidents, maintaining inventory, maintaining accurate records of daily ride sheets, updating daily attendance, and submitting the daily EOD report to Senior Leadership.
* Administer first aid and CPR in emergency situations
* Report safety and maintenance issues to Facilities Department
* Assist in the sweeping and clearing the park of guests
* Support special event production
* Support the MOD (Manager on Duty) to oversee the park as needed
* Scheduling of Park Ambassadors personnel to ensure all areas are adequately covered

### **Customer Service**


* Respond to customer issues including providing answers to guest inquiries, addressing guest concerns, issuing refunds and rainchecks
* Walk the park and monitor guests and staff
* Act as a lead and make decisions for customer service escalation

### **Supervision**


* Oversee all functions of Park Ambassadors.
* Support Park Ambassador Lead with daily operations
* Provide coverage to Park Ambassador Lead during scheduled rest periods
* Coordinate staff training including New Hire Orientation, ride operator training and cross training.
* Monitor park ambassador performance, coach and counsel staff
* Document performance issues and coordinate additional training as needed.
* Communicate all issues to the Park Operations Manager.
* Assist in handling staff shortages, recruiting and hiring.
* Schedule, train, and monitor the performance of Park Ambassadors;
* Partner with Retail Sales Manager to cross\-training Park Ambassadors
* Contribute to Daily Lineup Notes and Weekly Staff Guide
* Other duties as assigned

**Knowledge Skills \& Abilities**
---------------------------------


* Minimum 2 years’ experience leading a team of ten (10\) people or more in a busy, customer service based environment. Experience in an amusement park, museum or similar hospitality environment is preferred.
* Associate’s Degree or equivalent preferred
* Excellent interpersonal skills
* Proven ability to work in a multi\-faceted, fast paced, customer\-facing environment
* Intermediate level computer skills with working knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel and Google Workspace application suite
* Experience with POS systems and cash handling procedures
* Ability to track and maintain accurate records on multiple items and meet deadlines
* Flexible and adaptable to constantly changing and challenging situations including weather, crowd size, staff shortages, occasionally having to work past scheduled hours
* Possession of a clear background history with no barriers to working with children
* Current Infant/Child/Adult First Aid \& CPR Certification

  


### **Personal Attributes/Values**


* People\-orientation\- able to interact effectively, politely, and productively with all types of people from all types of backgrounds and experience and in all types of situations. Comfortable working with non\-English speaking and culturally diverse stakeholders
* Professional maturity to manage composure during stressful interactions
* Energetic, diplomatic, adaptable and with a good sense of humor.
* Passionate about the mission, vision, and goals of Fairyland and possess an understanding of how this position contributes to the organization’s success.
* Strong work ethic with an orientation toward constant innovation and process improvement.
* Impeccable integrity and honesty

**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------



This position is primarily located in an outdoor environment. Able to perform the following duties with or without accommodation:


* Stand, sit, kneel, walk, bend, and perform repetitive motions for the duration of an eight (8\) hour shift
* Traverse safely over uneven terrain throughout the entirety of the 10\-acre amusement park
* Safely lift and transport items of up to 50 lbs.
* Respond quickly to sounds
* See and respond quickly to situations
* Communicate in clear, loud voice
* Operate two\-radio for communications with park personnel
* Work in outdoor, seasonal weather conditions for 100% of shift

**Benefits \& Compensation**
--------------

Reporting to the EOC Director of Finance, the EOC Administrative Coordinator – Finance Office provides day\-to\-day administrative support for purchasing, invoices, budget tracking, fiscal records, and business\-office follow\-up. * Receive and review purchase requests, invoices, vendor forms, and supporting documents for completeness; maintain a central request and follow\-up log showing status, responsible parties, and deadlines.

Bachelor's degree required.

* Experience supporting a finance office, purchasing, accounts payable, budget administration, or a comparable administrative function.
