**Community Coordinator \- M.S. 358 (28Q358\)**
===============================================


* Posted Date: Sep 30, 2026 Deadline: Oct 14, 2026
**Job Details**
---------------


### **Position Summary:**


Under the supervision of the Principal, the Community Coordinator will perform duties related to developing and improving community relations. The Community Coordinator will support the school in its efforts to increase and maintain communication between the school and our students, families, staff, and community partners and other community organizations and high schools and colleges. The Community Coordinator will similarly work to develop and sustain positive relations with other schools in the community and other organizations within the NYC Department of Education. The Community Coordinator will also work with local businesses, corporations and community\-based organizations to solicit interest in supporting and/or providing sites for the school’s fieldwork, internship, community service or community farming programs. Current groups working with the school include: QCH, LiveSchool, PTA, SLT, District Support Team, and various neighboring High Schools. Performs related work.


### **Reports to:**


Principal, Assistant Principal


### **Key Relationships:**


Serves as a liaison between school administration and community groups by coordinating and facilitating communication between the school, staff, students, families, community organizations, businesses, government agencies and the communities that these vital organizations represent.


### **Responsibilities**


* Maintains ongoing contact with community based organizations (CBO’s) that are involved with providing services to support the school’s educational programs.
* Assists students and staff in building relationships with external partners including those connected to the school.
* Meets with community leaders and the administration to plan community events.
* Meets regularly and communicate with community partners to schedule a calendar of events for the fiscal year.
* Coordinates and supervises various outreach programs between the school and the neighboring community.
* Responsible for the supervision, planning, implementation, coordination, and monitoring of community development programs.
* Develops, coordinates and monitors partnerships and community development programs associated with the PTA and CBO’s.
* Prepares evaluation reports; performs analyses; and reviews program plans, funding and performance with various CBO’s.
* Works with our various departments and Parent Association to support and develop the community workshops.
* Prepares correspondence, documents, and other forms of written communication for internal and external community outreach purposes.
* Provides logistical and administrative support to the Parent Coordinator and the Principal related to community outreach and parent engagement.
* Encourages participation from the school’s community groups in recreational activities and assists with the provision of related operational support including outreach to community agencies.

### **Qualification Requirements:**


#### **Minimum**


* A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and two years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties described above; or


* High school graduation or equivalent and six years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties as described above; or


* Education and/or experience which is equivalent to **"1"** or **"2"** above. However, all candidates must have at least one year of experience as described in **"1"** above.

* Public speaking ability and good people skills.
* Ability to interact with people of all social and economic levels.

* Knowledge of school program objectives.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Flagler Health is building the clinical operating system for modern musculoskeletal care.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


We partner with MSK provider groups and specialty clinics to help them grow, operate more efficiently, and deliver better longitudinal care across patient acquisition, clinical workflows, and ongoing patient engagement. Our platform sits at the intersection of care delivery and clinic operations, helping providers capture more value across the full patient lifecycle.


We’ve recently raised our Series B and are entering our next phase of growth.


As Account Manager, you own a portfolio of Flagler's existing customer accounts and are responsible for growing them. You build trusted relationships with clinic and provider\-group stakeholders, understand their goals, and help them get more value from the platform over time. You partner with Customer Success, Product, and Revenue Operations to find where accounts can expand and to turn those opportunities into larger, longer\-term partnerships. Success in the role is measured by account growth and retention.  

What You'll Do

* Own a portfolio of existing accounts and carry a target for growth and retention.
* Build strong relationships with the decision\-makers and day\-to\-day users at each clinic or provider group.
* Learn each account's goals and workflows, and proactively surface ways they can get more value from the platform.
* Identify and close expansion opportunities within your accounts, from first conversation through signed agreement.
* Prepare proposals, pricing, and business cases that show the value of expanding.
* Lead regular account reviews and renewals, and keep customers engaged in between.
* Partner with Customer Success, Product, and Revenue Operations to remove blockers and deliver on what you sell.
* Track account health and forecast growth accurately in the CRM.


Required Qualifications

* 5 to 7 years in account management, sales, or a customer\-facing revenue role, with a record of growing existing accounts.
* A consistent track record of hitting growth or retention targets.
* Strong relationship\-building, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Comfort with CRM and sales tooling, pipeline management, and data\-driven account planning.
* Ability to manage a portfolio of accounts and priorities at once without losing the details.


Preferred Qualifications

* Healthtech and enterprise experience, highly preferred.
* Experience growing existing customer accounts or expanding product adoption.
* Familiarity with revenue operations tooling and analytics.

**Our Values:**
---------------


This is what you can expect of your teammates at Flagler:

* **Owner:** We own our work like founders. We don't wait to be asked, and we pick up the problem nobody else has.
* **Builder:** We like making things from scratch. We don't need a playbook to start, and we'd rather ship a rough first version than wait on a perfect spec.
* **Fast:** We make quick decisions. We favor progress and respect process.
* **Transparent:** We communicate directly. We value merit and honesty, and we challenge assumptions, including our own.
* **Curious:** We explore new approaches and ask "why" often.


Compensation Range: $85K \- $120K

From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signaling and digital mobility, we offer our customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide.



Could you be the full\-time **Customer Communications Specialist** we’re looking for at Newark Airport?


**Customer Communications Specialist (Union Position)**


**Location:** Newark Liberty International Airport (Newark, NJ)  

**Pay:** $21\.10/hour
**Your future role**
--------------------



Take on a hands\-on role where clear, real\-time communication makes a direct impact. As a Customer Communications Specialist, you’ll keep passengers, airport partners, and internal teams informed—especially during service disruptions—helping ensure a smooth and safe travel experience.



Working alongside a collaborative and fast\-paced team, you’ll monitor system activity, respond quickly to operational changes, and deliver accurate updates when they matter most.



You’ll play a key role in:


* Communicating real\-time service updates to passengers and stakeholders
* Supporting response efforts during AirTrain service disruptions
* Coordinating with operations, maintenance, and airport teams
* Ensuring all communication channels (PA systems, radios, intercoms) are ready and functioning
* Contributing to basic reporting and system monitoring activities

**What success looks like in this role**
----------------------------------------


* Passengers receive timely, clear, and consistent information
* Communication supports efficient operational recovery
* Stakeholders remain aligned during fast\-changing situations
* Systems are checked regularly and ready for use
* Information is delivered confidently, even under pressure

**All about you**
-----------------



We value attitude, reliability, and communication skills. You don’t need to meet every requirement to apply—we’re looking for candidates who are ready to learn and grow.


* Strong communicator with the ability to stay clear and calm under pressure
* Quick thinker who can respond in real time without hesitation
* Customer\-focused mindset with attention to detail
* Comfortable working in a structured, team\-based environment
* Able to collaborate across operations, maintenance, and external partners
* Experience with radios, intercoms, or similar systems is helpful (not required)

**Things you’ll enjoy**
-----------------------


* A stable, union role with competitive hourly pay (**$21\.10/hour**)
* A dynamic work environment where no two days are the same
* The opportunity to support critical airport transportation operations
* Working alongside experienced, supportive colleagues
* Career development opportunities within a global organization


You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. But once you see the impact of your work, you’ll be proud to be part of the journey.



**Important to note**

new_jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
new_jobs.description:
NJ/NY Gotham FC (“Gotham FC” or “the Club”) is a National Women’s Soccer League (“NWSL”) team representing New Jersey and New York. The team plays at Sports Illustrated Stadium in Harrison, NJ. At Gotham FC, we don’t just play soccer; we set trends, challenge the status quo, and lead with bold creativity. While our roots are grounded in the tradition of the beautiful game, everything else about us is fiercely original. We’re here to redefine expectations, break boundaries, and build something that hasn’t been done before. If you’re ready to push the limits and make an impact, you belong at Gotham FC. **The Role:**
Gotham FC is seeking an Inside Sales Representative (ISR) that will report to the Director of Sales. This role is designed for those passionate about sports and eager to develop their sales skills in a fast\-paced, competitive environment. Our ISRs reach their goals by phone prospecting, setting outside appointments, participating in sales/promotional events and prospecting at Gotham FC home matches as well as events. They are also responsible for delivering exceptional customer service, updating and maintaining account records, and other duties as assigned. This position will have set start and end dates. **Key Responsibilities:*** Sales Goals Achievement: Consistently meet or exceed established sales targets for season memberships (full season), group ticket packages, and other offerings.
* Outbound Sales Efforts: Actively engage in outbound sales efforts, including but not limited to prospecting, networking, and cold calling, to generate new business opportunities and build a robust client base.
* Lead Generation and Database Management: Use sales and service best practices to effectively manage lead generation, data capture, and database management to maximize sales potential.
* Customer Service Excellence: Provide exceptional service to all Season Members, group buyers, single\-game buyers, and new business prospects to ensure long\-term satisfaction and retention.
* Sales Strategy Development: Continuously develop and implement creative sales strategies and promotional ideas to generate new business and drive ticket sales.
* Collaboration and Team Culture: Work collaboratively with the sales team, fostering a supportive and motivated environment. Participate in regular sales meetings and training sessions.

 **Qualifications:*** Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience.
* Strong Work Ethic \& Competitiveness: A self\-starter with a positive attitude and a passion for achieving sales goals.
* Team Player: Ability to collaborate and work well within a team environment.
* Outbound Sales Comfort: Comfortable with making outbound cold calls.
* Career\-Oriented: A strong desire to start a career with a team offering significant growth opportunities.
* Professional Presentation: Demonstrates professionalism in both appearance and interactions with individuals at all organizational levels.
* Adaptability: Able to address challenges and adapt quickly in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.

Proven Results\-Driven Approach: Demonstrated success in achieving or exceeding sales targets and driving results.  
* 

**Capability \& Other Characteristics:*** Legally authorized to work in the United States.

 **Location:**
Based at Gotham FC’s business office, which is located at 15 Exchange Place, Jersey City, New Jersey, on a hybrid working schedule that consists of three core in\-office/in\-person days (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday) and two non\-core days (Monday and Friday), with the option of being in the business office or remote. Ability to attend all home games and any mandatory events as well as away games, as necessary. A willingness to travel for other business\-related needs, as they arise. Ability to work at the team’s soccer operations office in Whippany, New Jersey, as needed. Gotham FC requires its associates to live in its market, that is, within reasonable commuting distance of Gotham FC’s offices, practice facility and Sports Illustrated Arena.  

Gotham FC is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes everyone to our team. We are committed to broadening the pool of qualified talent for consideration, including those who have been historically underrepresented. We strongly encourage people of color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non\-binary people, veterans, parents, and individuals with disabilities to apply. **Job type:** Full\-time Non\-Exempt position  

**Salary range:** $20 Per Hour \+ Commission opportunities  

**Benefits**: Medical, Dental \& Vision benefit plans available for Employee and Family, Employee\-funded 401(k) option  


This job description is a broad summary of the essential job functions and general duties for this position, the additional job duties that may be required from time\-to\-time, the level of knowledge and skill typically required, and the scope of responsibility, but should not be considered an all\-inclusive listing of work requirements. The person in this role may be required to and must be willing to perform other duties as assigned to meet organizational needs. This job description may be modified from time to time, at the sole discretion of Gotham FC.  


This employee must follow and enforce all policies and procedures formulated by Gotham FC and be a role model for the organization.

new_jobs.title: Digital Incentives Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
Neptune Retail Solutions is the unparalleled leader in omnichannel retail marketing across the U.S. and Canada. Neptune's In\-Store Media network is unmatched across 60,000 locations and 140 banners, including Albertsons, CVS, Dollar General, Family Dollar, HEB, Kroger, Loblaw, Metro, Publix, Sobeys, Southeastern Grocers, Meijer, HyVee, Total Wine \& More and Wakefern. Linked to its market\-leading Digital Incentives Network at many of the same retailers plus BJ's and Target, along with Neptune's exclusive ability to combine in\-store and Digital OOH content into a single platform with unparalleled precision, scale and proven results, the Company is "one of one," uniquely positioned to seamlessly drive traffic, conversion and profitable revenue growth for retailers and advertisers. For more information, visit www.neptuneretailsolutions.com.

 **The Position:**



The Digital Incentives Account Manager supports digital incentives programs for CPG and Retail marketers. This role serves as a client consultant and works closely with clients, agencies, and cross\-functional internal teams to ensure flawless project management, execution, and optimization of campaigns on behalf of Neptune’s clients. Successful candidates will be creative, curious, self\-motivated, driven to deliver operational excellence, dedicated to world class customer service, willing to innovate and have high integrity. This is a remote position.

  


**Key Responsibilities of the position:**


* Advocate and voice of our customers; utilize subject matter experts to deliver thought leadership, insights, product recommendations and new technology.
* Provide digital incentives operational and compliance driven consultative best practices and recommendations to Clients, Sales, and Operations teams to shape creative and targeting to meet KPIs and program goals.
* Manage multiple digital incentive campaign launches, including developing, maintaining, and communicating campaign pipeline, timelines, and tasks.
* Creating and managing digital incentive campaign contracts in partnership with Sales and Finance, and managing the enforcement of Neptune rules and fees.
* Project manage and lead digital incentives executional relationships with assigned Sales team, Client(s) and Agencies.
* Assist client with promotion onboarding, technical execution, program implementation, and first\-tier technical troubleshooting.
* Ensure and maintain overall campaign quality.
* Accountable for tracking live campaigns, provide optimization and best practices to customers to meet KPIs.
* Ownership of basic end of campaign reporting and deliverables.
* Provide Finance and Client support for basic invoicing questions.
* Ability to evaluate processes and continually seek improvement ideas.
* Assist with special projects as assigned by leadership.

  


**What you’ll bring to the team:**


* Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Communications, Marketing or related field (and/or equivalent, relevant work experience).
* Minimum of 3 years’ experience ranging for college internships to a professional position in Campaign Management, Customer Success, or Account Management/Client Services \- dealing directly with internal business teams, vendors, clients and/or Sales Executives.
* Proven ability to manage complex projects to successful conclusion.
* Exhibit exceptional client service and collaboration skills.
* Able to work with data and provide actionable campaign insights.
* Superior written and verbal communication with the ability to effectively communicate via email and phone with remote colleagues and clients.
* Ability to adapt and change with the needs of the business mindfully and tactically.
* Proven ability to establish and maintain strong Client partnerships.
* Excellent organizational skills including strong attention to detail and ability to present complex information in such a way that all team members understand their tasks at hand.
* Strong time management skills including an outstanding ability to work independently and multi\-task while operating in an environment of frequently changing priorities and successfully managing the demands of a quickly growing workforce.
* Proven ability to mitigate problems through first\-tier troubleshooting, identify pain points, manage issues through resolution that put the customer first, and apply learnings to future situations.
* Must have technical proficiency with Microsoft Office and reporting tools. Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, etc. are a plus.
* Experience working with Adult Beverage brands (either directly or at an agency), is a big plus

  


***Applicants must be able to work for any U.S. employer and not require sponsorship either now or in the future.***

  

Applicant Privacy Notice


**Neptune Retail Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

new_jobs.title: Pharmaceutical Sales Representative
new_jobs.description:
**Description**


Join Syneos Health in partnership with a large Biopharmaceutical company as a Pharmaceutical Sales Representative (PSR). Become a part of a fast\-paced and challenging environment where our compassion and dedication drive us to meet the unique needs and goals of our customers. The PSR role is responsible for building relationships with recognized experts, healthcare providers (HCPs) and prioritized stakeholders.

**The successful PSR will:**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing, and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key accounts with the goal of maximizing sales
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action
* Deliver clinical brand specific presentations of product(s) to physicians and other appropriate health care professionals
* Develop a complete understanding of the health care delivery system within each assigned customer, including the physician hierarchy, key pharmacy personnel, clinical nursing staff, etc.
* Develop deep product and competitor knowledge and understanding of local and regional market trends
* Analyze local trends, identifying long and short\-term goals to craft a strong product business plan
* Collaborate and partner with peers in the sales organization, brand team and other support partners to deliver an extraordinary customer experience
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner
* Execute the company brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area
* Participation in training and development programs
* Leverage AI\-driven insights and digital engagement tools to personalize healthcare provider interactions and improve customer experience.
* Adapt to emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence and automation tools, to enhance productivity, customer engagement, and business outcomes.
* Maintain adherence and compliance with all corporate, industry policies and procedures

**Essential Requirements:**

* BA/BS degree required, Life Sciences preferred
* Business to business sales experience or internship experience and/or sales degree or 2\+ years of pharmaceutical experience
* Ability to identify key decision makers, develop positive relationships and strong customer dedication and influence prescribing habits
* Ability to learn, apply, and communicate products and disease states
* Proven track record of success in exceeding results
* Team player who can also work independently, highly collaborative and motivated to succeed
* Strong communication, business analytics and account management skills
* Strong digital acumen with an interest in adopting innovative technologies, including artificial intelligence, to drive performance and operational efficiency.

**Desired Requirements:**

* Cardiovascular Experience


The annual base salary for this position is **$60,000 – $90,000**. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include a company car or car allowance and eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and/or individual performance.


At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Here, the work is challenging, and the pace is exhilarating. By joining one of our commercial teams, you’re empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy that you need. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Syneos Health has launched more sales teams in the last 5 years across all major therapeutic areas than the top 25 pharma companies combined. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients. Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.


Work Here Matters Everywhere \| How are you inspired to change lives?

*Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*


At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality\-of\-life balance. The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos Health complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

new_jobs.title: Part-Time Financial Services Sales Representative (Full time unlocked with performance)
new_jobs.description:
Part\-Time Financial Services Sales Representative

Please email us at Hiring@PathwayCatalyst.com for more information about the position, how to get bonuses, raises, more hours, and promotions. The entire roadmap is already established of how we can bring the right candidate from day to an executive after 18 months.

**Pathway Catalyst \| Midtown Manhattan \| In Person Only**  
**10 Positions Available \| $20/Hour \+ Performance Bonuses**  
**No Experience Required \| Paid Training \| Path to Full Time**

**(Experience and/or Bi\-lingual Spanish \-priority)**

Your talent deserves somewhere to grow.

You can start a conversation. You connect with people. You’re ambitious, eager to learn, and ready for an opportunity where your results can increase your income.

**At Pathway Catalyst, we’re hiring people we can train, develop, and grow into our next generation of Account Executives.**

Start part time with a schedule that can work around your current commitments. Learn the business, build your confidence, and see whether financial services sales is the long\-term career you’ve been looking for.

Start with flexibility. Advance with clear targets.

You’ll begin with **20 calling hours per week, plus two additional paid training hours**. Five\-hour morning, afternoon, evening, and weekend shifts offer scheduling options while you get started.

As your verified production grows, you unlock additional hours and higher pay through clearly defined milestones. You’ll know what you’re working toward and how your results move you forward.

**This is a part\-time starting position. Full\-time hours must be earned through performance.** We want to help you qualify as soon as possible. Expanded schedules include morning, night, and weekend coverage requirements.

Build your earning potential.

* **Start at $20/hour**, with performance milestones leading to $21, $22, and up to $25/hour.
* **Unlock more calling hours**, progressing from 20 toward full\-time schedules and potentially up to 60 hours weekly.
* **Earn $2–$5 per verified qualified lead** when you meet the weekly production pace.
* **Earn $5 per verified completed application.**
* **Receive additional fixed funding bonuses** when eligible opportunities you originate result in funding.

Your raise and additional\-hour milestones are separate—you can earn one before the other. Advancement is based on objective, verified results.

**Illustrative first\-year earnings range from approximately $51,000 to nearly $90,000** for employees who maintain the modeled production levels and work their earned additional hours. These projections include hourly pay, paid training, overtime, and lead and application bonuses. They are not guaranteed earnings or the income for remaining at the starting part\-time schedule.

The development roadmap targets advancement toward the next company tier around **12–18 months**, based on performance and readiness, with increased base pay and stronger incentives.

What you’ll do

You’ll work from our Midtown Manhattan office, speaking with business owners by phone and helping them take the first step toward exploring business financing.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Making outbound calls using our dialer and approved scripts.
* Generating interest in business financing and financial services.
* Asking qualification questions and identifying interested prospects.
* Recording accurate information and follow\-up activity in our CRM.
* Helping prospects move toward a completed application.
* Handing qualified opportunities to our account team.
* Participating in training, applying feedback, and tracking your progress.

**You don’t need to arrive as a financial expert.** We’ll teach you our services, systems, qualification process, and approach to productive sales conversations.

Who will thrive here?

Someone who brings energy to the phone, takes coaching seriously, and wants to improve.

We’re looking for:

* Strong communication skills and a willingness to start conversations.
* Reliability, focus, and consistent effort.
* Resilience when a prospect says no.
* Curiosity and a willingness to learn.
* Motivation to work toward measurable goals.
* Ambition to earn greater responsibility and income.

Previous sales, customer service, hospitality, or phone experience can help, but **experience is not required**.

This is a high\-energy, in\-person workplace. Personal cell phones must be stored securely while working in the office, and employees are expected to follow that policy without repeated reminders.

We’re hiring for potential—and investing in progress.

You bring the drive. We provide training, coaching, and a defined path forward.

If you have skills you’re ready to develop and want an opportunity to start part time while building toward a bigger career, we’d like to meet you.

**Apply now with your résumé and availability. Tell us what strength you’re ready to put to work.**

**10 positions available. Join Pathway Catalyst and start building your next chapter.**

Pay: $51,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Ability to Commute:

* New York, NY 10018 (Required)

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.description:
**$3,900 Sign\-On Bonus\***


**Entry Level Sales Representative**


**Build Your Career With Purpose**


At POWER, sales is more than closing deals \- it's about helping homeowners make confident decisions while building a career with unlimited growth potential. As a full\-time Sales Representative you'll receive hands\-on training, mentorship, and the tools you need to develop professionally, earn uncapped commissions, and make an impact from day one.


**How you’ll make an impact**


* Meet with homeowners to deliver engaging presentations on our energy\-efficient home remodeling products and services.
* Learn POWER’s proven sales process through ongoing training and coaching.
* Build meaningful relationships with customers by understanding their needs and recommending personalized solutions.
* Collaborate with teammates and mentors to continuously improve your sales approach.
* Develop communication, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills that prepare you for long\-term career growth.


**How you’ll partner with others**


* Partner with experienced sales leaders who will coach and support your development.
* Participate in weekly team meetings, training sessions, and collaborative learning opportunities.
* Contribute to a team culture built around mentorship, accountability, and celebrating success.


**What success looks like**


* Deliver exceptional customer experiences throughout every appointment.
* Consistently apply POWER’s sales process and product knowledge.
* Achieve individual sales goals while contributing to overall team success.
* Continue developing the skills needed for advancement within the organization.


**What It Takes To Succeed**


***You have these minimum qualifications:***


* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Confidence speaking with new people and presenting information.
* A self\-motivated mindset with a desire to learn and grow.
* Ability to work independently while thriving in a team environment.
* High school diploma or equivalent.


***It would be helpful if you have:***


* Previous experience in sales, customer service, hospitality, or another customer\-facing role.
* Bachelor's degree.
* Experience delivering presentations or working toward performance\-based goals.


**Why You’ll Love Working Here**


At POWER, your success starts with our investment in you. From paid training and mentorship to comprehensive benefits and career advancement opportunities, we're committed to helping you build a rewarding long\-term career.


**Some of the benefits you’ll enjoy include:**


* **Competitive Earning Potential** \- Earn $72,000 \- $130,000 each year paid at an hourly rate which includes uncapped commissions and bonuses
* **Comprehensive Health Coverage** \- Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance plans designed to support you and your family.
* **Retirement Savings** \- Build your future with a 401(k) plan that includes company matching.
* **Paid Time Away** \- Take advantage of paid holidays and paid parental leave so you can focus on what matters most.
* **Wellness Support** \- Access to wellness programs that help you stay at your best.
* **Professional Development** \- Receive industry\-leading training, mentorship, leadership development, and ongoing opportunities for career growth.
* **Performance Recognition** \- Celebrate your success with incentive vacations, exclusive rewards, and recognition for top performance.
* **Tools For Success** \- Work with modern technology and resources that help you serve customers and maximize your potential.
* **An Inclusive Culture** \- Join a team that values diverse perspectives, supports employee resource groups, encourages veterans to apply, and is committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive.
* **Community Impact** \- Give back through volunteer opportunities and company initiatives that make a positive impact in the communities we serve.
* **Modern Workspaces** \- Collaborate in thoughtfully designed office spaces with opportunities for relocation as your career grows.


**Office Locations**


* Edison, NJ
* Princeton, NJ
* Neptune, NJ

  




* *Power offers a $3,900 sign\-on bonus, which will be paid weekly in $325 increments over the course of twelve weeks of initial training. The full sign\-on bonus is contingent on successfully completing the twelve weeks of initial training.*

  


*Power Home Remodeling Group is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to hiring a diverse and talented workforce. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please submit the accommodation request to recruiting@powerhrg.com*

new_jobs.title: Enterprise Business Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
**About Ande**  

We're a Series A startup building an AI\-native platform that connects Enterprises and Hospitality across the entire booking experience, backed by top\-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, Sierra Ventures, and Bain Capital, and led by a serial entrepreneur with offices in NYC and SF. We help companies turn every dinner, event, and offsite into something effortless to plan and a breeze to manage, plugging right into the tools they already use.

**About the Role**  

You'll start the conversations that become Ande's enterprise deals. You'll research companies that spend on corporate entertainment, open conversations with the people who book and approve that spend, and book qualified meetings for our Account Executives.


This is an in\-office role on a small, early sales team. You'll work day to day with the Enterprise GTM Lead and the AEs you support, and help shape the outbound playbook as we grow.

**What You'll Do**

* Prospect into enterprise accounts that fit Ande's ideal customer profile.
* Run outbound across email, phone and LinkedIn to the people who book and approve entertainment spend
* Use AI native tools to research every account before you reach out, so each message is specific to the person and their business.
* Book qualified meetings: an account that fits our profile, a conversation with a decision maker or key influencer, and an opportunity the AE moves to the qualified stage.
* Hand each meeting to the AE with clear context, and keep your activity and pipeline accurate in Salesforce.
* Work conferences and events with the team, and follow up on the contacts made there.
* Share what you hear from prospects, including which messages land and which don't, so we can sharpen targeting and messaging.
* Hit a quarterly qualified\-meeting target.

**What We're Looking For**

* Prospect into enterprise accounts that fit Ande's ideal customer profile.
* Run outbound across email, phone and LinkedIn to the people who book and approve entertainment spend
* Use AI native tools to research every account before you reach out, so each message is specific to the person and their business.
* Book qualified meetings: an account that fits our profile, a conversation with a decision maker or key influencer, and an opportunity the AE moves to the qualified stage.
* Hand each meeting to the AE with clear context, and keep your activity and pipeline accurate in Salesforce.
* Work conferences and events with the team, and follow up on the contacts made there.
* Share what you hear from prospects, including which messages land and which don't, so we can sharpen targeting and messaging.
* Hit a quarterly qualified\-meeting target.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience prospecting into procurement, events or field marketing teams.
* Familiarity with events, or travel and expense software.
* Hands\-on use of AI tools in your prospecting workflow.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**  

*Ande is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. new_jobs.title: Executive Assistant - GIP
new_jobs.description:
Location: New York, New York Team: Administrative Support Job Requisition \#: R266664 Date posted: Sep. 30, 2026
  
**Job description**
-------------------


**About this role**


**Position Title:** Executive Assistant, GIP Credit Team

  

  

**Location:** New York

  

  

**Overview:**


Global Infrastructure Partners (GIP), a part of BlackRock, is a leading infrastructure investor that specializes in investing in, owning and operating some of the largest and most complex assets across the energy, transport, digital infrastructure and water and waste management sectors. In October 2024, BlackRock completed the acquisition of GIP, positioning GIP to continue to capitalize on the long\-term structural trends driving infrastructure growth.

  

  

GIP’s scaled platform has over $189 billion in assets under management. We believe that our focus on real infrastructure assets, combined with our deep proprietary origination network and comprehensive operational expertise, enables us to be responsible stewards of our clients’ capital and create positive economic impact for communities.

  

  

GIP Credit, the credit arm of Global Infrastructure Partners, was formed to make primarily “non\-equity” investments, with the ability to transact across multiple entry points in the capital stack. GIP Credit targets power, energy, transport, water and waste, digital and other industries or projects with infrastructure\-like characteristics. GIP Credit provides financing solutions across a breadth of capital needs, including greenfield and brownfield projects, acquisition finance, liquidity and growth, restructuring and secondary purchases. GIP Credit manages more than $25 billion of assets under management.

  

  

**Position Summary:**


The Executive Assistant is responsible for providing administrative support to the GIP Credit team.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**


* Manage calendars and coordinate high volume scheduling with internal and external stakeholders
* Book domestic and international travel, including itinerary, visa, preparation, etc. There will be heavy international travel coordination across multiple time zones.
* This role deals with investors and high\-profile individuals so a polished presence and capability to build relationships is important.
* Compile receipts and prepare expense reports in a timely manner.
* Compile materials and prepare presentations for internal, company and investor meetings and support ad\-hoc projects as needed.
* Develop relationships and work collaboratively across EAs and other counterparties.
* Facilitate and track the group recruiting process, including direct contact with recruiters to provide updates and schedule interviews/model tests
* Coordinate, schedule and facilitate agendas for global group / regularly scheduled meetings
* Manage the approval of invoices and wire instructions for our portfolio companies
* There is no travel required
  

  

**Qualifications:**

new_jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Landscape Studio Group is a design\-build landscape company serving high\-end residential homes throughout the Atlanta area. We create beautiful, functional outdoor spaces through innovative design, exceptional craftsmanship, and collaborative project execution. Our clients value attention to detail, clear communication, and a professional, personalized experience from start to finish.

As Production Coordinator, you will help deliver that experience through clear, proactive communication, thoughtful coordination, and strong relationships with homeowners, our internal team, and outside partners.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an energetic and detail\-oriented Landscape Construction Production Coordinator to support and coordinate our landscape construction projects.

This role works closely with and supports our current Production Manager, who leads field operations and manages the crews.

The Production Coordinator focuses on project planning, purchasing, job\-cost tracking, scheduling support, and customer communication, partnering with the Production Manager to keep projects organized and running smoothly.

You will coordinate project schedules and resources, keep customers and teammates informed, and help deliver exceptional results on time and within budget. Strong relationships, proactive communication, and consistent follow\-through are essential to success in this position.

**Responsibilities**

* Plan and coordinate high\-end residential landscape construction projects alongside the Production Manager, including materials, work sequences, schedules, and estimated crew days.
* Serve as a key point of contact for homeowners, providing proactive updates, answering questions, communicating schedule changes, and following through on concerns.
* Work closely with leadership, the Production Manager, and crews to keep project information accurate, priorities clear, and work moving efficiently.
* Review project plans and drawings to develop materials lists and ensure the team has current information.
* Order materials against approved estimates, confirm specifications and delivery dates, and flag potential budget overruns before purchases are made.
* Maintain accurate daily job\-cost records, including receipts, material purchases, and subcontractor expenses.
* Review labor hours against estimates weekly with the Production Manager and address variances while projects are underway.
* Coordinate subcontractor scopes, pricing, schedules, and insurance documentation.
* Schedule and track inspections, keeping customers and the field team informed of requirements and next steps.
* Identify potential problems early, communicate them clearly, and work collaboratively to find practical solutions.
* Learn and consistently use company\-selected software, internal systems, and AI tools to manage project information, communication, costs, and reporting.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* Experience in landscape construction, residential construction coordination, or production administration.
* Excellent customer service and communication skills, with the professionalism to work with homeowners who expect a high level of service and attention to detail.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build productive relationships with teammates, customers, subcontractors, and suppliers.
* Confidence handling challenging conversations about budgets, schedules, and expectations respectfully and constructively.
* Ability to read construction plans and drawings and develop accurate materials lists.
* Working knowledge of landscape construction materials, including stone, aggregate, pipe, plants, and pavers.
* Experience with purchasing, purchase orders, job costing, and tracking expenses against project budgets.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow\-through across multiple active projects.
* Ability to prioritize, adapt to changing schedules, and take initiative.
* Willingness to learn new technology and use the software, internal systems, and AI tools selected by the company. Prior experience with a specific platform is not required.
* Permitting and inspection experience in metro Atlanta and Spanish language skills are a plus.

At Landscape Studio Group, beautiful outdoor spaces start with great people working together. If you enjoy building relationships, keeping projects organized, and seeing thoughtful plans come to life, we’d love to meet you.

Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities.
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner.
* Execute the company’s brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area.
* Participation in training and development programs.
* Comply with all legal, regulatory and compliance policies and demonstrate a high level of integrity and professionalism at all times.
* Additional duties as required.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Business or a related field required.
* 3\+ years of pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical sales experience.
* 2\+ years of cardiovascular/cardiometabolic strongly preferred.
* Experience in highly managed, payor\-controlled markets is strongly preferred.
* Consistent track record of documented top\-tier sales accomplishments.
* Experience calling on assigned targets in the designated territory geography highly desired.
* Experience launching products in competitive marketplace.
* Ability to learn complex scientific information, apply technical proficiency and effectively communicate.
* Must be self\-motivated and able to work with a high level of autonomy and independence.
* Strong technical \& analytical skills including proficiency with CRM, AI tools and Microsoft Office Suite.
* A valid driver’s license and ability to travel as needed, which may include overnight and/or weekend travel.

**Job ID:** 18689\-OTHLOC\-CEHvYfwy


Not ready to apply?  

Join our Talent Network
**Description**


The Cardiovascular Sales Representative (CSR) is responsible for achieving or exceeding sales goals within an assigned geography while operating in a compliant and ethical manner. This role develops and executes territory strategies, identifies customer needs, and drives results. Using strong analytical skills, the CSR evaluates regional market data to build and implement strategic territory business plans, foster lasting professional relationships, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional partners. The ideal candidate has strong business acumen, is resourceful, self\-motivated, results\-oriented, and collaborative.

**Responsibilities**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key customers and accounts with the goal of maximizing sales.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with targeted physicians to maximize new business opportunities.
* Achieve success in a complex, matrixed selling environment in which the need for collaboration and cross\-functional discipline is critical. Cross\-functional partners may consist of FRMs, TLLs, Market Access, Medical, Marketing and Operations colleagues.
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers.
* Use data tools and insights, and other informational sources such as next best action, to determine strategies and tactics for business decision\-making.
* Demonstrate account\-based selling skills (including group presentations, etc.).
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action.
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities.
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner.
* Execute the company’s brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area.
* Participation in training and development programs.
* Comply with all legal, regulatory and compliance policies and demonstrate a high level of integrity and professionalism at all times.
* Additional duties as required.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Business or a related field required.
* 3\+ years of pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical sales experience.
* 2\+ years of cardiovascular/cardiometabolic strongly preferred.
* Experience in highly managed, payor\-controlled markets is strongly preferred.
* Consistent track record of documented top\-tier sales accomplishments.
* Experience calling on assigned targets in the designated territory geography highly desired.
* Experience launching products in competitive marketplace.
* Ability to learn complex scientific information, apply technical proficiency and effectively communicate.
* Must be self\-motivated and able to work with a high level of autonomy and independence.
* Strong technical \& analytical skills including proficiency with CRM, AI tools and Microsoft Office Suite.
* A valid driver’s license and ability to travel as needed, which may include overnight and/or weekend travel.

new_jobs.description:
**$3,900 Sign\-On Bonus\***


**Entry Level Sales Representative**


**Build Your Career With Purpose**


At POWER, sales is more than closing deals \- it's about helping homeowners make confident decisions while building a career with unlimited growth potential. * Meet with homeowners to deliver engaging presentations on our energy\-efficient home remodeling products and services.

* Develop communication, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills that prepare you for long\-term career growth.


**How you’ll partner with others**


* Partner with experienced sales leaders who will coach and support your development.
* Participate in weekly team meetings, training sessions, and collaborative learning opportunities.
* Contribute to a team culture built around mentorship, accountability, and celebrating success.


**What success looks like**


* Deliver exceptional customer experiences throughout every appointment.
* Consistently apply POWER’s sales process and product knowledge.
* Achieve individual sales goals while contributing to overall team success.
* Continue developing the skills needed for advancement within the organization.


**What It Takes To Succeed**


***You have these minimum qualifications:***


* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Confidence speaking with new people and presenting information.
* A self\-motivated mindset with a desire to learn and grow.
* Ability to work independently while thriving in a team environment.
* High school diploma or equivalent.


***It would be helpful if you have:***


* Previous experience in sales, customer service, hospitality, or another customer\-facing role.
* Bachelor's degree.
* Experience delivering presentations or working toward performance\-based goals.


**Why You’ll Love Working Here**


At POWER, your success starts with our investment in you. From paid training and mentorship to comprehensive benefits and career advancement opportunities, we're committed to helping you build a rewarding long\-term career.


**Some of the benefits you’ll enjoy include:**


* **Competitive Earning Potential** \- Earn $72,000 \- $130,000 each year paid at an hourly rate which includes uncapped commissions and bonuses
* **Comprehensive Health Coverage** \- Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance plans designed to support you and your family.
* **Retirement Savings** \- Build your future with a 401(k) plan that includes company matching.
* **Paid Time Away** \- Take advantage of paid holidays and paid parental leave so you can focus on what matters most.
* **Wellness Support** \- Access to wellness programs that help you stay at your best.
* **Professional Development** \- Receive industry\-leading training, mentorship, leadership development, and ongoing opportunities for career growth.
* **Performance Recognition** \- Celebrate your success with incentive vacations, exclusive rewards, and recognition for top performance.
* **Tools For Success** \- Work with modern technology and resources that help you serve customers and maximize your potential.
* **An Inclusive Culture** \- Join a team that values diverse perspectives, supports employee resource groups, encourages veterans to apply, and is committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive.
* **Community Impact** \- Give back through volunteer opportunities and company initiatives that make a positive impact in the communities we serve.
* **Modern Workspaces** \- Collaborate in thoughtfully designed office spaces with opportunities for relocation as your career grows.


**Office Locations**


* Duluth, GA
* Marietta, GA

  




* *Power offers a $3,900 sign\-on bonus, which will be paid weekly in $325 increments over the course of twelve weeks of initial training. The full sign\-on bonus is contingent on successfully completing the twelve weeks of initial training.*

**This is a hybrid position requiring in\-office attendance 2\-3 days per week at our Atlanta office. Candidates must reside within a commutable distance to be considered.**


As a Sales Development Representative, you'll report to our SDR Manager and build a qualified pipeline for our Enterprise and Strategic sales teams. Most of your day is outbound: researching accounts, picking up the phone, and opening conversations with product leaders who haven't met Fullstory yet. AI is part of how you'll work every day, taking the busywork out of research so more of your time goes to real conversations.

**In a typical day, you might:**

* Book six qualified opportunities a month, mostly through outbound. Inbound leads help, but they won't get you to quota on their own.
* Prospect into a shared pool of enterprise and strategic accounts
* Cold call the buyers we win with most, and think on your feet when they push back.
* Research accounts and prospects in Salesforce, ZoomInfo, Sales Navigator, and pull them into Outreach, so every call opens with a reason the person on the other end should care.
* Use AI tools to research accounts, prep calls, and cut repetitive steps from your day, so you ramp faster and spend more time selling.
* Spend your in\-office day in Atlanta alongside our sales leaders, getting close to the work.

**Here’s what we’re looking for:**

* You've sold something where the results were yours: door\-to\-door, phone sales, retail, events, or an SDR internship.
* You've done high\-volume cold outreach, by phone or in person, to people who weren't expecting you.
* You've worked against a number, like dials, sales, or a quota, and can show how you tracked against it.
* You've worked somewhere that changed fast, like new targets, processes, or team structure, and adapted without waiting for direction.
* You've used an AI tool like Claude to build something or cut real time out of a workflow.

***The impact you will have in 6 months:***

* You're consistently hitting target by booking qualified meetings each month, mostly from outbound you sourced, and running your own week without daily direction.
* AI is a natural part of how you work, and you're always looking for new ways it can help you prospect smarter.

***The impact you will have in 12 months:***

* You're someone other reps learn from: sharing messaging that works, leading a call review, or helping other reps streamline their workflows.
* You've opened doors at tough accounts through months of persistent outbound, building a track record of beating your number.

new_jobs.title: Personal Executive Assistant & Project Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Personal Executive Assistant \& Project Coordinator — Part\-Time

**Location:** Primarily remote\-Hybrid\| Chicago\-area  
**Starting Hours:** Approximately 5 hours/week  
**Pay:** $25–$30/hour, based on experience  
**Schedule:** Flexible part\-time  
**Start:** Paid assessment → paid 30\-day introductory period → potential ongoing/increased hours

ABOUT THE ROLE

I am looking for a highly resourceful, proactive, organized **Personal Executive Assistant \& Project Coordinator** to help manage and move forward multiple personal, creative, business, family, and lifestyle projects.

This is **not** a traditional assistant role where you simply wait for step\-by\-step instructions. The ideal candidate must figure out the given objective and what would need to happen to resolve, research and verify information, identify strong options, coordinate next steps, follow up without reminders, solve problems, and bring me concise recommendations when my input is needed.

**This role is best suited for someone who genuinely enjoys variety. Projects may change week to week, and you must be comfortable moving between very different categories without requiring extensive direction.**

RESPONSIBILITIES

* Maintain my master project/task system and weekly priorities
* Track deadlines, next steps, follow\-ups and outstanding items
* Research, compare and vet professionals, services and opportunities
* Make calls, send emails, schedule appointments/consultations and follow up
* Coordinate music professionals, lessons, consultations and opportunities
* Conduct business research involving competitors, suppliers, manufacturers, vendors and markets
* Coordinate beauty, wellness, fitness and lifestyle projects
* Research events, networking opportunities, travel and experiences
* Support health\-related administration such as provider research, scheduling and follow\-ups — not medical decision\-making
* Support family logistics and appointment coordination
* Present the best 2–3 verified options rather than large unfiltered lists
* Keep projects moving without repeated reminders

IDEAL CANDIDATE

Preferably **3\+ years of relevant experience** in executive assistance, personal assistance, project coordination, operations, founder/entrepreneur support or a similar role.

You should be:

* Extremely resourceful and proactive
* Excellent at research and **verifying information**
* Highly organized with strong follow\-through
* Comfortable making calls and contacting unfamiliar people/organizations
* Able to manage multiple unrelated projects
* Strong at prioritization
* Able to distinguish between decisions you can make and those requiring my approval
* A concise, reliable communicator
* Comfortable respectfully pushing back when something is unrealistic
* Able to anticipate logical next steps
* Comfortable admitting when you don’t know something and figuring it out
* Professional with confidential/personal information
* Someone who brings solutions, not simply problems

Experience supporting an entrepreneur, founder, executive or creative professional with multiple simultaneous projects is strongly preferred.

Bonus — Not Required

* Chicago\-area knowledge
* Persian/Farsi or Arabic language/community knowledge
* Music, entertainment, fashion or creative\-industry experience
* Experience coordinating complex personal/family projects
* Experience with project\-management systems

**You do NOT need to be an expert in every industry listed above. Your core skill should be figuring things out, finding the right people/information, staying organized and getting things done.**

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

* Projects actually move forward
* Follow\-ups happen without reminders
* Deadlines don’t disappear
* Research is verified and useful
* I receive concise recommendations instead of information overload
* My administrative and mental workload decreases
* I spend more time on the creative, personal and business work only I can do
* I trust that assigned work will be tracked through completion

HIRING PROCESS

**1\. Interview**  
**2\. Paid practical assessment**  
**3\. Professional reference check for finalist(s)**  
**4\. Paid 30\-day introductory period at approximately 5 hours/week**

Hours may gradually increase based on workload, performance, demonstrated value and mutual fit. Increased hours are **not guaranteed**.

TO APPLY

* Résumé
* Location/time zone
* Hourly rate
* Weekly availability
* Years/type of relevant experience
* Project\-management/organization tools you use
* A brief example of a difficult or unfamiliar assignment you independently figured out

new_jobs.title: Production Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Agency Overview**  


Agency EA, a part of EA Collective, is a 100% employee\-owned, award\-winning experiential marketing agency specializing in live, virtual, and hybrid experiences for global brands. Known for its ability to blend strategy, creativity, and flawless execution, Agency EA partners with clients to bring their brands to life through impactful events, immersive environments, and engaging digital activations. As the flagship agency of EA Collective, Agency EA benefits from the broader collective’s creative resources and industry\-leading expertise to innovate and deliver unforgettable experiences that resonate with audiences and achieve business objectives.
We are looking for dreamers and doers who have the passion to champion big ideas and the talent to bring them to life. A place of acceptance and open dialogue, we strive to foster a culture where differences are not just valued, but celebrated. Come do your best and be your best in a casual yet vibrant workplace where we prioritize professional and personal growth, commit to causes we believe in, and ensure a diverse and inclusive community.
This position is based in Chicago and will involve a combination of remote and in\-office work.
**Role Summary:**
The Production Coordinator will support EA’s Production Department, both internally in
pre\-production and onsite for client events. This entry\-level position requires an eager individual
with a strong work ethic and the desire to learn and grow in a fast\-paced environment.
**Responsibilities:**
* Provide coordination and project management support to the project’s lead producer to ensure success of the program.
* Support all live, hybrid, virtual event logistics and timelines conception to completion.
* Work on multiple projects and assignments with a variety of production and cross\-department team members.
* Employ strong problem\-solving skills and provide recommendations to assigned project deliverables.
* Research and gather information in planning the execution of events.
* Sourcing caterers, giveaways/swag, hotel blocks, production supplies, vendors, venues, etc.
* Anticipate project needs to meet deadlines.
* Serve as liaison between vendors, venues staff and clients regarding event details.
* Work onsite during production for events as needed.
* Provide status reports to the Production Team as necessary.
* Coordinate and attend site visits if need arises.
* Coordinate communication with speakers/talent for scheduling technical checks and/or pre\-recorded content.
* Support the creation and management of production schedules as well as both internal and client facing project decks, as required.
* Assist producers in processing invoices and check requests.
* Additional responsibilities as assigned.

**Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent field experience in the event industry.
* 1\-2 years events industry experience preferred.
* Experience/knowledge in backend management of various meeting platforms including but not limited to Zoom host, Google Hangouts, Teams, Webex, etc.
* Knowledge of virtual event platforms is a plus.
* Event platforms including but not limited to Cvent, Swoogo, Swapcard, Kaltura, etc.
* Proficiency in the latest versions of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Keynote.
* Experience in G Suite products and Asana a plus.
* Client\-centric mentality.
* Take initiative and demonstrate confidence.
* Superior attention to detail.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to multi\-task across multiple projects, work independently and contribute to a team environment.
* Organizational and project management skills.
* Eager to learn in a fast paced, ever changing environment.
* Strong work ethic and desire to succeed.
* Some travel required.

Compensation will be based on experience and will range from $50,000 to $60,000\.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager (Chicago)
new_jobs.description:
In 1989, Wikoff’s first continual improvement department was established, adopting a Total Quality Management approach. Over the years, the department has matured and expanded its vision to include not only oversight of the quality management system, but also training programs and employee safety while adopting other improvement methodologies such as lean and six sigma.
  
  

Role
  
At Wikoff Color Corporation, we’re proud to be employee\-owned, which means every team member has a stake in our success. We believe in building a workplace where people feel valued, empowered, and invested in the future.
  
  

We are seeking a motivated and results\-driven Ink and Pressroom Products Salesperson to join our sales team. The successful candidate will be responsible for promoting and selling a range of Wikoff products to new and existing clients. This role involves prospecting, managing customer relationships, providing technical product knowledge, and achieving sales targets within an assigned territory. It is expected the candidate will drive revenue growth through consultative selling. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter with a passion for sales, excellent communication skills, and a proven track record in Ink, Coatings or Chemical environments
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Identify and develop new business opportunities through prospecting, cold calling, networking, inbound lead follow\-up and industry events.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing customers to ensure ongoing satisfaction and repeat business.
* Understand customer needs and recommend appropriate products or solutions.
* Conduct product demonstrations and deliver technical presentations to clients.
* Collaborate with technical and development teams to understand technical specifications and tailor offerings to client requirements.
* Negotiate pricing, terms, and conditions of sales agreements.
* Prepare quotes, proposals, and contracts.
* Maintain accurate records of sales activities, customer interactions, and opportunities using CRM (eChempax) software.
* Stay up to date on industry trends, market conditions, and competitors.
* Attend trade shows, conferences, and sales meetings as required.
* Ensure all competitive pricing insights are shared with the Market Manager and Regional Sales Leader in a timely manner for analysis and action.
* Develop key account plans, including sales summaries, key personnel, account strategy and an annual action plan.
* Organizing sales territory to efficiently call on current and prospective customers, coordinating all accounts with your supervisor and technical support personnel.
* Working through the Chief Commercial Officer and Regional Sales Leader in coordinating major or national accounts as they relate to local activity in communicating to corporate and other branches.
* Making recommendations to management regarding improvements in products, packaging, shipping methods, service or billing methods and procedures to prevent future complaints and following up on recommendations to ensure customer satisfaction.
* Working with field technical and production personnel to supply a current formula or produce a product that satisfies the customer’s requirement at a competitive price within material and manufacturing guidelines.
* Working with Corporate Credit and Collection to resolve delinquent accounts.
* Provide a forward\-looking 12\-month sales forecast by major customers and all others within the territory on a monthly cadence.
* Report on YTD sales performance on a periodic (monthly or quarterly) basis to the Regional Sales Leader and the Chief Commercial Officer
* Actively update and report monthly on territory sales pipeline value, opportunity progress, wins and losses and suggestions for advancing projects.
* Ensure that all sales team members adhere to company policies and procedures
* Execute your individual sales development plan to improve selling skills and effectiveness.
* Create the annual sales budget from the bottom\-up, customer by customer basis.


**Competencies:**  

* Technical aptitude and ability to understand complex products
* Customer\-centric approach
* Time management and organizational skills
* Strategic thinking, analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Persistence and resilience under pressure
* Familiarity with lead generation tools and sales automation platforms


Education/Experience
  
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Industrial Technology, Chemistry or a related field (preferred but not mandatory) Industry experience in lieu of a college degree will be considered.
* Proven experience in B2B sales (3 to 6 years), preferably within the Ink, Coating or Printing Industry.
* Strong knowledge of printing products or equipment.
* Demonstrate excellent customer service skills
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Self\-motivated with a strong drive to meet and exceed sales targets.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Ability to travel within assigned territory ( \>50%) and to meet customer contact metrics
* Proficiency with CRM systems and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Have good math skills to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commission, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume
* Results\-oriented with a focus on exceeding sales targets.


**Working Conditions:**  

* This role is field\-based where most of the time will be spent with customers and a fraction of the time will be spent in a home or branch\-based office.


**Effort/Physical Demands:**  

* Ability to sit for long periods of time
* Lifting/pushing/pulling up to 25 lbs


**Health and Safety Responsibilities:**  

* Must work in accordance with Health and Safety regulations, Company Rules, Plant Rules, policies and procedures.
* Must use or wear equipment, protective devices, or certain clothing as required by the company.

new_jobs.description:
**A path for every ambition.**

  

At HUB, we believe the best work happens when people are given real space to grow and then given the autonomy to exercise it. We power progress and protect ambition: for the clients who count on us, and equally for the people who make that possible every day.


We’re creative thinkers and determined doers, guided by values that show up in how we work together: with empathy, adaptability, accountability and a genuine commitment to one another’s success. We foster bold ideas, celebrate curiosity and share what we know. Because when people grow, the work they do grows with them.

  

Our purpose is deeply human: to help people navigate the world on their terms, at their speed, toward their future. We hold that same commitment to the people building careers here.

  

Whether you’re starting out or leveling up, you’ll find the resources to evolve, the support to take on more and a team ready to back you at every stage.

  

Your ambition has a home here.

 **About HUB**


In a rapidly changing world, HUB advises businesses and individuals on how to prepare for the unexpected. As one of the world’s largest insurance brokers, our focus is dedicated to providing our customers with the peace of mind that what matters most will be protected — through unrelenting advocacy and tailored insurance solutions that put our clients in control. Our growing team of professionals across North America represents a broad, deep, and one\-of\-a kind aggregation of entrepreneurs and leaders recognized for their excellence throughout the insurance community.

 **Why Choose HUB?**


Throughout our network of more than 700 HUB offices in North America, we offer a competitive, exciting, and friendly work environment that strategically positions our employees for longevity and success. At HUB, we believe in investing in the future of our employees and provide continuous opportunities for growth and development. Our entrepreneurial culture fosters an environment that empowers our people to make the best decisions for our customers and organization, focusing on expanding the industry knowledge of our insurance professionals to better serve our valued clients. We are committed to providing you with competitive and flexible benefits options that are rooted in your current needs yet evolves as your needs change over time. Join us in taking the first step toward creating a future that combines a diverse, challenging work environment with financial security and career satisfaction.

 **We are the perfect fit if you:**

* are seeking a progressive work environment at a rapidly growing organization
* have a desire to help others protect their future
* have an entrepreneurial spirit and are challenged by the opportunity to grow the business
* are focused on learning and development to enhance your industry knowledge and expertise
* are a self\-starter willing to invest time and energy to learn the technical aspects of our business
* believe in integrity and building success by developing relationships with others

 **Summary**


As a Commercial Lines Account Manager (High Growth Ventures), you will provide critical support to our customers through account management, claims management, day\-to\-day client oversight, and underwriting services that make us a leading sales and service organization in the insurance industry. Through a robust network of resources, you will be amongst some of the industry’s top talent to help guide and support our customer’s needs and provide them with innovative solutions. The Account Manager will support Producers and/or AEs in obtaining, maintaining, and expanding business. The Account Manager may also be responsible for account rounding and the development of new business as appropriate and in accordance with standard practices, policies, and procedures.

 **High Growth Ventures Group**


HUB’s High\-Growth Ventures Group provides tailor\-made solutions for risk, insurance and human capital to fast\-growing companies. Our bespoke service and advisory model is designed to support and empower companies in any stage of the growth lifecycle: Start up, Growth Stage, IPO/Enterprise

 **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Manages the entire account\-service process
* Markets to carriers, prepares quotes/proposals
* Processes certificates, endorsements, MVRs, loss runs, binding, billing, audits, etc., for accuracy
* Coordinates premium financing and the collection of premiums, as needed
* Coordinates and prepares renewal strategy meeting for clients
* Work with Producer and other AM to ensure retention of accounts

 **Required Skills:**

* Required minimum of 5 years of experience and demonstrated proficiency in an insurance Account Management role in commercial lines.
* Brokerage experience is preferred.
* Experience with Executive Risk and Professional Liability is preferred
* Experience with VC\-backed companies is preferred
* Excellent oral and written English communications skills.
* Superior customer service and problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrated proficiency with computer systems, including but not limited to Microsoft Office and automated agency management systems.
* Ability to work in a team environment.
* Ability to work with a fast\-paced group of clients as quick turnaround time is essential
* High level attention to detail is essential.
* Ability to work a regular, full\-time work schedule at HUB’s facility(s) and ability to travel on business when required.
* Currently licensed in good standing in required lines and states.
